text.ACTION: Ever had one of those days? You know, the kind where you wonder what you did to someone in a past life? This was one of them, and it started even before I woke up. I had this weird-ass dream.
VIDEO- An Odd Dream

I don't know what a blue limo driving through fog lined in blue velvet is supposed to mean, but I bet some shrink would get a damn paper out of coming up with something. Especially when I got to the people in there with me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/2-P4-00011.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/3-P4-00012.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/4-P4-00014.jpg
Normally I don't really remember dreams, but this one is clear as a bell.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/5-P4-00015.jpg

text.Igor: My name is Igor ...  I am delighted to make your acquaintance.
This place exists between dream and reality, mind and matter ...
It is a room that only those who are bound by a "contract" may enter ...
It may be that such a fate awaits you in the near future.
Now then ...  Why don't you introduce yourself ... ?

text.ACTION: I wonder why I needed to tell my own creepy dream my name?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/7-P4-00021.jpg

text.Igor: Hm ...  I see.
Now, let's take a look into your future, shall we?
Do you believe in fortune telling?
Each reading is done with the same cards, yet the result is always different ...
(chuckle) Life itself follows the same principles, doesn't it?
Hm ...  The Tower in the upright position represents the immediate future. It seems a terrible catastrophe is imminent.

text.ACTION: I'm moving a million miles away from home, I don't need a creepy dream troll to tell me catastrophe is coming. The next part, though, was a little more odd.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/8-P4-00031.jpg

text.Igor: The Moon, in the upright position.
This card represents "hesitation" and "mystery" ...  Very interesting indeed.
It seems you will encounter a misfortune at your destination, and a great mystery will be imposed upon you.
In the coming days, you will enter into a contract of some sort, after which you will return here.
The coming year is a turning point in your destiny ...  If the mystery goes unsolved, your future may be forever lost.
My duty is to provide assistance to our guests to ensure that does not happen.
Ah! I have neglected to introduce my assistant to you.
This is Margaret. She is a resident of this place, like myself.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/9-P4-00040.jpg

text.Igor: We shall attend to the details another time.
Until then, farewell ...

text.ACTION: That's when I woke up, which really made things even worse. As bad as crazy dreams might be, they were better than the reality of what was going to happen today. Moving to Inaba…
VIDEO- "The Train"

There's been some story or another all over the news about some politician, Namatame or something, who's been stepping out on his wife with that news announcer Yamano. Nothing really interesting. Anyway my uncle had sent me a message saying he'd meet me at the station when I arrived.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/11-P4-00055.jpg
I started kind of fuzzing out, seeing some strange things on the train. Luckily it got to Inaba before I started hallucinating or something.
VIDEO- "The Dojimas"
I wasn't left waiting long.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/13-P4-00067.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/14-P4-00068.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Welcome to Inaba. I'm Ryotaro Dojima. I'll be looking after you.
Let's see ...  I'm your mother's younger brother ...  and that about sums it up.

text.ACTION: I hadn't seen my uncle in like forever.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/16-P4-00071.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I'll say. You've really grown, I still remember when you were in diapers ...
This here's my daughter.
Come on, Nanako, introduce yourself to your cousin.

text.ACTION: I'd not met my cousin Nanako at all, he's got some crazy job that takes up all his time and stops him coming to visit.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/17-P4-00075.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: (chuckle) What're you so shy for?
Ow, hahaha.
Well then ...  Let's get going.
My car's over there.

text.ACTION: It was a bit of a drive back into town, and we ended up stopping for gas.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/19-P4-00085.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/20-P4-00086.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Can you go to the bathroom by yourself?

text.Moel Gas Station Attendant: It's in the back, to your left. You know which way's left? The side you don't hold your chopsticks in.
Are you taking a trip?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: No, we just went to pick him up. He just moved here from the big city.

text.Moel Gas Station Attendant: The city, huh ... ?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Fill up my car while you're at it. Regular's fine.

text.Moel Gas Station Attendant: Right away, Sir!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Good a time as any for a smoke ...

text.ACTION: The attendant struck up a conversation with me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/21-P4-00099.jpg

text.Moel Gas Station Attendant: Does it surprise a city boy to see how little there is out here?
There's so little to do, I'm sure you'll get bored fast. You'll either be hanging out with your friends or doing part-time jobs.
Speaking of which, we're actually looking for part-time help right now.
Give it some thought, why don't you? We don't mind if you're a student.
Oh, I should get back to work.

text.ACTION: Nanako is looking at you.
I started feeling kind of queasy. I guess it was the trip.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/22-P4-00107.jpg
Could it be exhaustion from the long trip…? Now that she mentions it, you feel a little dizzy…
Dojima got back from his smoke, and we finished our drive.
VIDEO- "The Dojima Home"
For the next year, this place will be your home…
We sat down and had some dinner.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/24-P4-00115.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: So ...  Your mom and dad are busy as always ...  They're working overseas, was it?
I know it's only for a year, but getting stuck in a place like this because of your parents ...  It's rough being a kid.
Well, it's just me and Nanako here, so it'll be nice having someone you around.
So long as you're here, you're part of the family, so make yourself at home.

text.ACTION: If I was going to be stuck here, at least it would be with nice people.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/25-P4-00120.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: C'mon, there's no need to be so formal.
Look, you're making Nanako all tense.
Well, anyway ...  Let's eat.

text.ACTION: Before we could start, Dojima got a call.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/26-P4-00124.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: ... Dojima speaking.
Yeah? I see ...  So where is it?
All right, I'm on my way.
Looks like I made the right choice to skip the booze ...
Sorry, but I gotta go take care of some business. Go ahead and eat without me.
I don't know how late I'll be. Nanako, you help him out, okay?

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/27-P4-00134.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: ... All right. Well, I'm off.

text.ACTION: Dojima left, and Nanako turned the TV on.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/28-P4-00137.jpg

text.Weather Announcer: With storm clouds moving in from the west, expect rain throughout the day tomorrow in most areas.

text.ACTION: You find yourself alone with Nanako…
You might want to strike up a conversation…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/29-P4-00142.jpg

text.Nanako: He ...  investigates stuff. Like crime scenes.

text.Announcer: And now for the local news.

text.ACTION: Crap, not this again. Why do people get so obsessed with these things?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/30-P4-00146.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/31-P4-00147.jpg

text.Announcer: In response, Eye Television has decided to cancel all of announcer Mayumi Yamano's televised appearances.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/32-P4-00149.jpg

text.Commercial: At Junes, every day is Customer Appreciation Day. Come see for yourself, and get in touch with our products!
Every day's great at your Junes!

text.ACTION: Those things have been sprouting up like mushrooms all over the place. But out here, I guess it's your best bet for shopping. Nanako seems to like the place.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/33-P4-00153.jpg
I'm pretty bushed. Time to get to sleep.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/34-P4-00172.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/35-P4-00173.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2001/36-P4-00174.jpg
At least things can't get any weirder.
The ancient Chinese had a curse: "May you live in interesting times." I think I'm starting to get that now. Where do I start? Had an even more bullshit dream last night.
VIDEO- "The Corridor"
Everything was shrouded in fog, which might have been a good thing because the floor looked really unsettling for whatever reason.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/2-P4-00008.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/3-P4-00009.jpg
This is…?
The area is covered in a thick fog…
All you can do right now is proceed forward…
As I moved forward, I heard a voice. It was just as indistinct as the world around me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/4-P4-00016.jpg
You heard someone's voice…

text.???: If it's truth you desire, come and find me ...

text.ACTION: The voice came from up ahead…
There was some kind of door at the end of the path. I had a bad feeling about it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/5-P4-00021.jpg
The other room was filled with even thicker fog. I hadn't even realized I was carrying it before, but I found a sword in my hands. It felt pretty natural, even though I've not really used one before.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/6-P4-00025.jpg
There was someone else in there with me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/7-P4-00026.jpg
I could just barely make out where the voice was coming from.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/8-P4-00030.jpg

text.???: I see ...  Indeed, you possess an interesting quality ...
But ...  you will not catch me so easily ...
If what you seek is "truth," then your search will be even harder ...

text.ACTION: The fog became even thicker…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/9-P4-00034.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/10-P4-00035.jpg
And I lost track of the voice.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/11-P4-00036.jpg

text.???: Everyone sees what they want to ... .
At a place other than here ...
Hmhm ...  I look forward to it ...

text.ACTION: You are losing consciousness…
The fog was replaced by darkness.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/12-P4-00044.jpg
You can hear someone's voice…
It's almost time to get up…
You feel like you had a nightmare…
What could it have been about…?
You're starting school today. You should head to the living room for now…
Anyway, I didn't have time to think about some crazy fog dream because it was time for school soon.
VIDEO- "The First Day"
I noticed Dojima wasn't around.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/15-P4-00056.jpg

text.Nanako: There was some kind of trouble. He won't be back.
My school's on the way, so ...  let's go together.

text.ACTION: Nanako seems somewhat restless…
You decided to head to school with Nanako.
It was raining pretty heavily. The school zone is in the Samegawa river's flood plain.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/16-P4-00063.jpg
I was almost at school when some lunatic nearly killed himself on his bike.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/17-P4-00067.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/18-P4-00068.jpg
Had to hurt.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/19-P4-00069.jpg
That looked painful…
You should leave him be…
Yasogami High School, eh…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/20-P4-00072.jpg
What kind of student life awaits you here…?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/21-P4-00075.jpg

text.Student's Friend: Yeah, it's King Moron alright ...  We get to enjoy his long-ass sermons every day for a whole year ...

text.Female Student: Hey you guys, I heard there's going to be a transfer student from the city in this class.

text.Sitting Student: Huh? Really? A guy or a girl?

text.Chie Satonaka: ... Huh? You look dead today.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, um ...  I don't wanna talk about it ...

text.Chie Satonaka: What's with him?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Who knows?

text.ACTION: I already don't like this teacher.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/25-P4-00084.jpg

text.Kinshiro Morooka: I'm Kinshiro Morooka, your homeroom teacher from today forward!
First things first! Just 'cause it's spring doesn't mean you can swoon over each other like love-struck baboons.
Long as I'm around, you students are going to be pure as the driven snow!
Now I hate wasting my time, but I'd better introduce this transfer student.
This sad sack's been thrown from the big city out to the middle of nowhere like yesterday's garbage.
And he's just as much of a loser here as he was there, so you girls better not get any ideas about hitting on him!
Tell 'em your name, kid, and make it quick.

text.ACTION: What the hell is this guy's problem?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/27-P4-00092.jpg

text.Kinshiro Morooka: Hrnh ...  That's it, you're on my shit list, effective immediately.
Now listen up!
This town is miles away from your big city of perverts and assholes, in more ways than one.
You better not even think of getting involved with the girls here, let alone abusing them!
But what do I know ...  it's not like the old days. Even here, kids grow up so damn fast.
Every time I turn my back, you're fooling around on those damn phones, checking your life-journals and you're my-places ...

text.ACTION: Mr. Morooka goes on and on…
I got a nice save just about then.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/28-P4-00101.jpg

text.Kinshiro Morooka: Huh? Yeah, sure. Hear that? Your seat's over there.
So hurry up and siddown already!

text.Chie Satonaka: He's the worst, huh?
Rotten luck for you to get stuck in this class ...  Well, we'll just have to hang in there for a year.

text.ACTION: It seems this guy's a notorious asshole.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/29-P4-00106.jpg

text.Male Student: Sucks to be the transfer student, ending up in King Moron's class on the first morning here ...

text.Whiny Student: Yeah, he won't think twice about suspending you if you get on his bad side.
Then again, we're all in the same boat ...

text.Kinshiro Morooka: Shut your traps! I'm taking roll, and I damn well expect you to respond in an orderly manner!

text.ACTION: Your life at this new school has begun.
Will you be able to fit in here…?
In an orderly and just world this would have been the worst thing that happened today.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/30-P4-00115.jpg

text.School Intercom: Please report immediately to the Faculty Office for a brief staff meeting.
All students must return to their classrooms and are not to leave the school until further notice.

text.Kinshiro Morooka: Hrnh. You heard the announcement. Don't go anywhere until you hear otherwise.

text.Brown-Haired Girl: He's seriously getting on my nerves ...

text.ACTION: And the prick left, just in time for the sirens to start. Everyone started to freak out.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/31-P4-00121.jpg

text.Excited Student: Ugh, I can't see a damn thing. Frickin' fog ...

text.Rumor-Loving Student: Yeah, like every time it rains lately, it gets all foggy.

text.Knowledgeable Student: Hey, did you hear? I hear the paparazzi's looking all over for that announcer.

text.Rumor-Loving Student: Oh yeah. You mean Mayumi Yamano, right?
I heard some guys spotted her at the shopping district.
H-Hey, Yukiko-san. Mind if I ask you something ... ?
Is it true that announcer's staying at your family's inn?

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/32-P4-00131.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: (sigh) Sheesh, how much longer is this gonna take?

text.Yukiko Amagi: There's no telling.

text.Chie Satonaka: I shoulda left before the announcement came on ...
By the way, didja try what I told you the other day?
You know ...  That thing about rainy nights ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: Oh ...  No, not yet. Sorry.

text.Chie Satonaka: Ahhh, that's okay.
Well ...  it's just, I heard a guy in the class next door yell something like, "My soulmate is Yamano, the announcer!"

text.ACTION: Then there was another announcement, seemed we could go now.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/33-P4-00141.jpg

text.School Intercom: There has been an incident inside the school district. Police officers have been dispatched around the School Zone.
Please stay calm and contact your parents or guardians as soon as possible, and quickly leave the school grounds.
Do not disturb the police officers. Head directly home.

text.Brown-Haired Girl: C'mon, let's go take a look!

text.ACTION: The girl sitting next to me came up to me before I could leave.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/34-P4-00149.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Why don't you come with us?
Oh, nearly forgot! I'm Chie Satonaka. You know I sit next to you, right?
Well, nice to meet you!
This is Yukiko Amagi.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Oh, nice to meet you ...  I'm sorry that this is so sudden ...

text.Chie Satonaka: C'mon, don't apologize like that. It makes me look like I got no upbringing.
I just wanted to ask some stuff. Really, that's all.

text.ACTION: Before we could leave, the guy who wiped out on his bike earlier came up to us. Seemed he had something to talk to Chie about.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/36-P4-00158.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: This was really awesome. Like, the way they moved was just amazing to see ...
And ...  I'm really sorry! It was an accident! Please just have mercy until my next paycheck!
Seeya thanks!

text.Chie Satonaka: Stop right there! What did you do to my DVD!?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Argh!

text.ACTION: Note to self: Chie's kicks are brutally accurate.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/37-P4-00164.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: My "Trial of the Dragon" ... !

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I think mine's cracked too ...  C-Critical hit to the nads ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: A-Are you all right?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, Yukiko-san ...  Are you worried about me ... ?

text.Chie Satonaka: He's fine, Yukiko. Let's ditch him and go home.

text.ACTION: He looks like he's in a lot of pain…
You should leave him be…
I sure as hell wasn't going to get kicked myself. And things just kept getting stranger and stranger.
VIDEO- "The Walk Home"

text.Yukiko Amagi: What ... ? Wh-Who are you?

text.Onlooking Student: What's up with him? What school's he from?

text.Spectacled Student: Never mind that, he's going for Yukiko-san? Man, you'd think he'd at least wait until she's alone to make his move ...

text.Onlooking Student: I bet you a can of TaP he gets knocked out.

text.Spectacled Student: No bet. Haven't you heard how difficult the Amagi Challenge is?

text.Mitsuo Kubo: Um, s-so ...  are you coming or not?

text.Yukiko Amagi: I-I'm not going ...

text.Mitsuo Kubo: ... Fine!

text.ACTION: Creepy fisheye bastard ran off.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/40-P4-00182.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: What did he want ... ? Obviously, he was asking you out on a date.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Huh? Really ... ?

text.Chie Satonaka: You had no clue? Sheesh ...
But then again, that was way over the top. It was creepy how he called you Yuki all of a sudden.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yo, Yukiko-san. Turned down another lovelorn fool, huh?
Man, you're cruel ...  You got me the same way last year.

text.Yukiko Amagi: I don't recall doing that.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Whoa, you serious? So then, you wanna hang out sometime!?

text.Yukiko Amagi: ... I'd rather not.

text.ACTION: Dude just cannot win.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/41-P4-00193.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Anyways, you two better not pick on the transfer student too much.

text.Chie Satonaka: We're just curious, is all!

text.Yukiko Amagi: U-Um, I'm sorry for dragging you into this ...

text.Chie Satonaka: C'mon, let's go. Everybody is staring.

text.ACTION: I explained to them how I'd ended up here in Inaba.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/42-P4-00198.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: There really is nothing here, huh?
That is what makes it nice, but there's nothing much we can show to people from outside.
Oh! Though, there is something from Mt. Yasogami ...  I think our dyed clothes or pottery or something is kinda famous.
Oh wait, there's the Amagi Inn! Yukiko's family runs it. It's the pride of Inaba!

text.Yukiko Amagi: Huh? It's ...  just an old inn.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh, no way, it's been in all sorta magazines as a hidden treasure.
It's a great inn! It's been going for generations, and Yukiko here is going to take over someday.
The inn actually attracts a lot of visitors to Inaba. It pretty much keeps this town going.

text.Yukiko Amagi: ... I don't think that's entirely true.

text.Chie Satonaka: So, tell me. You think Yukiko's cute, huh?

text.ACTION: It was sort of out of nowhere, and I panicked.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/43-P4-00209.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: I knew it!

text.Yukiko Amagi: Come on ...  Don't start this again ...

text.Chie Satonaka: She's really popular at school, but she's never had a boyfriend. Kinda weird, huh?

text.Yukiko Amagi: C-Come on, stop it.
Y-You shouldn't believe that, okay? It's not true that I'm popular or that I've never had a boyfriend!
Wait, no! Wh-What I meant to say was, I don't need a boyfriend!
Geez ...  Chie!

text.Chie Satonaka: Hahaha! Sorry, sorry. But this is our chance to talk to somebody from the big city, and you barely said a word!
Hey, what's that?

text.ACTION: The discussion was saved from going downhill by the worst possible circumstances.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/44-P4-00219.jpg

text.Spectator Housewife: Wow. Who could imagine THAT hanging from an antenna?

text.Shopping Housewife: I wanted to see it too.

text.Spectator Housewife: Uh, you got here too late ...  The police and fire department took it down just a moment ago.

text.Shopping Housewife: Well, I think it's terrifying. I can't believe a dead body showed up around here ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Wait ...  What did she just say? A dead body!?

text.ACTION: And of course Dojima was there.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/45-P4-00225.jpg
One thing was sure, I did not want to be mistaken for one of these ghouls wanting to see a dead body.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/46-P4-00226.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Huh ...  I should have figured that'd happen.
That damn principal. We told him not to let them through here ...

text.Chie Satonaka: ... You know this guy?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I'm Detective Dojima, his guardian. Uhh ...  Well, how should I say this ...  I hope you get along with him.
But you three really ought to stop wandering around and head straight home.

text.ACTION: It must have been a real mess, because this one cop came barreling out and threw up all over the place.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/48-P4-00232.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Adachi! How long are you going to act like a rookie? You want to be sent back to the central office!?

text.Tohru Adachi: I-I'm sorry ...  Nngh ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: (sigh) Go wash your face. We're gonna go around and gather information!

text.Chie Satonaka: Was this what that announcement was about ... ?

text.Yukiko Amagi: What do they mean ...  it was hanging from the antenna ... ?

text.Chie Satonaka: Hey, Yukiko ... ? Why don't we go to Junes some other time?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Good idea ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Alright then, we're taking off. Starting tomorrow, neighbor, let's do our best!

text.ACTION: The two of them left.
You decide to head straight home…
Nanako was alone in the house when I got there. The news explained exactly why.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/50-P4-00243.jpg

text.Announcer: Our top story this evening concerns a bizarre case in a quiet suburb.
Around noon today, a woman was found dead near the Samegawa River in Inaba.

text.ACTION: The School Zone is being shown on TV.
Could this be the incident you heard about…?
It was a real bombshell.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/51-P4-00248.jpg

text.Announcer: The initial results of the Inaba Police Department's investigation have revealed ...

text.Nanako: Ah! The Inaba Police Department! Th-That's where Dad works!

text.ACTION: She seemed really upset.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2002/52-P4-00252.jpg

text.Nanako: ... I know. That's his job, so this stuff happens.

text.Announcer: The body was found hanging from a large television antenna atop a local resident's roof.
Authorities are uncertain as to why the body was in such a state.
With the cause of death also uncertain, police continue to investigate whether the death is an accident or a homicide.
A thick fog common to the area has slowed their progress, and plans to fully canvas the area are delayed until tomorrow.

text.ACTION: It seems that the local TV station's announcer was found dead near the Yasogami High School campus…
The announcer, Mayumi Yamano…
Her affair with a local councilman's secretary had been on the news just the other day.

text.Nanako: They found her on the roof? That's scary ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It looks like we're in some kinda building, but ...  Damn, this fog's so thick, I can hardly see.

text.Chie Satonaka: Are you sure we're not wandering further away?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I can't be positive, but we've gotta trust our instinct a little.

text.Chie Satonaka: I know, but ...

text.ACTION: It seems that there's no choice for now but to continue onward…
We ended up in some creepy room. Looked sort of like a hotel room or something. You know, in hell.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/30-P4-00161.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: No service. What a surprise ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Can't you guys slow down a little? It's hard enough to see where you're going ...
Huh? What the ... !?
It's a dead end! There's no exit!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It keep getting creepier and creepier the further we go ...
Aargh! I can't hold it any longer ...
My bladder's gonna explode ... !

text.Chie Satonaka: Yosuke!? What're you doing!?

text.ACTION: I had to agree with Chie here.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/31-P4-00170.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: You're going here!? Oh, you have got to be kidding ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: T-Turn around! I can't go if everyone's watching!
Aaaaargh ...  I can't do it! It's all your fault if my bladder bursts!

text.Chie Satonaka: Like I care ...
Anyways ...  what's with this room?
Check out these posters ...  Their faces are all cut out ...
Somebody must really hate this person ...

text.ACTION: And it just got worse and worse.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/32-P4-00178.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It's tied in a noose ...  Is this a scarf?

text.Chie Satonaka: C'mon ...  Let's go back to where we came from, and look somewhere else for an exit ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey ...  I think I've seen that poster before ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Who CARES!? Let's go! I am sick of this place!
And I'm not feeling so good ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Now that you mention it, me too ...

text.ACTION: The fog in there is terrible.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/33-P4-00185.jpg
Could it be due to this place's oppressive atmosphere…?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Alright, let's go back. I'm seriously starting to feel sick ...

text.ACTION: And when we got back to the studio section, things managed to get even stranger.
VIDEO- "A Bear And A Crime"

text.Chie Satonaka: Wait ...  What's that ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Th-There's something over there!

text.ACTION: Something was indeed there.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/35-P4-00192.jpg
I don't know how to explain this. It was some kind of bear… thing.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/36-P4-00193.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: What is this thing? A monkey? A bear ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What in the world ... ?

text.ACTION: And it could talk.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/37-P4-00196.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: (gasp) It talked!
Uhh ...  What are you! Y-You wanna fight!?

text.Teddie: D-Don't yell at me like that ...

text.ACTION: The bear is cowering in fear…
Maybe it would be better to ask him nicely…
I figured we'd catch more bears with honey or something.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/39-P4-00202.jpg

text.Teddie: This place is what it is. It doesn't have a name.
It's where I live.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You ...  live here?

text.Teddie: If I was you guys, I'd hurry back to the other side.
Someone's been throwing people in here. It's a big headache.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh? Throwing people in? What're you talking about?

text.Teddie: I dunno who's doing it! I just want them to think before they go doing things like that!

text.ACTION: Chie was really not taking anything from the bear thing.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/40-P4-00210.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: What ARE you!? Where are we!?
What the heck's going on here!?

text.ACTION: By the way note to self: Honey attracts bears.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/41-P4-00213.jpg

text.Teddie: I already told you ...
A-Anyways, you should hurry back.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What it comes down to is, you want us to get outta here, right?
Well, so do we! We just don't know how, dammit!

text.Teddie: Urrrrgh! That's why I'm saying I'll let you out!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Like I keep saying, we don't know where the frickin' exit-
Wait ...  What?

text.ACTION: The bear did some weird tapping thing and boom, TVs out of nowhere.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/42-P4-00221.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What the hell!?

text.Chie Satonaka: Wh-Where did these TVs come from!?

text.Teddie: Okay, now go, go, get outta here! I'm a busy bear!

text.Chie Satonaka: What's going on now!? Whoa! Hey, what're you doing!?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: S-Stop pushing!

text.ACTION: The bear pushed us into the TVs, and the world swam again. We landed with a thud on a familiar floor…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/43-P4-00229.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Huh? Is this ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Did we ...  make it back?

text.Store Annoucement: Attention, shoppers. Our daily limited-time sale will now begin at the side dish area on the first floor.
Why not try the delicious, fresh produce Junes picked for you this morning as your side dish for dinner tonight?
All ages are invited to take advantage of this incredible bargain!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Crap, it's already that late!?

text.Chie Satonaka: Looks like we were in there for quite awhile ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: That's right ...
Now I remember where I saw that poster before ...
Look over there! That's the poster we saw!

text.Chie Satonaka: What's up now?

text.ACTION: Yosuke noticed something chilling.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/44-P4-00241.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: She's been all over the news lately.
Something about ...  her husband having an affair with that announcer lady who died the other day.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey, so does that mean ... ?
That weird room we saw ...  Could it be related to that Yamano lady's death ... ?
Now that I think about it ...  there was that creepy noose hanging from the ceiling ...
Yaaargh, stop! No more! We gotta stop talking about this.
I'm gonna wipe what happened today from my brain. I don't think my poor heart can take anymore.

text.Chie Satonaka: I'm feeling a chill too ...
Let's go home ...  I wanna lie down and rest.

text.ACTION: We stuck together as long as we could. The chill we felt had nothing to do with the rain.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/45-P4-00252.jpg
You still feel sluggish…

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Uh-Hmm ...  Well, I doubt you'd know ...
But have you heard anything about a student named Saki Konishi?

text.ACTION: I remembered Yosuke said he'd not seen her in school earlier.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/47-P4-00256.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Oh. I see ...
To be honest ...  we got a call from her family. She's disappeared.
We've got people looking for her, but she hasn't been found yet ...
(sigh) Work just keeps piling up ...

text.ACTION: And then the news started. More on that damn murder case.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/48-P4-00261.jpg

text.Announcer: Not long ago, television announcer Mayumi Yamano was found dead in the small town.
Up until now, her whereabouts prior to her death had been unknown.
But the police investigation has found that she had been staying in the region's famous Amagi Inn.

text.ACTION: The Amagi Inn… It's the inn that Yukiko's family runs…
Then things started to get kind of creepy in a new way honestly.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/49-P4-00266.jpg

text.Commentator: Oh yes, the Amagi Inn! Their hot springs are first-rate.
The manager's teenage daughter also works there, and it's rumored that she'll take over the inn this spring.
If that happens, she'll be one of the youngest managers on record! I should book another trip there!

text.Announcer: Uhh ...  I-I see ...  Moving along, it's time for the weather report.
The rain has begun to subside.
From now until morning, heavy fog warnings will be in effect in the Inaba region.
Visibility will be severely reduced, so please be careful if you plan on driving in the area ...

text.ACTION: The news continues.
Just before the announcer was found dead, she was apparently staying at the Amagi Inn, run by Yukiko's family…

text.Announcer: And it seems the whereabouts of Saki Konishi, who discovered the body, are unknown ...

text.ACTION: What the hell is going on?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2004/50-P4-00277.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Give it some more time.

text.ACTION: You sneezed.
You feel a slight chill…

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Are you sick? You're probably still adjusting to the new environment.
Nanako, could you get him some cold medicine?
You should get to bed right after you take it.

text.ACTION: So damn tired after going to that TV world… Anyway, all this will surely wait until the morning…
Part 5: 4/15/11 Part 1
There was another murder last night…
VIDEO- "Exit Saki"
I knew something must be up right from the moment I got up, Dojima was rushing out.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/2-P4-00006.jpg
Dojima left the house…

text.Nanako: ... Dad has to go do something. He got a call, so he left.

text.ACTION: Nanako looks worried…
Gossip was already starting even before people knew what was up.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/4-P4-00010.jpg

text.Red Umbrella Girl: When I looked, I saw three police cars zooming by.

text.White Umbrella Girl: You live by the police station, don't you? Did you hear anything?

text.Red Umbrella Girl: I heard yelling, but nothing more. Total disappointment.

text.White Umbrella Girl: Geez, you need to pay more attention to stuff like that. How else are we supposed to get the juicy stories?

text.ACTION: You hear sirens nearby…
It seems there's been an incident…
…You decide to head to school.
They called us all in for an assembly.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/5-P4-00020.jpg

text.Long-Haired Girl: Of course not ...  What, is that rumor for real?

text.Rumor-Loving Girl: I dunno, but it seems like a lot of people have seen it.

text.ACTION: You overhear people gossiping about something.

text.Chie Satonaka: Yukiko said she'd be here after lunch ...
I wonder why they're holding a school assembly all of a sudden.
... Hey, what's wrong, Yosuke?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, it's nothing ...

text.Kimiko Sofue: Everyone, please settle down. The school assembly is about to begin.
First, the Principal has something to say.

text.Principal: I ...  regret to say that I have a terrible announcement for all of you.

text.ACTION: It was worse than we ever could have imagined.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/8-P4-00031.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Passed away ... !?

text.Principal: Ms. Konishi was found deceased early this morning ...
The reasons behind her passing are currently under investigation by the police.
If they ask you for your cooperation, I urge you as students of this school to provide only the facts.
I have been assured by the faculty that there's been no evidence that bullying was involved in the incident.
So mind what you say, not only to the police but to anyone who asks ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Found dead ... ? How could this happen ... ?

text.ACTION: The Principal's address continues…
Old bastard's only concerned with covering his own ass. And nobody could stop talking about the damn details of her death.
VIDEO- "Yosuke's Resolve"

text.Girl's Friend: Well, last time, it was from an antenna, but this time she was hanging from a telephone pole.
It's gotta be a serial murder case ...

text.Rumor-Loving Girl: Someone said the cause of death was some unknown poison.

text.Girl's Friend: Unknown ... ? C'mon, this isn't some sci-fi drama.
Oh, by the way, did you hear? Someone saw a girl that looked like Saki on that Midnight Channel thingie.
They said she totally looked like she was in pain. Isn't that scary?

text.Rumor-Loving Girl: Haha, sounds like someone had a nightmare.
The media's been broadcasting their interviews with her nonstop, so maybe they just had Saki on the brain.

text.ACTION: People can be so ghoulish.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/10-P4-00054.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey ...  Did you guys check out the TV last night?

text.Chie Satonaka: Yosuke! Not you too!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Just listen for a sec! Something kept bothering me, so ...  I watched it again, and ...
I think the girl on the screen ...  was Saki-senpai.
There's no mistaking it ...
Senpai looked like ...  she was writing in pain ...
And then ...  she disappeared from the screen.

text.Chie Satonaka: What ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You heard Senpai's body was found in a similar situation as that announcer's, right ... ?
Well, remember that guy you told us about? How he was all excited that his soulmate was the announcer?

text.ACTION: It was about that point I figured out where Yosuke was going with this, and a chill ran down my spine.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/11-P4-00065.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Ms. Yamano might've been on that Midnight Channel before she died, too.

text.Chie Satonaka: What's that supposed to mean ... ?
Hold on ...  Are you saying ...
People who appear on that TV ...  die ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I can't say for sure.
But something tells me ...  I just can't dismiss it as coincidence.
Plus, remember what that bear thing said? How that place was dangerous, and we should leave before the fog clears ... ?
It also said that someone's been throwing people in there.
And that room with the posters on the wall ...  It has to have something to do with the announcer's death.
I mean ...  don't you think there's some kind of connection there?
Couldn't that world in the TV have something to do with Senpai and the announcer's death!?
Well ... ? What do you think ... ?

text.ACTION: At first I'd thought Yosuke was grasping at straws out of grief, but there was some definite sense to it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/12-P4-00079.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: ... So it's not just me, huh?
If there is a connection, then it's a good bet that the two of them went inside that world.
That would explain the posters in that room.
Which means ...  if we look around, we might find a place that has something to do with Senpai, too.

text.Chie Satonaka: Yosuke, don't tell me ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah ...  I'm thinking about going in again. I want to find out for myself.

text.Chie Satonaka: D-Don't do this ...  You should just let the police hand this and-

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You think we can rely on the police!? They haven't made any progress on the announcer's case.
Besides, even if we told them about the world inside the TV, there's no way they're gonna believe us!
If I'm completely off-base with this, that's fine ...
It's just ...  I need to know why Senpai had to die like this.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh, Yosuke ...

text.ACTION: He was right, though, if it was true that the death had something to do with the other world, the police were going to be useless.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/13-P4-00092.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Sorry ...  but you're the only person who can help me.
I'm gonna go get ready. I'll be waiting for you at Junes.

text.ACTION: Yosuke has asked you to take him into the TV world again…

text.Chie Satonaka: I can kinda understand how he feels ...
But we can't be sure we'll be able to get out safely again.
What should we do ... ?

text.ACTION: I was inclined to help him out, but I did want a second opinion.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/14-P4-00099.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: W-Wha? Huh? M-Me?
Uh ...  Anyways, let's go to Junes. We can't leave Yosuke alone ...

text.ACTION: We headed to Junes. Yosuke had made some 'preparations' in the mean time.
VIDEO- "The Promise"

text.Chie Satonaka: We came to stop you, idiot!
C'mon ...  You really shouldn't do this. It's too dangerous.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I know ...  But we were able to come back once, right?
If we go in from the same location, maybe we'll meet that bear again.

text.Chie Satonaka: "Maybe" isn't good enough!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Look, I can't just act like everyone else and pretend this has nothing to do with me.

text.Chie Satonaka: That's true, but ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What about you? Could you just walk away?

text.ACTION: I knew I couldn't, but Chie… I don't want to see someone else put in danger here.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/16-P4-00113.jpg
There's no telling what may happen over there…
You voiced your concern over Chie coming along.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, it'll be just you and me.
Don't worry, I'm not going in without a plan. Chie, I'm leaving you in charge of this.

text.Chie Satonaka: Huh? What's that? A rope ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: We'll go in with this tied to me, so I want you to hold on to this and wait here.

text.Chie Satonaka: Wh-What? Then, is this a lifeline? C'mon, wait a sec ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Here, Souji ...  This is for you.

text.ACTION: Yosuke handed me a golf club and some bandages and ointment he'd picked up.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/17-P4-00125.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Alright ...  Let's go. There's no use wasting any more time.
Chie, whatever you do, don't let go of the rope!

text.Chie Satonaka: H-Hey! I said wait!

text.ACTION: We stepped into the TV…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/18-P4-00129.jpg
Elsewhere…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/19-P4-00130.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/20-P4-00131.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/21-P4-00132.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/22-P4-00133.jpg
Once again we had a hard fall, and once again we encountered that bear.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/23-P4-00134.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Is this ... ?
Look, this is the same place as last time! So they are connected from place to place!

text.Teddie: Y-You guys ...  Why'd you come back ... ?
I get it! You're the ones behind this!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You're that thing from last time ... !
Wait, what the hell did you just say!?

text.Teddie: Lately, I can tell someone's been throwing people in here.
It's making this world more and more messed up ...
This is the second time you guys came here. And I don't think anyone forced you in.
That means you're the most suspicious!
You guys must be the ones throwing the people in here, raaaawr!

text.ACTION: What do you say when a bear is calling you a killer?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/25-P4-00146.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What're you talking about, "throwing people in"!?
If someone was thrown in here and they couldn't get out, they might die!
Who would do such a-
Wait a sec ...
All this talk about someone throwing people in here ...
Does he mean Senpai and the announcer?
Did that "someone" throw those two in here?
H-Hey ...  What do you think?

text.ACTION: I had to agree.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/26-P4-00155.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah ...  I agree.
Let's assume he's telling the truth ...
Could it be that someone's throwing people in here, intending to kill them ... ?
If that's the case ...

text.Teddie: What're you guys mumbling about? Why'd you come here, anyways!?
It's a one-way door! You can't get out once you're in!
Remember? How I had to let you guys out?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, whatever.
We don't need your help this time! See, this time we have a lifeli-

text.ACTION: That was when we noticed the line had broken as we entered.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/27-P4-00166.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: H-Hey! You better let us out once we're done investigating here!

text.Teddie: Grrrrr! I'm the one who wants to investigate!
I've lived here for a long time. But it's never been noisy like this till now.
Do you have proof!? Prove to me that you're not throwing people in here!

text.ACTION: How the hell were we supposed to prove that?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/28-P4-00171.jpg

text.Teddie: See! So it is you guys!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: For the last time, it's not us, so we've go nothing to prove to you!
Hey, you better answer our questions. This isn't like last time, when we came by accident. We're dead serious!
Listen up, 'cause people have died in our world ...  Every time the fog appears, a dead body shows up with it.
It has to be related to this place somehow! If you know something, tell us!

text.Teddie: A dead body? Whenever the fog appears ... ?
I know that if it's foggy on your side, the fog lifts here.
It's really dangerous when the fog lifts. That's when the Shadows get violent.
Aaaah ...  I get it ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh ... ? If you get it, then explain it to us, dammit!
If it's foggy on our side, it isn't in here ... ? Shadows get violent ... ?

text.Teddie: That's why I said to hurry back! It's dangerous when that happens!

text.ACTION: The bear was firmly convinced we were the killers.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/29-P4-00185.jpg

text.Teddie: I know you guys did it! You better stop right now!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I've told you and told you, we're not the ones doing it!
I've about had it with you ...  Why the hell won't you listen to what we're saying!?

text.Teddie: I-I'm just saying ...  you might be the culprits.
I'm just making sure ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What ... ? Man, this bear's driving me nuts ...
What is this place, anyways? It looks like a TV studio ...
Is something being filmed here ... ?
H-Hey, don't tell me ...  Is that weird show being filmed here!?

text.Teddie: Weird show? Filmed? What does that mean?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Uh ...  I'm asking if someone's been filming the people that get thrown in here.

text.Teddie: ...  ... ? I don't get it ...
This world has always been like this. No one has ever done that filming thing here.

text.ACTION: None of this made any damn sense.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/30-P4-00199.jpg

text.Teddie: Only me and Shadows are here! I told you before!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Ugh ...  We don't know what these Shadow things are! Or what you are either, for that matter!
You keep telling us to prove our innocence, but you're the most suspicious thing here!
Maybe you're the real culprit!
And what's with that stupid costume!? I'd say it's time you showed your face!

text.ACTION: Yosuke grabbed the bear's head…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/31-P4-00205.jpg
And pulled…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/32-P4-00206.jpg
What the hell…?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/33-P4-00207.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Wh-What the hell are you ... ?
I-It's empty inside ...

text.Teddie: Me ... ? The culprit ... ? I wouldn't do such a thing ...
I just live here ...
I just want to live here peacefully ...
Okay. I'll believe that you guys aren't the culprits.
But I want you to find the real guy who did all this. You have to stop him.
Promise me, or else ...

text.ACTION: He had a very effective threat.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/34-P4-00217.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Y-You little ... !

text.Teddie: This can't keep going on! My home here will be a complete mess!
And then ...  and then ...  I ...
Waaah ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Wh-What're you crying for all of a sudden?
Geez, this thing's really weirding me out ...

text.ACTION: The mysterious bear is asking you to find the culprit behind this…
Someone on the outside is throwing people into this world…
If the culprit isn't you, he wants you to find the real culprit…
The mysterious bear seems serious about this…

text.Yosuke Hanamura: (sigh) Hey, what should we do?

text.ACTION: Now it all made sense. That damn dream.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/35-P4-00229.jpg

text.Igor: It seems you will encounter a misfortune at your destination, and a great mystery will be imposed upon you ...

text.ACTION: Could this be the mystery that will be thrust upon you…?
What was the "contract" Igor spoke of…?
Could finding the culprit and solving the case be part of this promise…?
In any case, since you cannot leave the TV world on your own, there seems to be no other option…

text.Teddie: You're the only ones I can ask. Will you promise me ... ?

text.ACTION: Fate, destiny, whatever you call it. I didn't really buy into that shit before, but this was an awful coincidence.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/37-P4-00236.jpg

text.Teddie: Th-Thank you!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Damn bear ...  Practically holding a gun to our heads ...
But ...  it's true that we came here to figure things out. So far, we're completely in the dark.
Look for the culprit, huh ... ? Bring it on! You got my word, too.
Might as well introduce ourselves ...  I'm Yosuke Hanamura, and this is my buddy, Souji Seta.
You got a name?

text.ACTION: Should have seen this coming.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2005/38-P4-00243.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: (groan) Figures ...
But how are we supposed to find the culprit in the first place?

text.Teddie: I dunno ...
Oh, but I know where the last person came in.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: The last person ... ? You mean Saki-senpai!?

text.Teddie: I mean the person who came in and disappeared last time. I dunno the name.
I'll take you there. You might find clues.
Oh, one thing first. You two should put these on.
What're these classes for ... ?

Gameplay Notes: Battle Basics

Combat in Persona 4 is pretty simple. Character speeds set the turn order. The basic character options are to Attack with their equipped weapon, to Guard to reduce damage from the next hit they take, to use an Item, or to use a Skill from their Persona. The main character also has the ability to set Tactics in battle and change Personas, though those won't matter until we have a party and more Personas. Shadows in turn can also use a basic Attack, Guard, or a Skill. We can get an extra action in combat by knocking Down an enemy. This happens if we land a critical hit with a physical attack or strike a weakness of theirs. The same thing happens if the enemy strikes one of our weaknesses, though. These Slipping Hableries are weak against Lightning, so we're able to easily dispatch them. Once we've tried some attacks out on a target, we can Analyze them. This lets us see a record of what we've demonstrated to be the strengths and weaknesses of an enemy. That's all we really need to know about combat.
With this newfound strength, I managed to defeat the Shadows.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Shadow Yosuke

Shadow Yosuke is here to teach us about Guarding, one of the major new features in Persona 4. I mentioned before that we can Guard to reduce incoming damage. Well, it also lets us prevent ourselves being knocked down by our weakness. Shadow Yosuke is weak against our Zio skill but has a skill, Wind of Oblivion, that hits our weakness to wind. He's quite predictable luckily. He always goes in this sequence: Wind of Oblivion, Power Charge, Attack, Guard. What we want to do is always make sure we're Guarding against the Wind of Oblivion and the Power Charged Attack. So if he used Wind of Oblivion or Attack last turn, we can safely throw two Zios at him. If he used Power Charge, we'll Zio and then Guard, and if he Guarded we have to do so as well. That's all there is to it really. You have Medicines if you're really hurting, but you shouldn't need them on Normal.
Somehow I managed to prevail against it.

text.ACTION: Gameplay Notes:

At Daidara's Metalworks we can buy weapons, armor, and accessories. Things don't work quite the same way as the police department in Persona 3, though. New inventory isn't unlocked by time, it's unlocked by selling bits of Shadows collected in the TV world. What this means is that we can't really properly upgrade our equipment until after we've stepped foot into a new dungeon. There's a few more little wrinkles we'll see later on.
As we split up to change, I noticed something I'm sure wasn't there before.

text.ACTION: Gameplay Notes:

So let's hit the high points of Fusion. There are two main types of Fusion, Double and Triple. The resulting Persona is based on two things, the Arcana of the ingredient Personas and their base levels. The result Persona will inherit a number of skills from the ingredients. The more total skills among your ingredients, the more inherited skill slots you'll get. Once you're happy with the skills it's randomly selected you to inherit, you can start the fusion. If you've got a Social Link of the Arcanum in question, your Persona will gain extra experience, gaining at least one full level. That's the basics of fusion.

text.ACTION: Gameplay Notes:

Shuffle Time is back but in a slightly different form. Now there are only three types of cards- Blanks, Personas, and Penalties. Blanks obviously do nothing. Personas give us the opportunity to pick up the Persona on the card if we are high enough level and do not already have it. Penalties eliminate all of the rewards from the fight. Another new wrinkle is that instead of cards shuffled like three-card monte, we have to deal with cards that are continually moving. So instead of a memory check, it's really a timing check. Shuffle Time is your best source of fodder for fusion so it's important to get good at it.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Shadow Chie

Shadow Chie is another easy boss. She's got a Weakness to Wind (which makes her the last actual boss with any type of weakness, so cherish it) and is entirely vulnerable to being Downed by it (though she cannot be Dizzied). But if we open up with a Wind attack ...
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2009/24-P4-00183.jpg

And then she casts Green Wall, which will make her resist Wind instead of being weak to it for a few turns. Most of her offense comes in the form of nasty whipping Attacks, but she does have one other little trick up her sleeve. She'll spend one turn like this ...
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2009/25-P4-00185.jpg

And then casts Mazio. It's important that you have Yosuke guard through this, because Chie will do a nasty follow-up if she gets One More. As long as you don't fall victim to this, you should be able to blow through Shadow Chie almost as fast as you did Shadow Yosuke. text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Shadow Yukiko

And now the game has decided to stop playing the fuck around. Unlike the first two bosses, Shadow Yukiko has no weaknesses. She's totally immune to status effects, though she can be Downed by a crit. Her first turn is largely a wash, though you do want to be careful to have Chie guard so as not to let her get a One More right off the bat. When her second turn comes around, though ...
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/19-P4-00086.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/20-P4-00087.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/21-P4-00088.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/22-P4-00089.jpg

... She summons a Charming Prince. The Charming Prince is a particularly annoying little bastard. It will buff itself and Shadow Yukiko with Sukukaja, it has Diarama, it can do some pretty nasty physical damage with its Cleave attack, and it can inflict Fear. That last one is actually by far the most dangerous, because if someone is Feared when Shadow Yukiko's turn comes around she can use an attack on them called Shivering Rondo. Shivering Rondo pretty much kills whoever it hits instantly. The Prince has one key flaw, though, he's weak against Ice. He also gets Dizzied by any hit on him while he's Down. We can keep him locked down for half of his turns, then, by simply hitting him with a Bufu skill and then whacking him during the One More. Personally, I like killing the Charming Prince before even really starting on Shadow Yukiko. One thing to be careful about is that if Shadow Yukiko gets a One More while he's up, she'll sometimes cast White Wall on the Prince to temporarily negate his weakness. If you do kill the Prince ...
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/23-P4-00090.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/24-P4-00091.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/25-P4-00092.jpg

text.Shadow Yukiko Amagi: Why ...  Why won't he come ... ?

text.Teddie: No one's coming! Now's your chance to attack!

Things are pretty easy for the first half of Yukiko's health bar. She'll just stick to her Agi, Double Fangs, and sometimes normal Attacks. These are merely damaging. It's when she gets to the second half of her health bar that things start to get entertaining. You'll know when you get there for two reasons.

text.Shadow Yukiko Amagi: She'll always use Burn To Ashes right after she ticks over into this phase, and she'll start using it every few turns or so from now on. There's no predicting it, she'll just do it whenever. If she gets One More in this phase, she'll use Matarunda on the party to reduce your offense. Things get even worse once her health gets critical.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2011/28-P4-00099.jpg

text.Shadow Yukiko Amagi: You're no Princes ...  Die, you worthless commoners!

In the last bits of her health, she'll use Burn to Ashes even more often, and replace her Double Fang with Assault Dive. So how the hell do we deal with this? One common strategy uses a skill off of the Persona Slime, Red Wall. This can be used to negate Chie's Fire weakness. If this strategy has a weakness, it's the limited duration and relative expense of Red Wall. You'll really want to try and fuse it onto something other than Slime because Slime is himself weak to Fire. The strategy I use this time is to wear the Persona Senri, which is totally immune to Fire and can heal. This strategy's biggest weakness is that Senri has one of the lowest Endurance stats in the game, which makes you very vulnerable to Shadow Yukiko's physicals. Another strategy I like but didn't use this time is to get a Persona with Media (Valkyrie is a good source and indeed is a viable option). The group healing can really prove to be the difference between victory and defeat. If you're still having problems, you an always try to level up some more. The game expects you to be around level 15, if that's any help. Don't get discouraged, if you die a few times to this getting the hang of a real fight.

text.ACTION: Gameplay Notes:

So let's talk about another new little wrinkle to the battle system: Arcana Chance. After we get a blank or Persona card from Shuffle Time, we also have a chance to see another card appear. We see the Arcanum, and choose whether we want to accept it or not. If we accept it, the card then turns around and ends up either upright or reversed. In general if the card ends upright we get a positive effect and if it ends up reversed we get a negative effect. Arcana Chance can do really good things for you, and it can also really fuck you up. Be very careful when you accept them.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: That's right! That room with those faceless posters ...
Then ...  it's that announcer's ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Uh, well, kinda ...
Um ...  Did Ms. Yamano happen to have a scarf like this?

She actually ordered a pair, but in the end, she said she only wanted the women's scarf.
It left us with no choice but to sell this one separately.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: H-How should I know ... ?

text.ACTION: Just then a delivery came, and Mrs. Tatsumi had to leave.

text.Textile Shop Owner: Oh, I'll be right there. I'm sorry, you'll have to excuse me.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh, it's okay. We should get going.

text.Yukiko Amagi: I'll come again, Ma'am.

text.Textile Shop Owner: Is that so? Well, then please say hello to your mother for me.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It really is connected to the first case after all ...

Dammit, what's going on ... ?
C'mon, let's talk outside.

text.ACTION: We stepped outside and got a surprise.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2017/32-P4-00202.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Wha-Quick, hide!

text.ACTION: Kanji was talking with the boy from earlier.

text.ACTION: You eavesdropped on Kanji's conversation with the boy…

Huh? S-School? 'Course I'm going to school ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: D-Did he was he was interested ... ?
He's a guy ...  and I'm a guy ...  But ...  he's interested in me ... ?

text.ACTION: At that point Kanji noticed us. I mean we weren't exactly hiding so much, not a surprise.

If you think about it, my mother fit the victim profile more than I did.
She was the one who dealt directly with Ms. Yamano ...  but I was the one who was targeted.

text.Chie Satonaka: Does that mean it'll be the kid again, instead of the mother?
But if that's true, then the killer's motive makes no sense at all.
It'd have nothing to do with silencing witnesses or revenge or anything.

text.ACTION: Chie makes some scary good points sometimes.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2017/37-P4-00227.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Or is there some kinda secret in the textile shop itself ... ?

text.Yukiko Amagi: But we can't ignore this.

We could at least see if anything odd's happened lately. He scares the wits out of me, but ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey, wasn't Kanji making plans with that weird kid a moment ago?
Something about meeting up at school.
I heard he's been skipping school ever since the new year started ...  Doesn't that see a little suspicious?

text.Chie Satonaka: Yeah, something did seem weird.
Yeah, it's suspicious all right. There's something funny going on here ...  I can sense it.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: "Sense"? You sound like Teddie ...  Still, we might find some clues.
Alright ...  Let's try staking out both Kanji and his family's store.

Target arrived in-zone near the end of his mess break, with mother-issued rations in hand.

So... shall we?

What in the world was that...?

If only we'd held our ground and stayed there a little longer...
(sigh)
In any case, that place that was behind him... What do you think it is?

Anyways... We'd better hurry and come up with a plan tomorrow!

text.ACTION: ...You decided to go to bed.
It sucks how close we must have gotten to the killer. But all we can do now is try to save Kanji. We'll start tomorrow...

If this rumor spreads and everyone starts watching the Midnight Channel...

Oh, that is IT! That killer is dead meat! I'm gonna leave footprints all over his face!
Guys!
First we save Kanji! Then, we crush the killer!

Boss Battle: Contrarian King
Okay so this guy is much harder than you'd expect him to be. He's only got two real moves, Hysterical Slap and Rampage.
Hysterical Slap does a decent amount of damage to one target, and Rampage does massive damage to everyone. You are very likely to be
killed by Rampage if you're not around level 20 or so. He pulls a damn dirty trick at the start by casting Red Wall, which makes you
think he'll be weak to Fire. He actually Drains Fire, though. Having resistance to Physical helps, as does having a decent amount of
group healing and just in general being high enough level not to get gibbed by Rampage. The reward is a Courage boost and an awesome
weapon for Yukiko that gives her +50 SP so it's very worth doing this fight once you're high enough.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Shadow Kanji

We're up against Shadow Kanji and his two buddies, the Nice Guy and the Tough Guy. In the first phase of the fight, Shadow Kanji's only abilities are Swift Strike, Fatal End, and Power Charge. Normally he'll just alternate between Power Charges and Swift Strikes, it's actually sort of rare for him to use Fatal End or a Swift Strike without a Charge. He's not weak against anything, and is immune to lightning. The Tough Guy uses a mix of largely ineffectual physical skills and is actually really hard to kill, so we'll just ignore him. The Nice Guy uses a lot of buffs, including Heat Riser (+Offense/Defense/Agility), which is needless to say really annoying. Our strategy for the start of the fight, then, is to kill the Nice Guy while keeping the enemy party's buffs clear with Yosuke's Dekaja every few turns (or just in general if Kanji's both Charged and Heat Risered, that is sort of dangerous). Once the Nice Guy is down, we can move on to Kanji. When his health gets to about 2/3 max, he'll telegraph his first phase change by saying this:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2022/30-P4-00181.jpg

In this phase he gains the skill Forbidden Murmur, which he'll always use that turn. This skill attempts to poison your whole party, so hopefully you brought some Dokudami Tea to cure it. At about 50% Kanji will start mixing his moves up a bit more, which is telegraphed by this taunt.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2022/31-P4-00183.jpg
Things don't get really exciting until he's at about a third of his health, though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2022/32-P4-00184.jpg

text.Shadow Kanji Tatsumi: No matter what, I won't lose!

At this point he will always cast a special lightning skill, Fanatical Spark, and he'll start using it quite heavily from this point on. If he manages to knock down Yosuke with this, he'll spend his One More on a Fatal End usually.

So, there's a rather obvious way to make this fight a lot easier for you, which is to bring a Persona that resists Physical attacks. I generally use Rakshasa for this, because it's Strength Arcana (which should mean it gets a lot of bonus exp on fusion even this early) and it gets Kill Rush, which is broken as fuck (watch the video if you want to see exactly why). The thing to remember is that Kanji's offense and defense aren't that impressive when he's not buffed. You can blast through that last 33% where he gets dangerous pretty damn quickly if you go all-out. I suggest you be about level 24 or so for this, which isn't hard at all if you don't duck out of fights in the Sauna.

VIDEO- "Intolerant Officer"
Boss Battle: Intolerant Officer

This fight's not so brutal as the Contrarian King, but it is trickier. The Intolerant Officer uses a mix of single target physicals, Bufula, and Garula. The hard part is that his AI is actually pretty smart, and will go for anyone who is weak to one of his attacks. So our party is going to be Souji, Yosuke, Chie, and whichever of the others we'd rather get the exp on. That person's going to be guarding the whole time, so it really doesn't matter who it is. My personal choice of Persona for this fight is Titania, because she gets Diarama and nulls Ice. As long as he's not getting lots of One Mores and hitting weaknesses he's pretty reasonable.

There was a thick Iron Plate on the ground, which reminded me of the folding chair Kanji's been hitting things with up until now so I picked it up and brought it out to him. He was pretty excited. After all that we were pretty tired, so we called it a day.
