text.Yukiko Amagi: Once it starts, it'll be raining every night. We'll have to keep a constant eye on the Midnight Channel.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Crap, I didn't even think of that ...  Well, so it goes.
Hehe, I thought you were worried about the rain 'cause of the school campout.

text.Chie Satonaka: Why are you so excited about that?

text.Yukiko Amagi: That's right, it's the first time for you two ...

text.Chie Satonaka: You realize the only purpose of the school campout is to "develop a love for one's hometown in young people," right?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, they tell us that up front. So?

text.Chie Satonaka: Well you see, the way we supposedly develop that love is by picking up trash of the mountain.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: P-Picking up trash? "Develop a love" my ass! That's slave labor!

text.Chie Satonaka: Well, the night's kinda fun. We cook our own meals with mess kits and sleep in tents.

text.Yukiko Amagi: The four of us are in the same group.

text.ACTION: Poor Yosuke still had some hope that this wasn't going to be absolutely terrible.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/27-P4-00145.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: You wish! Guys and girls sleep in different tents!
I'm warning ya ...  If you leave your tent at night, you'll be expelled on the spot.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Ugh ...  This gets worse and worse. I thought it was gonna be fun ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: It's only for one night and we disband before noon the next day. It doesn't last very long.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh ...  We did have some fun at the river before going home last year.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Do they let you go swimming?

text.Chie Satonaka: I think so? There's always someone who takes a dip, although we didn't.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I see ...  So you can swim in the river ...

text.ACTION: Yosuke looked very thoughtful after that. God only knows what he's up to. Anyway, it was raining pretty heavily so I stopped by Junes to dry out and ran into Dojima's partner.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/28-P4-00154.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Uhhh, well, I was buying a toy, and this magic set was on sale, you see.
It was so cheap, I couldn't resist! You know how it is.

text.ACTION: Good to know we've got such dedicated officers on the case. I grabbed an Aiya bowl to try to combat my crippling depression and then went home. I decided to see what Nanako was up to.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/30-P4-00157.jpg
Just then we got a call.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/31-P4-00159.jpg

text.Nanako: I need to get dinner ready.

text.ACTION: Nanako is in high spirits.
I figured as long as we went together it'd be okay for us to go get some.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/32-P4-00168.jpg
Nanako looks really happy.
Nanako looks happy…
You feel Nanako's affection for you, and that your relationship with her has grown deeper…
I mean the killer's not after either of us.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/33-P4-00175.jpg
You went to Junes with Nanako.
A while later, at the house…
Dojima was already home when we got back.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/34-P4-00181.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Where did you go at this time of night?
Didn't I tell you not to go outside this late?

text.Nanako: B-But, you were coming home ...  so I ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: No matter what your reason was, rules are rules. You promised me, remember?

text.ACTION: Nanako looks sad…
It really was my fault, though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/35-P4-00191.jpg
Nanako looks relieved.

text.Nanako: ... It's not my fault? Then why is Dad angry ... ?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Nanako! How dare you call your father stupid!!

text.ACTION: You explained to Dojima why you went with Nanako to Junes…

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Pickled radish ...  for me ... ?
... Is that so.
But I still can't allow kids to be walking around this late at night.
You know how dangerous it's been lately. You shouldn't be wandering around out there at night either!

text.ACTION: Dojima yelled at you, too…
You decided to go back to your room.
Yeah won't do that again.

Not much happened today, played some soccer, talked to Nanako, worried about who might appear on the Midnight Channel next. Nobody's been on the news, though, so I guess the killer doesn't have a target yet.
Yukiko called me up, she wanted me to try some of the food she'd been cooking.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/36-P4-00218.jpg
Yukiko handed you a hand-made boxed lunch…

text.Yukiko Amagi: It came out well, so I packed it up. Try it out.

text.ACTION: It looks normal…
For some reason, an unusually pungent smell hangs in the air…
I tried to at least act enthusiastic.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/37-P4-00224.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Go ahead!

text.ACTION: Yukiko is looking at you expectantly…
It seems you have no choice but to eat it…
You started with the… omelette-looking… thing…
It's actually soft…
There's something too hard to bite on inside…
And it smells burnt, yet raw…
You worry that your body will reject the foreign matter…
You were finally able to swallow it…

text.Yukiko Amagi: ... You're not about to tell me how delicious that was, are you?

text.ACTION: Yukiko looks sad…
I mean Rome wasn't built in a day.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/38-P4-00239.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: I-I suppose ...  Thank you.

text.ACTION: Yukiko seems relieved…
Nanako had gone out for something and came by just then.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/39-P4-00242.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Ah, Nanako-chan ...  Well, I was just having him try my boxed lunch ...
I-I'm sorry, but I can't give you any. It's not good ...

text.Nanako: Oh. If you make a good one, will you let me have some?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Huh ... ? S-Sure, if you want ...
Nanako-chan ...
Thank you. I'll do my best, okay?

text.Nanako: I'm going to Mai-chan's house. By!

text.Yukiko Amagi: Be careful.
Umm ...  I'm sorry to drag you around ...

text.ACTION: Even with the food this wasn't a bad time.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/40-P4-00255.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: R-Really? I'm glad to hear that ...

text.ACTION: Yukiko seems relieved…
You can sense that Yukiko is relying on you…
You feel your relationship has grown deeper…
She just needs more practice. A lot more.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/41-P4-00260.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Only about a year left, huh ... ?
I need to be able to do anything on my own by then ...

text.ACTION: You handed Yukiko the rest of the boxed lunch and went home.
I guess Nanako had gone to Junes because there was enough food for me to cook some lunch.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/42-P4-00270.jpg
You have the ingredients to make potato salad.
You decided to make potato salad.
What should you do after boiling the potatoes?
Easy.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/43-P4-00275.jpg
You added ham, onions, and other ingredients after smashing the potatoes.
Obtained Tasty Potato Salad.
…In addition, you made Bait x 3 from the leftovers.
I should do this more often.
I heard a sort of heartening thing this morning on the way in to school.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/44-P4-00279.jpg

text.Dark-Haired Girl: Ah, it's finally time to break out the summer wardrobe.

text.Athletic Girl: I hope it's not going to get cold again with all this rain ...

text.Dark-Haired Girl: I don't think we'll have to worry about that this year.
I heard there's going to be less rain than there was last year.

text.ACTION: After yesterday I decided to treat Yukiko to my own cooking.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/45-P4-00287.jpg
You ate lunch with Yukiko.
You ate Tasty Potato Salad together.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Oh, it's really good! Did you make this on your own, Souji-kun?
The flavor is excellent, and the presentation is great, too ...  Do you want to work as a chef at our place?
I'm just kidding ...
... Though you'd be more than welcome if you wanted to ...

text.ACTION: It was Yukiko's favorite!
After lunch we had P.E., and Mr. Kondo tried to trip me up again.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/46-P4-00296.jpg

text.Mr. Kondo: June in Japan can be pretty tiring, thanks to all the humidity and heat!
But don't waste your days away with laziness! Summer is very near, my friends!
You wouldn't want that special someone to see you being lazy, would you?
So today, let's do 30 reps of the 100 meter dash! Running keeps the body and mind from rotting away!
... What's with that sourpuss face, Souji? Do you want it to freeze like that?
Okay, okay, how 'bout this? If you get this question right, I'll cut it down to five!
What kind of exercise is a sprint classified as?

text.ACTION: This was a sort of tricky one honestly but he can't defeat my mastery of the trivial.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/47-P4-00304.jpg

text.Mr. Kondo: Ugh ... ! So you knew! I didn't think you were that informed about athletics, Souji!
Well, a promise is a promise! I'll make it five instead of 30!
But I only promised Souji! Hahaha! Everyone else, you have ten reps, got it!? Get ready!

text.ACTION: That kid was back on the floodplain, so I gave him that sticker Nanako gave to me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2027/48-P4-00311.jpg

text.Lonely Boy: I can't come up with anything ...

text.ACTION: The boy is looking around for a rare sticker that is popular among kids.

text.Lonely Boy: ... A Tankiriman Sticker?
Wow, thank you!
This is cool-looking, so I'm sure they'll let me play after I show them this!

text.ACTION: The boy ran off cheerfully.
Will he make lots of friends…? You should ask him another time.
Another crappy rainy day.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/1-P4-00001.jpg

text.Guy With A Backpack: The school camp starts next weekend, doesn't it?

text.Lazy Student: Ah, right ...
It's gonna be all work. I'm not gonna have any fun at all.
Ah, there has to be some way I can ditch this stupid camp!
Alright, let's get together and brainstorm ideas on how to get out of this!

text.ACTION: I went to drama again since the weather was so terrible. Yumi was missing again, so I headed out to the hospital to see if she was there.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/2-P4-00013.jpg
Yumi is standing at the door…

text.Yumi Ozawa: Souji-kun ...
... I just came from Dad's-that man's room ...

text.ACTION: I'd remembered her mom wasn't doing well either.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/4-P4-00017.jpg

text.Yumi Ozawa: It was nothing. She's already out of the hospital ...

text.ACTION: Yumi smiles, relieved.

text.Yumi Ozawa: I was here anyway ...  I came here to pick up some medicine for Mom. I just decided to stop by.
He looked at me, and he smiled like he was so happy ...
"Do you want to watch TV?" "If you want to read some manga, go ahead and buy some." "Here's some money for ice cream."
He's so stupid ...
Getting all excited ...  Coughing ...  Causing trouble for the doctors ...
He's so stupid ...
That man is not my father. I keep telling myself that over and over, and yet ...
I can't take it anymore ...
Why me ...  Why me, why me!?

text.Nurse: Excuse me, can you keep your voice down, please?

text.Yumi Ozawa: Oh ...  I'm sorry ...
I'm sorry ...  I just lost control for a moment ...
... Why do I have to go through all of this? Why me!?

text.ACTION: This is all pretty terrible, really.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/5-P4-00034.jpg

text.Yumi Ozawa: I see ...  Then do you think that one day, good luck will come my way ... ?
Or are people who have bad luck doomed to stay unlucky forever?

text.ACTION: Yumi smiles sadly…

text.Yumi Ozawa: Oh ...  I have to go. I need to get this medicine to my mom.
Um ...  I'm glad you came.

text.ACTION: It seems you were able to give Yumi some emotional support.
You feel your relationship with Yumi has deepened…
I hope she does manage to see some good luck soon, nobody deserves what's happening to her.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/6-P4-00042.jpg

text.Yumi Ozawa: ... I'll see you at school.

text.ACTION: You watched Yumi walk off sadly.
Nanako watches so much TV, I decided to show her a neat trick I'd learned.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/7-P4-00047.jpg

text.Nanako: ... If you want, you can change the channel.

text.ACTION: Nanako looks bored…
You might as well try a magic trick…
Nanako is watching curiously…
…You decide to show her a magic trick.
You put the rubber band on your index finger and middle finger…
You also hook it on the ring finger and pinky without Nanako noticing…
When you open up the hand you had closed lightly…
The rubber band springs off the index and middle finger, instantly moving over to the ring finger and pinky!
…Nanako saw part of the trick.

text.Nanako: I saw it! It went like, zoom!
Do it again! One more time!

text.ACTION: She seems delighted anyway.
Nanako is laughing cheerfully.
…The night continues.
I'm glad she enjoyed it, I'll have to come up with another one sometime.
Morooka continues to reinforce why he's the worst person in all of Inaba.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/9-P4-00065.jpg

text.Kinshiro Morooka: It's going to be a place of education to wind up the lazy ass minds you get from screwing around all the time.
You know, you all depend on other people too much! That's why you jerk-offs have all this spare time!
"Oh, he'll do it someday," or "She's doing it for me," I bet that's all you think about!
Let's take a closer look at it, shall we? What's the root of the word "pend"? Hanamura! Stop smiling and answer!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: First of all, how could I be smiling in this class ... ? And second, this has nothing to do with logic ...
"Pend," eh? Words with "pend" in them ...  Uh ...
I have no clue ...  Souji, help me out here?

text.ACTION: Morooka is a real bastard by the way.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/12-P4-00074.jpg

text.Kinshiro Morooka: Ahh, pretty good, Hanamura ...  Or should I be praising Seta?
You're right. The root word "pend" means "to hang."
Like Hanamura was too tongue-tied to explain, words like "pendant" and "pendulum" are good examples!
Those girls who got murdered were fooling around and depending on others, and that's what got them killed!
Unless you want to end up the same, make sure you don't depend too much on others!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: ... That was evil. How could he say that ... ?
... Thanks, Souji. He'd probably have stabbed me to death with his words if I hadn't "depended" on you ...

text.ACTION: At lunch I ran into Ai again, she felt like skipping school and after that shit with Morooka I had to agree.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/13-P4-00086.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: Hey, you wanna ditch class? Don't worry, we'll be back before the last bell.
Really ...  Alright, then meet me at the shoe lockers.

text.ACTION: You accepted Ai's invitation and decided to skip afternoon classes.
We took the train to Okina.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/16-P4-00091.jpg
Ai has dragged you here…

text.Ai Ebihara: Mmmm! Feels so good.
Just knowing everyone else is still stuck at school studying makes it feel great to be out here.

text.ACTION: Again after that Morooka shit I'm down with skipping.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/17-P4-00095.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: You think so? I'm surprised you're so open-minded.
I had you pegged for a mama's boy.
It's not like I do this all the time.
Besides, since they started keeping track of my attendance and behavior record, I've been a good girl.
Well, enough small talk. Let's go.
We'll start with clothes, then we'll hit jewelry and shoes, and maybe some cell phone stuff if there's enough time.

text.ACTION: Ai only seems to be concerned about her own shopping…
Still beats school.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/18-P4-00103.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: Of course you will. Why else would you be here?
Anyway, time's a'wasting.
It's nice to have a personal servant! I can buy so much more this way.

text.ACTION: Ai paid for everything with a gold card…
It seems Ai is loaded.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/19-P4-00108.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: Well, I guess you could call my family "new money."
We may not have status or history, but we do have money. My daddy made a fortune in land speculation.
We'd better get going, though, or we won't make it back before class ends.
Soon as school gets out, I'm number one on the guidance counselor's list.
He has to check on my attendance and behavior, and sometimes, he tops it off with a lecture. It's a major pain.
But I'm out here having fun, and all the teachers are totally clueless. How stupid can they be?
You know what, though? I had more fun today than usual.
You're different from the others. I like you.
I think I'll keep you around. But next time, let's go after school.

text.ACTION: You have become acquaintances with the sports team manager, Ai Ebihara.
You feel a faint bond forming between you and Ai…
So far Ai seems like pretty much the only normal person I've got one of these with and there's something to be said for that.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/20-P4-00120.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: Are you coming!? Or maybe you'd like to be a blip on the guidance counselor's radar yourself?

text.ACTION: You returned to school with Ai and snuck into your class…
I decided to check up on that kid I gave the sticker.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/21-P4-00195.jpg

text.Lonely Boy: Y'know the sticker you gave me? Everyone already knew about it ...
But I did make friends!
I talked to them every time I got a new sticker, and they just kinda became my friends!
It's thanks to you! Oh, and also the fox.
I wrote my wish at the shrine. They said a fox grants wishes there.
I'll go say thanks to the fox later!

text.ACTION: You accomplished the request written on the ema!
You should report back to the fox…
I went to soccer practice, but Daisuke had a thing to do after and had to run.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/22-P4-00129.jpg

text.Daisuke Nagase: Ah ...  Perfect timing.
Later.

text.Kou Ichijo: Hm? What's up with the cold shoulder? Daisuke can be such a damn rebel.
Oh well, I guess that makes it easier. I need to talk to you.
Tell you what, we'll talk over map rice. My treat!

text.ACTION: Again never say no to free stuff.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/25-P4-00136.jpg

text.Kou Ichijo: Great! Heck, I'll get you a large!

text.ACTION: Kou looks happy…
You left school to listen to what Kou has to say.
I wondered what we needed to straight leave the grounds to talk about.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/26-P4-00141.jpg

text.Kou Ichijo: You probably guessed this, but it's about Daisuke.

text.ACTION: Kou speaks with a serious expression…

text.Kou Ichijo: You've noticed him slacking off at practice a lot lately, right?
He never used to do that kind of stuff ...
Before, he woulda died for any chance to play soccer.
You practically had to pry the ball away from him, even off the field.
But now he's half-assing everything ...
I don't get it. Maybe he just doesn't think playing hard is "cool" anymore ...
He took it seriously when he was helping you train, though, right?
He really wanted you to get good enough for the team to accept you ...
Don't get me wrong, I don't think he was faking it or anything ...
But ...  I wonder if part of that was him trying to make you do the things he feels like he can't anymore ...
... He's fooling himself.
It just pisses me off to watch him do this ...

text.ACTION: Kou sighs…
Kou was pretty worried.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/27-P4-00157.jpg

text.Kou Ichijo: Ya know, his new attitude toward girls is pretty sudden, too.
He used to talk about girls like any normal guy would.
You think it could be related ... ?

text.ACTION: Seemed as good a theory as any.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/28-P4-00161.jpg

text.Kou Ichijo: You think so too?

text.ACTION: Kou nods…

text.Kou Ichijo: He can be a little blunt sometimes, but he's a nice guy.
He's been acting so cold toward girls, though, like he's saying stuff that he doesn't really mean ...
I'm only telling you this because I trust you, but ...

text.ACTION: Kou begins to speak slowly…

text.Kou Ichijo: See, Daisuke had a girlfriend back in middle school ...
But from what he told me, they never even held hands.
Then she broke up with him.
She made a big scene. She was all like, "You don't even like me, do you!?" I heard she even slapped him.
And ever since then, he's been saying stuff like, "I don't know what it means to like someone ... "
At the rate he's going, he's gonna die an old hermit.

text.ACTION: Kou sighs…

text.Kou Ichijo: What do you think?

text.ACTION: Daisuke's my friend, if there's some way I can help him I've gotta do it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/29-P4-00178.jpg

text.Kou Ichijo: Yeah, I think so too.

text.ACTION: Kou nods.

text.Kou Ichijo: Whoa!
I just had a great idea. I'm a genius ...
You're with me on this, right? You're gonna help him?

text.ACTION: Kou is looking at you expectantly…

text.Kou Ichijo: Alright! Now we're talking!

text.ACTION: Kou is ecstatic…
By worrying about Daisuke with Kou, you feel your bonds strengthen.
I wonder what his plan is though…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/30-P4-00189.jpg

text.Kou Ichijo: I'll set everything up. Make sure you wear some clean boxers!

text.ACTION: You passed the time with a rather vulgar conversation…
The campout's almost here, I just hope it's not as bad as Chie and Yukiko are saying it'll be.
So we decided to head to Junes to get some food for the campout.
VIDEO- "The Looming Terror"

text.Yukiko Amagi: School camp starts tomorrow.
We'll be in the same group, but what should we be cooking for dinner?
Hey, why don't we get everyone and go buy ingredients after school?
Okay.
I'll be sure to let Chie and Yosuke-kun know, then.

text.ACTION: Yosuke said he had a thing to do on a different floor when we got to Junes. Yukiko and Chie were insisting on cooking so I left it to them.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/33-P4-00215.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Carrots, potatoes, onions ...  mushrooms, green peppers, and ...  radishes?

text.Chie Satonaka: Are radishes ...  the same as turnips?

text.ACTION: They're apparently going to make curry.

text.Chie Satonaka: Curry's fine, right? It's practically our national food.

text.Yukiko Amagi: We were going back and forth between ramen and curry, but I thought ramen might not be enough for you guys.

text.Chie Satonaka: Hmm, I wonder what kind of ingredients Yosuke likes ...  I get the feeling he's real picky.

text.Yukiko Amagi: He's on another floor, isn't he? Do you want me to go ask?

text.Chie Satonaka: Nah, no need. Plus, he said he needed to get ready for something.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Hey, Chie. You use potato starch for curry, right?

text.Chie Satonaka: ...  ... ? O-Of course you do.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Otherwise, the sauce wouldn't thicken.
Then, we need potato starch and ...  some flour, too?

text.Chie Satonaka: Th, there are different kinds of flour ...  Which should we get? All-purpose? Whole wheat?

text.ACTION: You know I'd been hoping maybe Chie knew what she was doing because I already know Yukiko does not. That did not seem to be the case.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/35-P4-00231.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Let's get that one. And ...  here they are!
Chili peppers! It's not curry if it isn't spicy.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh well ...  Let's just get everything that seems right.
How about some kimchi, too? And some ground pepper!

text.Yukiko Amagi: There's two kinds, though. Black and white.

text.Chie Satonaka: Whoa! Way to go, Yukiko ...  The Amagi family sure knows their stuff! Let's get both, just in case.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Oh yeah ...  We'll need some special ingredients, too, to spice things up.

text.Chie Satonaka: Hmm, I remember seeing something on TV about that ...  I think it was ...  chocolate ...  coffee ...  yogurt ...
How about mint chocolate!? I love that stuff!
I don't like coffee that much, though ...  Oh, I can drink mocha, so let's get that.

text.Yukiko Amagi: What about some seafood? That should make the sauce taste better.

text.ACTION: So we're all going to die. I went to work at the hospital again, since I'm sure getting in with them is going to be important after I eat whatever they're going to make.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/36-P4-00249.jpg

text.Sayoko Uehara: Oh, you sweet thing. Well, then ...
Would you like to study with me? Perhaps a subject they don't teach in school, if you catch my drift ... ?

text.ACTION: Seriously what is the deal with this nurse?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/38-P4-00254.jpg

text.Sayoko Uehara: Oho ...  You're an honest guy. That's cute, in boys your age.

text.ACTION: Sayoko smirks at you.

text.Sayoko Uehara: I don't find your type around here.
The kids over here are much simpler. All they see is the carrot dangling in front of their faces ...
You're ...  I know. You seem to have some sort of secret deep inside you ...
... I think it's irresistible.

text.ACTION: Sayoko smiles in satisfaction.
You can feel Sayoko's mischievous affection for you…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2028/39-P4-00263.jpg

text.Sayoko Uehara: I'll see you again.

text.ACTION: The campout is tomorrow. I just hope things aren't so bad as I'm worrying.

How best to sum up the school campout? In a word, harrowing. It turned out all the trash-picking was the highlight of our time on the mountain. When we were done Yukiko and Chie started making what they said was going to be curry.
VIDEO- "Mystery Food X"

text.Yosuke Hanamura: But man, seeing you here kinda reminds me of the school campout.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I thought we were all gonna forget about what happened ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh ...  Sorry.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: (sigh) Eh, whatever.
So hey, you guys see the news?

text.Chie Satonaka: News ... ? Oh, that stuff about Rise Kujikawa taking a break from showbiz?
I wonder why. She was just getting popular lately ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Just goes to prove that being an idol is tough work.

text.ACTION: It's pretty surprising I have to say because Rise really seemed like a natural.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/18-P4-00100.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You think so too?
It hasn't been that long since her debut, but at this rate, she'll be a top-class idol in no time.
To be honest, I'm a fan, too! She's such a cutie pie!

text.Chie Satonaka: A cutie pie ... ? What are you, 80?
But I think she used to live here, so she must have a lot of local fans.

text.Yukiko Amagi: The news said she's going to her grandmother's tofu shop, right?
Do they mean Marukyu ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Marukyu?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Marukyu Tofu. Our inn was serving their tofu until recently.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, that place in the shopping district! I pass by it all the time.
Wait, does that mean I can meet Rise if I go to her tofu shop!?

text.ACTION: Aces.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/20-P4-00112.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Hey, aren't we getting a little sidetracked from the point here?
Wait, did you forget about the murders!? You're the one who said the connection between the victims might be the TV!
She could be the next target!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: C'mon, it's not like Rise started showing up on TV just recently.
Also, how could Rise be connected to the incidents so far?

text.Yukiko Amagi: I wondered the same thing, so I did some research.
It seems that she had no personal interaction with Ms. Yamano.
They've just been on the same show once or twice.

text.Chie Satonaka: She's been an idol for a while now, but she's the talk of the town, thanks to the news last night.
And she is moving here, after all.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: So, if our assumptions are correct, she fits the pattern ...  She'll probably be targeted next.
And if she is, that narrows down the killer's methods even further.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: What's that supposed to mean?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: (sigh) Kanji-kun, listen real carefully ...

text.ACTION: I think Kanji's not really been listening when we've been talking about this.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/21-P4-00128.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: And that means the killer's targets are people who've been shown on TV recently. Get it now?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh. Ohhh ...  Yeah, okay.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Alright, now we have to keep a close eye on everything Rise does!
Let's do it!

text.Chie Satonaka: Sheesh, he's all pumped up ...

text.ACTION: The teachers had heard the news too, and some of them seemed a bit bitter honestly.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/22-P4-00134.jpg

text.Mrs. Nakayama: So, I've heard all the gossip going around about Rise Kujikawa. Those idols don't have "normal people" problems.
They'll have money, they'll never have to compromise in marriage ...  (sigh) What should I make for dinner tonight?
Just so you know, being an adult isn't all fun and games. It sucks.
Taxes, marriage, kids ...  I get so frustrated by these things, but it's not like I'll ever escape.
Oh well. Like they say, bad laws are still laws.
Hmm? Are you guys even listening!? I'm trying to give you important life advice here!
You! Seta-kun, you're looking especially slackjawed today!
Tell me, who said, "Law is the correct judgment of the state?"

text.ACTION: I still remember his immortal words, "I drank what?"
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/23-P4-00143.jpg

text.Mrs. Nakayama: Oh, so you knew, huh? You're right, it was Socrates.
Socrates accepted his own execution, even though his sentence was the result of an unjust law.
That's exactly what I'm talking about. Sometimes we have to accept things as they are, even though they're a pain.
... SO you're all ignoring me thinking I'm just chit-chatting, eh? Well, now this is gonna be on the test.

text.ACTION: I'm wondering if she means that Socrates will be on the test or that she's bitter and in a loveless marriage? Anyway, since we're not even sure Rise's a target until we see the Midnight Channel I agreed to help Yukiko with some things.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/24-P4-00151.jpg
You accompanied Yukiko on her shopping trip.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Ummm ...  Notebooks, three colors of pens, a loose-leaf folder, labels at the stationary department ...
Then the furniture department. I want to look at the desks. Those and the lamps ...

text.ACTION: I wasn't sure why she needed all this at first.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/25-P4-00155.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: (giggle) Studying!

text.ACTION: Yukiko is full of energy…

text.Yukiko Amagi: I'm thinking of studying seriously for a job license ...
Though I haven't decided on exactly which one I'll pursue.
But I was thinking of trying for all the ones I feel I can earn.
I've started working at night, you see. Remember the job you told me about?
Thanks to that, I have some money ...

text.ACTION: Some jerk came up to us and started talking to Yukiko.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/26-P4-00163.jpg

text.Shady Reporter: Or should I say, the manager-to-be.

text.Yukiko Amagi: ... I see you haven't gone home yet.

text.Shady Reporter: Well, I can't very well go anywhere until the next bus or train departs. This really is the boonies.
Stuck here with nothing to do ...
Man, the countryside is the dumps.

text.Yukiko Amagi: ... I beg to differ.

text.Shady Reporter: Turning down sweet deals is part of country life, too, is it? Hahaha.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Oh ...  I'm sorry.
Those people are from some TV station. They wanted to cover the Amagi Inn ...

text.ACTION: After what happened last time she was on TV I could see wanting them to go away, and it turned out to be even worse than that.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/27-P4-00173.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Yes ...

text.ACTION: Yukiko seems embarrassed…

text.Yukiko Amagi: It's a "news of the weird" show ...  It isn't real journalism.
You know that our inn was associated with Ms. Yamano's murder, right?
They want to make a special called, "Hot Springs Getting Too Hot for the Amagis!?"
It was an abhorrent title. Mother turned them away.
But maybe she shouldn't have declined ...
I mean ...  If it gets a bad reputation ...
We'd lose customers, and the inn really would close its doors.
Then ...
... I'd feel better about leaving.

text.ACTION: I really think for all her talk Yukiko hasn't really made up her mind to leave.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/28-P4-00185.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: I'm serious ...

text.ACTION: Yukiko muttered darkly…

text.Yukiko Amagi: But you're right, there's no real point in saying things like that.
I'm leaving now under my own power ...  My life is in my hands now.
And of course, I want to help everyone.
You too, for being such a patient listener all the time.

text.ACTION: You can sense Yukiko's iron will…
You feel that you understand Yukiko even more…
Yukiko also mentioned that they'd had some kind of training at the Inn recently and that if she could get an opening in battle she could help anyone who'd been knocked to the ground.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/29-P4-00194.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: W-Well, let's go shopping.
First is ...  the stationary department ...

text.ACTION: You helped Yukiko with her shopping and walked home partway together.
It's supposed to rain tomorrow. Will the Midnight Channel air again?

The rains came again today. I headed to the shopping district just to look around, but it seemed they'd driven almost everyone away from the area. That gas station person also confirmed that Rise was in the area.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/30-P4-00203.jpg

text.Moel Gas Station Attendant: Even in a country town like this, people do like to talk.
And everyone's talking about the same thing.
There are all kinds of different people, so why would that be?

text.ACTION: Oh, and I managed to make that Matador thing Margaret wanted to see. It's some kind of skeleton guy, I wonder what the deal with that even is?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/31-P4-00207.jpg

text.Margaret: Ah, Matador ...  and he has Mahama ...  You have successfully completed the quest ...
What a beautiful Persona ...  This fascinating dance, performed by a true sportsman ...
I'm amazed. You're still young, but you hold such masculinity within your soul ...
Mmm ...  I can feel my heart beat faster.
Thank you. I am strongly confident that you are the one I've been searching for.
I want to see more of your soul.

text.ACTION: Margaret is smiling gently…
You became a little more intimate with Margaret…
I really wish I knew exactly what Margaret is to know how scared I should be that she's hitting on me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/33-P4-00216.jpg

text.Margaret: Well then ...  For my next request ...
Bring me a Gdon that knows Rampage. If anyone can do this for me, it's you.
I eagerly await your return.

text.ACTION: Gdon's some kind of flaming tiger and I'm not quite able to handle it yet I think. I went to go tell the fox about helping the sticker kid, he seemed happy.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/34-P4-00222.jpg
By the way I keep mentioning this but I do make bad choices so very option.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/35-P4-00223.jpg
There's a small bag of wasabi…
Lick it…?
You really regret doing that!
The tears… They won't stop…
Your Courage has greatly increased.
However…
You don't feel well…
You decided to go to bed early today…
I was recovered by midnight, though. Not that it was good news.
VIDEO- "The Midnight Channel"
Will something appear on TV…?
It was definitely a girl, and probably Rise.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/37-P4-00240.jpg
It seems to be a girl. She's wearing a swimsuit…
She looks somewhat like Rise Kujikawa, the idol you saw on TV yesterday…
For some reason, it keeps zooming in on her chest and thighs…
It's hard to make out her face as a result…

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hello!? Hey, did you see that!?
That was Rise for sure! Rise Kujikawa!

text.ACTION: I mean there's no way it could be anyone else.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2030/38-P4-00249.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Thought so!
Oh ...  I guess I shouldn't be so excited. There's a chance she might get kidnapped ...
C'mon, we should go there tomorrow! What was it called again ... ? Oh yeah, Marukyu Tofu!
Dude, my heart's pounding already ...
Well, see you tomorrow!

text.ACTION: You'll be going to Marukyu tofu shop with Yosuke tomorrow.
You decide to go to bed for tonight.
I just hope we can stop her being kidnapped.
We got together as school ended to plan out how we were going to deal with this.
VIDEO- "Rise Kujikawa"

text.Female Student: You know the tofu store Marukyu? The owners of that place have the same last name, Kujikawa!

text.Male Student: Seriously!? Hey, I practically live next door!

text.Yukiko Amagi: I've been hearing that there's a big crowd at Marukyu.

text.Chie Satonaka: I'm not surprised.
But was it really her on yesterday's Midnight Channel? Didn't she seem a little ...  different?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It was her, no doubt about it!
Her curves ...  Her posture ...  Even her beautiful, slim legs!

text.Chie Satonaka: ... What's that look for?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Anyways, I'm positive! Right!?

text.ACTION: Yosuke's really creepy sometimes. And by sometimes I mean all the times.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/5-P4-00011.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I don't really care about celebrities, but it's not like I got anything better to do ...  Sure, I'll tag along.

text.Chie Satonaka: Sorry, but me and Yukiko have plans. Give us a call if anything comes up.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, shall we get going? But let's be clear on one thing: we're not spectators.
We're on an investigation, got it?

text.ACTION: You decided to go to the Marukyu tofu shop.
Dojima's partner was directing traffic outside.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/7-P4-00018.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Oh, it's you guys.
Ai yi yi ...  These gawkers keep streaming in with their cars, trying to park in the middle of the shopping district.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Why's that?

text.Tohru Adachi: Don't you know? Rise Kujikawa's here.
Hey, did you see her already? Is she there? Which is it?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh ... ? We're askin' why a plainclothes detective is here doing traffic control.

text.Tohru Adachi: Oh ...  Uh, well ...  The Inaba Police Department isn't that big, and we don't have enough staff ...
Well, I still have work to do, so I'll see you later.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dude ...  You managed to scare off a police detective on active duty ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I wasn't trying to scare the guy, I just said what I was thinking.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: But you're right, it's weird for the police to come out like this ...
Hey ...  You think the police suspect that Rise might be the next target, too?

text.ACTION: It seemed our suspicion on that was confirmed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/9-P4-00031.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Dammit ...  I told him not to leave his post ...
What are you guys doing-
Hm? Kanji Tatsumi ... !? Are you friends with them?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Like it's any of your business ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: ... If you say so. So I'll ask again: What are you all doing here?

text.ACTION: I played it cool, as always.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/11-P4-00037.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: ... Is that so?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, um ...
W-Well, who wouldn't wanna come check it out if they found out an idol's family ran an ordinary tofu store?
I'm, uh ...  a big fan!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: (sigh) Fine.
But remember. She might be a celebrity, but this is her home. Try not to bother them too much.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: That cop's your uncle, eh ... ?
So, what the hell was that about? Are you guys under suspicion ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, they did take us in once ...
But we can't just tell him everything, right?
If we say anything about the other world, we only look more suspicious. They'll be watching us all the time.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Got a point there ...

text.Young Man's Voice: Man, there's no one in there but the old lady. Risette isn't here after all ...

text.Older Man's Voice: I heard that she really is already here, but it might've just been a rumor ...
Well, it was fun while it lasted.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: A rumor!? What, she's not here!? Seriously!?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Pfft, you sound like the world's about to end.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Shuddup!
Anyways, now that all those people are gone, we might as well check inside. I'll buy something.

text.ACTION: I seemed to recall that Yosuke can't eat tofu normally, so I suggested something a little more his speed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/12-P4-00058.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: How'd you know I can't eat tofu? Wow, that's considerate of you.

text.ACTION: Yosuke seems somewhat happy…

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Wait, what's ganmodoki again? Is it the kind with a rice cake in it?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: There's no rice cakes in 'em ...  They're sorta like ...  fried tofu patties with veggies and stuff in, and ...

text.ACTION: Yosuke received a crash course on ganmodoki…

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Ohhh, okay, I know what you mean! I think I can eat that.

text.ACTION: We headed in to get some tofu. We didn't see anyone around at first.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/13-P4-00065.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Sure enough ...  The only one here is your typical old lady. (sigh)

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Man, why don't you just ask if she's in back?
'Scuse me!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Yes, may I help you?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What the--!? Then, who's that ... ?

text.ACTION: Turned out we're just idiots.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/14-P4-00071.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Uh ...  Are you Rise?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Yeah. So?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: No way ...  Are you really Risette?

text.Rise Kujikawa: What do you want?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh ... ? Oh, sorry, um ...  Some tofu, please!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Tofu ... ? Which kind?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh? Wh-Which one's which again ... ?

text.Rise Kujikawa: If you're going to eat it by itself, you should go with silken. Momen's better for cooking ...  Depends how you use it.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: U-Um ...
Psst, Kanji! Order something!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Wha--!? Why're you making me do it!? You already picked ganmo a second ago!
Dude here wants three ganmodoki.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Oh, I see ...
I'll go get them.

text.ACTION: Rise was definitely not as energetic as we were used to seeing on TV.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/16-P4-00088.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Man, but it's really her ...  I'm so glad I came! Mission comple-
Wait, we haven't done what we came here for yet!
H-Have you noticed anything weird lately?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Weird ... ? Like stalkers?
Are you guys fans of mine?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I wouldn't say "we," but yeah, dude here's a big fan.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You little ... ! Why'd you let that slip!?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Her curves, her posture, even her beautiful slim legs ...  Ya finished checkin' em out yet, or what?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Waaaaaaah! Y-You're doing this on purpose, aren't you!?
I didn't say that! I never said any of that!
Maybe you know already, but it's been dangerous in Inaba lately. That's why we've been investigating some stuff.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Oh yeah?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Sorry, um ...  Let's see ...  Do you know about the TV show that comes on at midnight?
I mean, it's not like regularly scheduled programming ...  How do I explain this ... ?

text.ACTION: It seemed Rise had seen the Midnight Channel as well!
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/17-P4-00106.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, you know about it ...
Wait ...  What!? You mean you saw it last night!?

text.Rise Kujikawa: I heard the rumors from some friends of mine.
But that girl last night wasn't me. I've never been filmed wearing that swimsuit before.
And the bustline ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Mine aren't that big.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh yeah, I see what you mean now ...
I-I mean ...  What am I saying!? U-Um, I'm sorry ... !

text.Rise Kujikawa: ... Don't apologize so much.
You're funny.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey, she smiled.

text.Rise Kujikawa: What is that show about, anyway?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, we're not too sure either ...
But you know there's been stuff happening here, right?

text.ACTION: Well, we've warned her at least.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/18-P4-00122.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I know this is sudden, but we're not lying.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, that's why we thought you should know about it.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Huh ...  So that wasn't a dream.
I was tired yesterday, but I couldn't sleep.
And it was raining, so I decided to try that rumor I'd heard about ...
... Hmm.
Alright, thanks ...  I'll be careful.
Here you go, three ganmo. That'll be 600 yen.
There's extra tofu in there for everyone ...  A little thank-you for worrying about me.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Whoa, seriously? Thanks!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Yosuke-senpai, you can't eat tofu, right? Want me to take yours?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hell no! I always eat what people give me.

text.ACTION: Rise gave you a block of tofu.
Maybe you can eat it for dinner…
Later that day…
VIDEO- "The Plot Thickens"

text.Tohru Adachi: Seems like the crowds are thinning out, so we'll be leaving now.
If it gets rowdy again, just give us a call at the station.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Okay.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Uh, hang on a second. Sorry, but there's some things I'd like to ask you.
You do know that there have been multiple violent cases around here lately, yeah?
Have you seen anyone suspicious around?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Not really ...  It's been like always.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Like always ...  Well, you're an idol, so I imagine you deal with folks like fans, paparazzi and stalkers quite often.
What made you take a break from showbiz?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Does it really matter?
... I just needed a rest.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: And have you registered for school?

text.Rise Kujikawa: I'm planning on going to Yasogami High. It was the closest.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/20-P4-00153.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: That's why, well ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: I might be kidnapped, right?
I've been told that before. Don't worry, I'll be careful.

text.Tohru Adachi: Huh ... ? Someone told you already?

text.Rise Kujikawa: It was three guys ...  They were wearing uniforms, so I think they were high school students ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Did one of them happen to look ...  How do I put it ...  Did he look something like a gang member?

text.Tohru Adachi: Wait ...  You think she's talking about your nephew and his friends?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Something smells here.
The recent disappearances ...  Between those and the two homicides, there's too many questions with no answers.
To tell the truth, I followed my detective's intuition and came here to warn her.
How could high school kids who know less than we do beat us to the punch ... ?
Were they just making up an excuse to talk to a famous celebrity ... ?
Or ...

text.Tohru Adachi: Sir ... ?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Yasogami High ...

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/21-P4-00171.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: I guess the investigation of the ones involved with the school hasn't turned up anything either ...
Aren't we gonna be in trouble if this keeps up? The prefectural police will be coming soon to-

text.Ryotaro Dojima: They're the least of your worries! Keep your head in the game.

text.ACTION: Dojima was sort of on edge, I was concerned he'd caught on to why we were at Marukyu.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/22-P4-00175.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Yeah ...  It tastes great.
You visited Rise Kujikawa today. What did you talk about?

text.ACTION: I decided to just admit what we were there for, he might be pissed but at least he wouldn't think I was hiding something.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/23-P4-00178.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I told you to keep your hands off this.
Listen, this is a job for the police.
(sigh) Forget it ...  I shouldn't have brought it up.
(sigh) Yeah ...
Of course not ...  Here, hurry and finish your dinner.

text.ACTION: The tense atmosphere continues into the night…
The Midnight Channel was back on, and it was definitely Rise this time.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/25-P4-00189.jpg
It's the same girl as before, still wearing a swimsuit. Her chest area and waist are emphasized…
This girl…
It's Rise Kujikawa! The image is fairly clear tonight.
Should you try calling Yosuke…?
I figured Yosuke would call me if I didn't call him.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/26-P4-00195.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: The one on tonight seemed a lot creepier than the real Rise, but you could see her face clearly. There's no mistake.
Let's all get together as soon as possible tomorrow!

text.ACTION: You hung up.
You decide to go to bed for tonight.
At least it was still fuzzy, she's not been kidnapped yet.
We got together at Junes after school.
VIDEO- "The Plan"

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It even showed her face this time.

text.Yukiko Amagi: So now we know one more thing. The ones that the culprit's targeting are ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Exactly! So we can rules out the assumption that all the victims are connected to the incident with Ms. Yamano.
As for Rise, I took a peek this morning, and she was still at the shop.
So I'm guessing that "TV show" thing doesn't appear on the Midnight Channel until after the person enters the TV.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Teddie said before that it might be the victim's own creation upon entering that world.
I didn't understand at all at first, but now I feel it may be true.
The one that appears on TV is your other self ...  Maybe the victim's true feelings are shown unconsciously.

text.Chie Satonaka: But ...  We see them on the Midnight Channel before they disappear.
You know, when it's still really fuzzy and you can't tell who it is. How do you explain that part?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah ...  It always happens before the person disappears, like an advance notice ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Or like a ransom note. But who are they announcing it to? And for what?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I dunno, ask the killer. There's a bunch of stuff I still don't understand.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Is it possible that we see those images for the same reason?

text.Chie Satonaka: Huh? What do you mean?

text.ACTION: Yukiko had a really interesting theory.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2031/29-P4-00217.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Maybe what we're seeing is the culprit's intentions.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, it's a possibility ...
The killer can throw people into the TV, after all, which means they must have the same power that we do.

text.Chie Satonaka: So ...  When the killer things, "I'm gonna attack someone now," that's what we see on TV?

text.Yukiko Amagi: I don't know about that ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, if we're gonna go that far with it, we might as well say that's the basis for that entire world.
Like, it's some kinda mix of the minds of the victims and the killer ...  Or maybe it's everyone's minds?

text.ACTION: Boss Battle- Shadow Teddie

Now things get serious. First thing's first, Shadow Teddie laughs off Ice so don't even try it. For the first quarter or so of his health he's pretty simple. He'll use Marakunda to debuff your party's defense, Foolish Whisper to try and Mute your party, and Heat Wave, a physical attack that hits everyone. A Persona like Unicorn with Dekunda is pretty valuable here to negate the Marakunda. Things get a little more exciting when we drag him down a bit.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2032/67-P4-00464.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2032/68-P4-00466.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2032/69-P4-00467.jpg
Teddie will use Ultra Charge at this point. This will skip his next turn charging. And on the turn after?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2032/70-P4-00468.jpg

At which point you need to have everyone Guard, because Teddie is going to use Nihil Hand. I'm pretty sure this kills anyone who didn't guard. What's more, Teddie will start mixing things up at this point. He gains Mind Charge and Mabufula at this point. He'll always use Mind Charge first at this point, so you know when you need to have Yukiko guard if she's with you. Teddie adds another annoying little wrinkle at 50%.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2032/71-P4-00470.jpg

He then uses an attack called Nullity Guidance on someone, which is an automatic crit that dizzies them. Then he'll use his One More to start Ultra Charge again. This gives us fewer free turns while he's Charging. There's no real tactical change on Teddie's part until 25% though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2032/72-P4-00472.jpg

Teddie throws out two Nullity Guidances before this Ultra Charge starts. Now he'll also start throwing out Mabufulas whenever he feels like. If he gets a One More from them he'll often use Ice Break on the MC. Just keep things going nice and steady though and this shouldn't be a real problem.

text.Yukiko Amagi: S-Sorr-heehee ...

text.Chie Satonaka: You'll have to forgive Yukiko. She's helpless once she gets this way ...

text.Teddie: Oooh, please, everyone! Don't fight over me, baby!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Shuddup! You picking a fight with me!?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Ahahahahahaha!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Geez ...  oh well.

text.ACTION: Yosuke handed a 1,000-yen bill to Kanji.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Here, Kanji. Get whatever ice cream you wan, just share it with Teddie.
We're gonna head for the tofu shop. Wait here until we get back.

text.Teddie: Wow, you're rich!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I can't just take this from you!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Think of it as a welcome-back party for Teddie.
Just don't go around making a racket.

text.Chie Satonaka: Whoa, Yosuke, what's gotten into you? You're acting like a real senpai all of a sudden.
Oh, I get it. You might say differently, but you're still nice to Teddie.
I'm glad Yosuke's developing into such a mature adult. Someone who doesn't let trifles bother him.

text.ACTION: This was going in a direction that I could already tell was going to be hilarious if you weren't Yosuke.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/38-P4-00281.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh, it's about Teddie's clothes, that's all. We didn't have the money for them, so we charged the rest to you.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Charge?
WHAT!? You put it on my account!? What the hell, Chie!? I never said you could do that!

text.Chie Satonaka: What else were we supposed to do!? This stuff was expensive, even for Junes!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You seriously charged it to me?
Wh-Why would you do that!? You know I've been saving up to buy a motorcycle!

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh, that. You don't need one.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What!?

text.Teddie: C'mon baby. Stop fighting over-

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Shuddup! This is your fault, y'know!
Grrrrr ...
You listen here, Ted ...  You better take really, really, REALLY good care of that.
If you put even a single tear in it, I'll make your next set of clothes out of the bear hide you took off!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Yo Teddie, don't let it get you down.
Let's go get some Topsicles.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Let's go on ahead ...  I think they're going to be a while.

text.ACTION: That person Kanji had been talking with was already at Rise's.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/39-P4-00299.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: You're ... !

text.Naoto Shirogane: Are you here to ingratiate yourself with Rise Kujikawa now?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Geez ...  Why did the clerk even let them charge it to someone else ... ?
Huh? W-Wait, you're that guy we saw with Kanji ... !

text.Naoto Shirogane: Precisely. I don't believe we've met since then-In fact, I don't believe I've ever introduced myself.
My name is Naoto Shirogane. I'm investigating the multiple murders that have occurred here.
Mind if I ask you a few questions on the subject?
The latest victim, Kinshiro Morooka ...  He was a teacher at the school you all attend, correct?

text.Chie Satonaka: S-So what?

text.Naoto Shirogane: The public is focused on the fact that he is associated with the second victim's school ...  But in truth, that's irrelevant.
What intrigues me is the inconsistency.

text.ACTION: I don't know who this Naoto Shirogane is but I'm damn impressed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/41-P4-00311.jpg

text.Naoto Shirogane: What do you make of that?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: ... How are we supposed to know?

text.Naoto Shirogane: Well, we'll leave it at that.
For my part, I'd like to solve this case as quickly as possible.
I'll be keeping an eye on you all.
Well then, until we meet again.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Who is that guy ... ?

text.Chie Satonaka: It felt like he completely saw through us ...  He even knew about the TV thing.

text.ACTION: Before we could continue on, Rise showed up.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/42-P4-00320.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Rise-chan!
Are you okay now ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Good, good ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Are you all here to check up on me?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, yeah ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Oh, um ...  Do you guys have a moment?
There's something I want to tell you.
Follow me. My grandma's taking care of the shop today.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh? Sure, okay ...

text.ACTION: We went to the shrine with Rise.
VIDEO- "Rise"

text.Rise Kujikawa: When I came to, though, I was already in the other world.

text.Chie Satonaka: Still no real information on the killer ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: We met this weird kid named Naoto a second ago ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Oh ...  He's come to the shop several times. He asked me a lot about the incident.
I didn't tell him anything about the other world, though. I figured it'd be a waste of time.
Actually, he asked me about you guys too, but I just made up some stuff.
Like, "They found me unconscious on the roof at Junes."

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, I guess that's close enough to the truth.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Um ...  So ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Hm ... ? What's up?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Um ...
I-I really appreciate what you did for me ...
Thank you soooo much! I love you guys!

text.Chie Satonaka: Huh ... ? Awww, you don't have to thank us!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dude ...  She's so cute ...
Man, it's finally hitting me that you're the real deal. You really are Risette.

text.ACTION: It was good to see that she was feeling better, I have to say.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/45-P4-00348.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Do I ...  sound weird?
Oh, but I guess it sounds more "natural" this way to the public ...
I'm sorry ...  I've practically lost touch with what the normal me is like.

text.Chie Satonaka: Haha, no need to apologize. Just do what comes naturally.

text.Yukiko Amagi: I think everyone has multiple sides to them. You don't have to force yourself to decide on just one.

text.Chie Satonaka: Haha, it sounds convincing when Yukiko says it.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Huh ... ? R-Really?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Thanks.
(chuckle) I'm glad you're the first people I got to know here.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh yeah, we almost forgot your present. The Teddie Glasses.
Um, you don't have to take them, but ...  Well ...

text.ACTION: Teddie gave you a pair of glasses to hold onto for when Rise joined you.
But what you should say when giving them to her…?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Senpai ...  Would you be struggling without my help?
I can help you in that world, right?
With my power ...
So wouldn't it be better if I joined the team?

text.ACTION: It seems I didn't even need to ask her to join.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/46-P4-00367.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: These are kinda proof that you're one of us ...

text.ACTION: You explained the effect of the glasses to Rise.

text.Rise Kujikawa: I see ...  I do remember you all wearing glasses over there.
Thanks, Senpai. Now I'm part of the team, too!

text.ACTION: Rise Kujikawa joined the group!
She'll definitely be a strong asset in solving the case.
I think Rise's powers are much stronger than Teddie's ever were, so we'll be in even better shape now.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/47-P4-00374.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: I'll be going to Yasogami High, starting tomorrow.
But I don't have any friends yet, so don't ignore me, alright?
I do owe you my life, so ...  you know ...
W-Wow ...  I didn't realize you were so cool, Senpai.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: This sure is a rough time to transfer here, though.
The kidnappings, King Moron's death ...  All that, and exams are soon, too.
(sigh) Exams ...  Now I'm depressing myself. I wonder if there's any chance they'll be cancelled ...

text.Chie Satonaka: I doubt it. They always hold exams, rain or shine ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: (chuckle) I almost got killed by those monsters. Compared to that, exams are nothing.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Alrighty then, let's discuss the case some more tomorrow at our special headquarters.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Yo. How's it going?

text.ACTION: Kanji had some incredible news.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/48-P4-00390.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Though if you count the ones I had before, that makes six, so I still win.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: No one asked ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: We're all done talking already!
Let's go, Senpai!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Uh ...  When did you get so chipper?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Do you go to Yasogami, like Senpai? I'll be starting school there tomorrow, so I hope we get along too.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh? Oh ...  cool.
Uhh ...  What grade are you in?

text.Yukiko Amagi: ... Snrk.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: So where's Teddie?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: He's over there, finishing up his fifth Topsicle. What are we gonna do with him?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well ...  I guess I'll take him home ...

text.ACTION: We split up and headed home.
VIDEO- "That Night"

text.Announcer: The serial murder case in Inaba has claimed a third victim.
The news shocked local residents, who have not seen another murder in three months, and assumed the spree had reached its end.
The deceased taught at a local high school. Since his body was found arranged in a similar manner as the last two victims ...

text.ACTION: King Moron's picture is on the news.
It seems he really was murdered…
Nanako seems scared…
She wasn't taking this well.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/50-P4-00414.jpg
You calmed Nanako down…
Nanako seems somewhat relieved.

text.Announcer: This marks the second consecutive death, after Ms. Saki Konishi's, where the target was involved with Yasogami High.
Mr. Morooka was known for his strict teaching methods, and is said to have had constant friction with his students.
The police will be pursuing this line of inquiry, and are planning to begin a large-scale investigation tomorrow.
We now turn to our reporter at the scene for more details ...

text.ACTION: The news is livelier than usual…

text.Nanako: Dad won't be coming home again today ...

text.ACTION: Maybe you should try another magic trick…
You move a finger on your right hand…
…to your left hand!
It was an old trick but I figured it was pretty good.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/51-P4-00428.jpg
This time, you move a finger on the left hand…
…to your right hand!

text.Nanako: Hey, how did you do that? Tell me, tell me!

text.ACTION: Nanako seems to have cheered up…
You put Nanako to bed and decided to call it a night as well…
God this day has been a mess. What else could happen?
Later that night…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2037/52-P4-00435.jpg

text.Igor: Welcome.
It's been quite some time ...

text.ACTION: It seems you've been called to the Velvet Room…

text.Igor: Do not be alarmed. You are fast asleep in the real world ...
I have summoned you within your dreams.
How are things proceeding ... ?
Are you gradually drawing nearer to a solution to the mystery ... ?
Excellent.

text.Margaret: The season has changed, but your future is not yet closed.
In time, a path will open to you.

text.Igor: Our true reason for calling you here tonight is to provide a new form of assistance to help you achieve just that.
Fusing Personas ...  Have you been using our services diligently?
The aid we will henceforth provide is an advanced form of fusion ...
I speak of the power to fuse four or more Personas at once.
I am quite certain that this will enable you to command even stronger powers ...

text.ACTION: A new type of fusion is now available!

text.Igor: Now ...  your journey will soon reach its climax ...
And as a result, many challenges-which I cannot forsee at present-await you.
Most interesting ...  (chuckle)

text.ACTION: Today was our first day back to school since the murder.
VIDEO- "Kashiwagi"

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I still can't believe it ...  Our homeroom teacher was killed.
I ...  couldn't get that much sleep yesterday.
How about you? Are you alright?
Well ...  If we start getting depressed over something like this, we'll never catch the killer, huh?
Hmm ...  Oh, yeah ...  This means we'll be getting a new homeroom teacher.
I wonder who it'll be ...
... Well, I'm pretty sure that they won't be able to find anyone worse than King Moron.

text.ACTION: Yosuke was wrong, as he so often is.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/4-P4-00011.jpg

text.Male Student: Hey, is that stuff about King Moron for real?

text.Female Student: It was on TV, right? It must be true.

text.ACTION: He was oh so wrong.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/5-P4-00014.jpg

text.Noriko Kashiwagi: I'm Noriko Kashiwagi, your new class teacher starting today.
You all probably know already, but now that Mr. Morooka has passed away ...
I'll be taking good care of you instead. (giggle)
Okay, why don't we start off with a moment of silence for Mr. Morooka.
Close your eyes, everyone ...
That should be good enough.

text.ACTION: Creepy lady was sitting up on the desk when we opened our eyes.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/7-P4-00021.jpg

text.Noriko Kashiwagi: So our regular exams are still on track for next week.
As your principal said, "It's times like these when the schedule is most important, Nori-chan."
(giggle) It must be tough for you.
But that's what it means to become an adult, little by little.

text.Female Student: I already can't stand her ...

text.Male Student: First King Moron and now Kashiwagi ... ? How much worse can it get?

text.Noriko Kashiwagi: Oh, and one more thing.
That idol in our first-year class ...  Ms. Kujikawa, was it?
In person, she's nothing like she seems on TV, so don't get your hopes up, mmkay?
What's so great about an idol anyway, right class? She's just a piece of inexperienced jailbait.

text.ACTION: Ms. Kashiwagi is ranting on and on…
Seriously what a freak.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/8-P4-00034.jpg

text.Student's Friend: She doesn't stand a chance against Risette. I mean, I heard Kashiwagi is on the wrong side of 40 ...

text.ACTION: You can hear your classmates gossiping…

text.Brown-Haired Student: I bet King Moron would've been ecstatic to hear Risette had enrolled here.
Someone told me they saw him buying Rise's pinup book ...

text.Student's Friend: He annoyed the hell out of me, but I feel bad that he got killed ...

text.Brown-Haired Student: Oh, you know what? Risette was on a striptease show.

text.Student's Friend: Huh? A striptease!? Dude, if that was true, the paparazzi would've been all over it.

text.Brown-Haired Student: I'm serious! But the reception went bad right when it was getting to the good part ...
It was on that Midnight Channel everyone keeps talking about.

text.Student's Friend: You actually believe that crap? How friggin' dense are you?
Trust me, you were dreaming it ...

text.ACTION: If more people really are watching the Midnight Channel this could get even worse.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/9-P4-00047.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: We'd better wrap this case up quick.
Anyways, let's meet up later. Don't make any plans for this afternoon.

text.ACTION: We went down to Junes as usual.
VIDEO- "Naoto Returns"

text.Chie Satonaka: It's been a while since I failed any subjects ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, if by "a while" you mean "all the time."

text.Chie Satonaka: Sh-Shut up! Like you've ever seen my scores!

text.Yukiko Amagi: But Chie always has above-average marks in the subjects that she doesn't fail!

text.Chie Satonaka: H-Hey! Why'd you tell him!? My scores just ...  vary! Yeah, that's it!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Ahaha!

text.Chie Satonaka: R-Rise-chan, you too ... ?

text.Rise Kujikawa: (giggle) Sorry ...  I'm not laughing at you.
It's just ...  I thought it would take me a while to make any friends at my new school.

text.Chie Satonaka: Too bad we met under such awful circumstances.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh yeah ...  What do you guys think about King Moron's case?
He didn't show up on the Midnight Channel even once.

text.Teddie: If this person had been inside the TV, I would've sensed it.
My nose isn't as sharp now, but I can tell that much.

text.Chie Satonaka: But they found the body on a foggy day again, right?
They said on the news that that crime scene was just the way it was for that announcer and Saki-senpai.

text.Yukiko Amagi: I really wonder about the culprit's motives ...  Why was Mr. Morooka targeted?

text.ACTION: Kanji had a really good point.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/15-P4-00068.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: But didn't you say it's people who get famous on TV who are targeted?
If the killer's choosing targets by watching TV, I picture him as someone who doesn't know the victims at all.
I don't think it's worth trying to figure out motives for that type.
There are too many people who hold grudges against you for no reason, even if you've never met them before.

text.Chie Satonaka: Haha ...  You sound like you speak from experience, Rise-chan ...
But with King Moron, he didn't appear on the Midnight Channel or the regular TV ...
Uurgh! I don't get this at all!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Man, two victims in a row from our school ...
That's gotta set off the police's alarm bells. They're not gonna leave any stones at school unturned.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Y'know, to be honest ...
Somewhere deep inside, I thought maybe King Moron was the killer ...
The news says that he was the second victim from Yasogami High, but we all know that's not the case.
And I've heard him say more than once that so-and-so deserves to die ...
But now ...  I feel bad that I doubted him.
He was a capital-A asshole, but that doesn't justify killing him ...
And not just King Moron ...  I feel sorry for all the victims ...
I can't forgive the killer, no matter what!

text.Chie Satonaka: Well, we'll do what we can, for King Moron's sake too!
At this rate, you have to figure that the killer has something to do with the school, right?
So why don't we split up and-

text.ACTION: It was about then that we were interrupted.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/17-P4-00089.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Y-You ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: There is no need to examine the case of Mr. Morooka any further.

text.Chie Satonaka: Wh-Why's that?

text.Naoto Shirogane: Apparently, the police has found a suspect. It would be best to let them handle the case from here.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: H-How do you know ... ?

text.Naoto Shirogane: I'm on this case as a special investigator, by request of the prefectural police.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What!?

text.Chie Satonaka: They found a suspect ... !? Who is it!?

text.Naoto Shirogane: As to his name, I haven't been informed.
I do know ...  that he is a high schooler.
It isn't public knowledge yet, but he isn't a student of your high school.
It seems they are quite confident that this boy is the killer ...
They have testimonies directly linking him with the incident.
I expect it's only a matter of time before he is apprehended.
Soon, this case will be solved, and your town will once again be its peaceful, rustic self.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: The suspect ...  is a high schooler ... ?
All right ...  So why come tell us?
That's confidential info, right? Why run right here and spill it?

text.Naoto Shirogane: Your "game" will soon reach its end.
I felt I should at least let you know that.

text.ACTION: I don't know what Naoto's problem is but this sure as hell isn't a game to us.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/19-P4-00110.jpg

text.Naoto Shirogane: You don't deny, then, that you have involved yourselves in the matter?
Well, no matter. I have no reason to say anything further.

text.Rise Kujikawa: A game ... ?
Aren't you the one who thinks of this as a game?
I don't care if you're a special investigator or an amateur sleuth ...  All you're doing is solving mysteries.
What could you possibly know about us? You're the one who's playing a game here.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: One of the victims ...  She meant a lot to me. How could I possibly treat this like a game?
Plus ...
We made a promise ...

text.Teddie: Y-Y-Yosuke ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: A game ...
That may be quite true ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Wh-Why so understanding all of a sudden ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, I get it. I was wondering why you'd be wandering around like this when the police have a suspect ...
What, did they get rid of you now that they have their man? Is that why you came here? You were lonely?

text.Naoto Shirogane: Detectives normally aren't involved with arrests. And we never harbor any special emotions regarding a case, either.
Still ...

text.ACTION: I know Dojima wasn't happy about Naoto's presence, can't imagine the others were either.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2038/20-P4-00130.jpg

text.Naoto Shirogane: But then, I'm accustomed to it.
Much about this case was perplexing, but its solution was surprisingly simple ...
Well then, I'll be going now.

text.Chie Satonaka: What was that about ... ? He just said his piece and left ... ?
He said they have a suspect ...  but is this really gonna solve everything?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: (sigh) Who knows ...

text.ACTION: …You all decided to call it a day.
I keep trying to make myself forget that exams are right around the corner, but everyone won't stop talking about them.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/1-P4-00001.jpg

text.Easygoing Boy: That's not good for you, y'know? Once they're over, summer vacation isn't far behind, right?

text.Depressed Girl: Shut it, puny underclassman! I have to study for my college entrance exams!
Once you're a third-year student, you'll get a taste of what it's like to take tests all year.

text.ACTION: Also I never thought I'd say this but I really miss Morooka.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/2-P4-00008.jpg

text.Noriko Kashiwagi: Well, don't worry about that for now.  ... The hot and humid days just keep on coming.
It's the perfect time to have eel. I just loooove that slimy texture.
By the way ...  Does anyone know why eels are slimy?
They have a protein called mucin that, due to agglutination, can precipitate the small particles.
I learned all that on TV. And they say it makes your skin smoother!
I'd recommend that channel. I'm sure one day you'll all look back and thank me for this precious information.

text.ACTION: I wanted to hit the Velvet Room so I headed down to the shopping district. That gas station attendant noticed me passing and we had a chat.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/4-P4-00017.jpg

text.Moel Gas Station Attendant: Country life has gotten a lot more convenient than it used to be, but ...
Convenience isn't the only good thing in life, is it?
Or something like that, ahaha ...  I've been here for a while, so I think like that sometimes.
... But compared to the city, I bet it's still pretty inconvenient here.

text.ACTION: When I finished up I headed back to school. Chie's been stressing out about the exams so I decided to help her out.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/5-P4-00023.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Ugh ...
... Souji-kun, you free today? Maybe you could tutor me ...  Or not ...
Alright! Let's head for the library!

text.ACTION: We got a lot done, I was pretty happy with it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/7-P4-00030.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Got it! Thanks for helping me, Souji-kun!

text.ACTION: You were able to get more studying done by teaming up with Chie.
We had some ingredients around, so I decided to delve again into the land of dessert.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/8-P4-00037.jpg
You have the ingredients to make crème caramel.
You decided to make crème caramel.
You made the base with egg, milk, sugar, and other ingredients…
How should you give it some scent…?
I mean we only had one thing a civilized person would consider using.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/9-P4-00043.jpg
It's done to perfection.
Obtained Smooth Crème Caramel.
I'm pretty happy with how it turned out, and it's not going to be terrible tomorrow so I'll even get to enjoy it.
No point having a delicious dessert if you're not going to share it with someone. Yumi's been really down about her father, so I decided to try and cheer her up.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/10-P4-00050.jpg

text.Yumi Ozawa: I think I like men who know how to cook. Do you think you could make me something for next time, too?
... Thanks a bunch!

text.ACTION: Mr. Kondo was still pretty shaken up about Morooka dying I think.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/12-P4-00054.jpg

text.Mr. Kondo: ... I still can't believe Mr. Morooka was taken from us. The faculty office is still in shock too ...
But we can't sob about it all day! Today we're gonna put the "physical" back in education!
We're gonna play rugby! And don't even think about getting lazy because it's hot!
I know some of you probably don't know how to play, but don't worry! Rome wasn't built in a day!
Don't space out, Souji! I've got a question for you!
What does "Rome wasn't built in a day" mean!?

text.ACTION: I mean this one is so old I can't believe anyone doesn't know it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/13-P4-00061.jpg

text.Mr. Kondo: Excellent!
Of course, "keep trying" would have been close! You can't give up before you build your empire! Keep at it!
By the way, that proverb was originally written in French! Mr. Hosoi told me that.
What a great proverb! I just might put that on the test! Don't forget it!

text.ACTION: I think I found the person who made that last wish, but I'm not quite sure how to handle this one.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2039/14-P4-00069.jpg

text.Awkward Girl: Wh-What, don't just walk up to me and talk to me all of a sudden! Don't you know that's rude!?
Oh ...
Umm ...
S-Sorry for blowing up like that. It's fine. I'm not in a hurry to go anywhere or anything.
So ...

text.ACTION: The female student is mumbling and obviously flustered.
Perhaps she's the one who wrote the ema request the fox showed you.
She wants to improve her conversational abilities.

text.Awkward Girl: What do you want? S-Stop staring at my face!

text.ACTION: Her word are harsh…
