text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Shadow Mitsuo

Okay, this guy can be a real asshole if you're not prepared. We start out by fighting Mitsuo the Hero, a giant 8-bit warrior. He takes two actions every time his turn comes up, either an Attack on someone or a Bomb that does damage and causes the Exhaust status. This form is largely unthreatening as long as we use items or Teddie's Energy Shower to keep Exhaust off of our party and keep people healed. When we kill Mitsuo the Hero, Shadow Mitsuo is exposed and is Downed, giving us an All-Out Attack. Now the fight gets interesting and we face the first boss with a  really random and arbitrary way of fighting that can hose us if we have the wrong party. Shadow Mitsuo also gets two actions each time its turn comes up, and he'll spend one of the first two casting a Wall spell. He'll then use an action on each of the next three turns he gets casting a group attack spell of that same element. If he knocks someone down with that he'll use Megidola and wreck the party. Then, he'll have a vocal taunt and things will get much worse.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2044/31-P4-00205.jpg

text.Shadow Mitsuo Kubo: There's no need to be scared. It'll be quick.

In this phase, Shadow Mitsuo will start by using Stagnant Air to greatly increase the chances of you being hit by status effects. He will then start using Evil Touch on people to fear them, and if anyone is feared at the start of his turn he'll use Ghastly Wail to instantly kill them. After a bit he'll use the skill Whisper to start regenerating Mitsuo the Hero.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2044/32-P4-00209.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: The shell takes time to finish forming ...
Destroy it before that happens!

text.Shadow Mitsuo Kubo: Why ... ? Don't you want to be at ease?

If we can do enough damage to him before he regenerates the shell fully, it'll break and he'll be Downed, giving us another All-Out Attack. At that point he'll focus entirely on regenerating his shell, which is pretty much impossible to stop. He'll use Chant and then Prayer, at which point Mitsuo the Hero is back.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2044/33-P4-00215.jpg

text.Shadow Mitsuo Kubo: That ominous message tells us that Mitsuo the Hero is stronger now, which he is indeed. He does more damage with his Attack and Bomb, and now he can use his Spell, Gigadyne. Gigadyne does large amounts of Almighty damage to the party, and he'll use it for sure as his first action. Once again you want to burn Mitsuo the Hero down as fast as possible while keeping Exhaust off of people. Once it dies, Shadow Mitsuo returns. It works exactly the same way, with another random element chosen at the start. You want to go at Shadow Mitsuo as hard as possible now to ensure he dies before he can regenerate his shell again, because Mitsuo the Hero is very powerful if he gets to return again.

The party I used for this is Chie, Yukiko, and Teddie. Teddie gives us the ability to cure Exhaust and both he and Yukiko are brutally powerful on this boss. The last slot is actually sort of a toss-up because Yosuke, Chie, and Kanji are all pretty similar on this boss. I'd suggest not using Yosuke because he has the same weakness as Teddie personally. I'd also suggest you get to about level 43 so that Yukiko gets Mediarama and Teddie Matarukaja. Black Frost is incredible on this fight but really any decent Persona will do, just watch for his magical attacks in the Shadow phase because if he gets a Megidola off you're likely to lose.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Shadow Naoto

Shadow Naoto is a very strange fight. She's got no weaknesses or immunities, but is resistant to Fire (which makes sense, but only in long retrospect). She starts out the fight with a mix of Attacks, Brave Blade (a powerful physical hit), and a really nasty attack called Mute Ray that does heavy damage, mutes, and drains SP from the character. This is actually probably the most dangerous thing Shadow Naoto does in practice because it's very easy to find yourself running out of gas towards the end if you're not high enough level to really kill her quickly. After you've done some damage, Shadow Naoto changes tactics up a bit. You'll know you've reached this phase because there's a vocal taunt.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2060/33-P4-00151.jpg

Then she'll cast Element Zero, a spell that negates all your elemental resistances for a few turns. Now she'll largely stop using physicals, and gains all four elemental -dyne spells and an attack called Galgalim Eyes. Galgalim Eyes is a quite nasty little move that reduces someone to 1 HP and afflicts them with the Enervation status, which halves their stats. So this is where we also start to see how Shadow Naoto's AI is different. Shadow Naoto will try to target any weaknesses in the party with her -dyne spells. So, for example, if you've got Yukiko in the party she'll almost exclusively use Mabufudyne. She'll especially focus on elemental spells when Element Zero is active. If she does manage to knock someone down she'll usually follow it up with a Mute Ray, which is of course pretty bad. When we get her into the lower parts of her health bar, we'll see another phase change.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2060/34-P4-00155.jpg

text.Shadow Naoto Shirogane: Why won't you lie down and die!? You children can't do anything at all!

She'll cast Element Zero again, and then start constantly throwing out elemental magic. She also gains Element Zero as a normal skill now, so she can just refresh it whenever she feels like now. This phase will either be very easy or very hard. If you're high enough level and have enough SP left to weather the barrage of -dyne level magic you'll win, otherwise you'll die. It's that simple.

So the trick to Shadow Naoto is pretty simple really. It starts and ends at your party selection, really. You need to minimize your weaknesses, because it's absolutely crucial that Naoto not get a bunch of extra Mute Rays off and tank your SP into the ground. Beyond that, it's just a matter of dragging her down. There's not much to it, and if you're having problems it's almost certainly just that you aren't high enough level. Oh, and Shadow Naoto has a hilarious death animation (and really just awesome animations in general).

https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/12-P4-00104.jpg
Ai yanked your arm all the way up here…

text.Ai Ebihara: H-Hey. Umm ...
Th-Thank you for that, last time ...
I was ...  you know, happy.

text.ACTION: Ai looks embarrassed…

text.Ai Ebihara: I'm in a weird mood ...
Every time I think about what happened, I can feel my heart beat faster, and I hardly sleep at night ...
Wh-What should I do ... ?
I think ...
What should I do? I think I'm ...  in love.
It's funny, isn't it? Like ...  why now?
I just keep thinking back on that day ...
And about Daisuke-kun ...
D-Do you know if he has a girlfriend?
Do you think maybe I'm his type? O-Or do you think he hates ...  people like me?

text.ACTION: I am probably not the best person to ask about this.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/15-P4-00123.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: Y-You're right!

text.ACTION: Ai nods seriously…

text.Ai Ebihara: I-I'm not used to things like this ...
You're the only one I can turn to ...

text.ACTION: Ai is looking at you with pleading eyes…
You feel your relationship with Ai deepen as she reveals a side of herself you've never seen before…
I'm not sure what Ai and Daisuke have in common but I guess that's why I'm supposed to ask him.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/16-P4-00130.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: C'mon, please ...  You'll help me, right?
All I need you to do is ...  ask him what's his type. That's it.
Thank goodness ...
Um, y-you don't have to do it today or anything, but ...  p-please ...

text.ACTION: You parted with Ai in silence and went home.
Oh, and Nanako and Dojima seem to be talking more.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/17-P4-00139.jpg

text.Nanako: I gave it back to Dad.
He looked happy and smiled at me.
Big bro ...  I love my Dad.

text.ACTION: Nanako is smiling cheerfully…

text.Nanako: Dad didn't forget about how we used to pick flowers at the Samegawa River.
He smiled at me and said, "You remember, too?"
... I feel sorry for him, losing someone he loves.

text.ACTION: Nanako smiles vigorously…

text.Nanako: I'm glad to be Dad's daughter!

text.ACTION: Nanako is smiling so happily…
Through that smile, you feel your relationship has grown even deeper…
I knew Dojima hadn't forgotten.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/19-P4-00160.jpg
It's just about Nanako's bedtime…
What will you do…?
I decided to let her stay up a while.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/20-P4-00166.jpg

text.Nanako: Then, uh, I know! Let's play cards!

text.ACTION: Nanako looks really happy.
You decide to play some cards with her.
It's getting late, so you put Nanako to bed and went to your own room.
Kanji and I went up to the hill that overlooks town after school.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/21-P4-00172.jpg
Kanji took you here…

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I've always liked this place.
Being able to see my house and school and everything from up here ...  It makes me feel small.
Uhh ...  When you met Ma at the hospital ...  She say anything about me?
That's what I thought ...
Well, you already know everything about me. I got nothin' to hide.

text.ACTION: Kanji has an embarrassed smile on his face.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Wish I could quit being afraid of hospitals.
I gotta get stronger ...
Huh?
That kid ...  He was with Ma at the hospital ...

text.ACTION: Sure enough the kid his mom took to the hospital was around.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/23-P4-00186.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Then how come you look like you're gonna cry?

text.Doll Boy: I lost the knit rabbit doll that Sana-chan let me borrow ...
Taka-kun said it was girly and stomped on it ...
It got all dirty ...  And he said, "If you're a man, then throw it away ... "
I ...  threw the doll in the river ...  And it got washed away ...
(hic) What should I do!? I hafta give it back to Sana-chan ...
She liked that bunny ...  And I ...  I ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: So why are you here? You ran away?
... Ya dumb kid!
C'mon! Don't just stand there!!
Oh, uhh ...  I'm gonna go now.

text.ACTION: I had sort of guessed what Kanji was going to do and offered to help.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/24-P4-00205.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh? Really!?

text.ACTION: Kanji's eyes are wide open…
At the same time, unlike Kanji I was not so gung ho to jump back into the Samegawa.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/25-P4-00208.jpg
Kanji is looking in the river…

text.Kanji Tatsumi: You shut up. Stay where you are so you don't get in the way!
Senpai, make sure he doesn't come in after me!
Whoa, this is cold.

text.ACTION: Despite his efforts, Kanji was unable to find a bunny doll…

text.Doll Boy: I'm going to apologize to Sana-chan. Even if she's mad, I'll say I'm sorry ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Uh, yeah, well, if you do find the rabbit, make sure you give it to her ...
Yo, hold up.
What kind of rabbit was it? Spill it.
Just tell me!
Alright, I got it.
You apologize to this "Sana-chan." You're the one who "threw it away."
It might not be the same, but I'll get you a new one ...
So let it go with that.
Who you callin' mister!?

text.ACTION: The kid ran off to give the bad news to his friend.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/26-P4-00228.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: ... Do I really look that old? Maybe it's the eyebrows ...
Oh ...  Anyways, sorry 'bout dragging you into this ...

text.Souji: You're giving him a new one?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: ... So you heard me, huh?

text.ACTION: Kanji seems really embarrassed…

text.Kanji Tatsumi: It was like I understood how he felt.
Wanting to be accepted, afraid of being left out, doing stuff that you shouldn't ...
Then taking the one person you shouldn't make cry and making 'em bawl ...
So ...  Y'know, I thought maybe I could help him.
Was I going too easy on him?

text.ACTION: Kanji has an embarrassed smile on his face…
You feel you understand Kanji a bit more…
I'm not sure where he's gonna get the rabbit though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2062/27-P4-00242.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Ah ...  hmmm?
Guh, I feel like sneezing but it won't come out. This sucks ...
It looks like I'm catching a cold ...  I better head home.

text.ACTION: You parted with Kanji and went home.
We had today off for the equinox. I decided to try and implement Operation: Cute Kitten today.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/1-P4-00011.jpg
There's a cat…
Will you pet it…?
Come to think of it, there is that man who was afraid of cats.
He was so desperate, he made a wish to be cured of his fears… Should you bring him here?
You decided to bring the man who is terrified of cats here.
Limited success.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/2-P4-00019.jpg

text.Ailurophobe: It's watching me! It's waiting for me to turn around! It's coming for me! It's gonna jump on me! I'm gonna DIEEEEEE!
B-But, I-I'm a man ...  I-I-I'm prepared for death ...
A-Alright ...  Alllriiight ...  Let me t-t-t-touch you ...
Aaaaaaaaahh! It's eating meeeeeee!

text.ACTION: The man was licked by the cat and ran away screaming…
I went back to check on him and he wasn't by the river anymore. I did run into Hisano though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/3-P4-00030.jpg

text.Hisano Kuroda: I thought you were my husband ...
Watching the river here with you, like this, brings back memories ...
Of when I was still young, before I became this wrinkled old lady.

text.ACTION: Hisano smiles…

text.Hisano Kuroda: I met my husband here in this town.
I was born and raised here, and he was part of a travelling company of actors. They'd come to town once a year ...
When I was small, my family took me to see the play ...  That's when I met my husband, who was a child actor.
He had clear, pale skin, and he spoke completely differently from the other children ...  He was my first love.
Every year, he would come ...  And every year, I would watch ...
I gathered all the courage I had and talked to him. By some miracle, he fell in love with me, too ...
We would just talk behind the stage. One date every year.
Haha ...  I thought he was just flirting with me, but I thought that was okay ...
But do you know what he did? He quit the company and said he would live here, and marry me!
He did fieldwork, though he didn't know how ...  He would come home and show me his blisters. He was so proud ...
... I was happy back then.

text.ACTION: I wish my life was that simple.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/6-P4-00047.jpg

text.Hisano Kuroda: I'm sure the day will come where you'll be so happy you could just cry out of happiness.
No, there are many people who are in the midst of happiness ...  They just don't realize it.
If you don't know what you should hold dear, then your life is just a journey without a destination.

text.ACTION: Hisano smiles…

text.Hisano Kuroda: Right now ...  all I want to do is be by his side.
... But I know I never will.
He went to Heaven ...  and I will surely go to Hell.
... You're so kind.

text.ACTION: Hisano smiles sadly…
You feel that you understand Hisano a little bit…
Why would she be going to Hell?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/7-P4-00059.jpg

text.Hisano Kuroda: I must be going now. It gets cold here, down by the river.
... I'll see you later, Souji-chan.

text.ACTION: You left Hisano and went home.
I just don't get it.
Man we have some bitter teachers at our school.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/8-P4-00066.jpg

text.Mrs. Nakayama: Circles are interesting, I think. Here in Japan, even our fireworks are spherical.
I watched fireworks on TV from a plane's view, once. Their shape was the same as if I'd seen them from the ground.
Well, if you consider the properties of a sphere, it's pretty obvious that it'd be the same shape from any direction.
Yep ...  they look the same from any perspective ...  just like my husband. Nothing good there from any angle.
Why am I working so hard, anyway? He should at least make enough money for both of us ...
Er, anyway, let's move on to the workbook.  ... Oh look, practice problems ...

text.ACTION: Rise and I went down to Okina again.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/9-P4-00078.jpg
Rise invited you to go shopping with her.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Today, we're buying for you!
I'll put together the best outfit for you, so be prepared.
I've already checked out most of the stores. First is ...  over there ...
That ad ...
I see ...  So Kanami is the new poster girl ...
Oh, uhh ...
That store's sign has a girl who was at the agency with me.
Kanami Mashita ...  She was my junior ...
... She was cute, so I figured she would sell.

text.ACTION: I figured she'd be happy about that but I'm not sure.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/11-P4-00090.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: ... Huh? Oh, yeah.
If some other girl takes off, I'm sure the agency will leave me alone.

text.ACTION: Rise is smiling…
You over hear a conversation between some teenagers…

text.Bored Teenager: It's crazy that she's still in middle school.
I like how she's not so fake, like Risette.

text.Idle Teenager: Yeah, Kanamin's like ...  plain, and honest.
Somewhere between a little sister and the girl next door. Like, the kind of girl you want to protect.

text.ACTION: I'd be really pissed but the sort of people who are dumb enough to believe someone is the way they are on TV aren't worth it. Rise didn't take it as well though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/12-P4-00100.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Yeah, yeah, I'm "fake."
That's the role I played ...
It was all an act ...  Everything ...
... Hey! All that stuff about Kanami is an act, too!
Let's go home, Senpai.
I don't want to be here.

text.ACTION: We walked down by the river when we got back to Inaba.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/13-P4-00110.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Senpai, are you ...  happy right now? Do you like being with me ...  like this, the way we are now?
You like having such a cute underclassman, right? I'm an ex-idol, after all.
Y-Yeah, of course not ...  What am I saying?
You see me as Rise, huh ... ?
The real me ...

text.ACTION: Rise seems anxious for some reason…

text.Rise Kujikawa: ... I'm sorry. I was just irritated ...
I dragged you all the way to Okina, then just came back without doing anything ...
I'm really sorry ...

text.ACTION: Nanako had just gotten out of school and was walking back as we stood there.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/14-P4-00121.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Oh, Nanako-chan ...  Y-You're going home?
Oh, I know ...
H-Hey, Nanako-chan, umm ...
Well ...
Do you know who Kanami Mashita is ... ?

text.Nanako: Yeah, I know her. Some of my friends like her.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Y-You do, huh? Hahaha, thanks ...
B-But I'm totally different from how I am on TV ...  You must be disappointed ...
Huh? Oh ...  thanks.
But that means ...  you like the "me" over here, huh ...

text.ACTION: Nanako didn't even get what Rise was talking about.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/16-P4-00140.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Oh, er ...  ummmm ...
... Thanks, Nanako-chan. I like you too.

text.Nanako: Oh, the show's about to start! I'm going home now! Bye!

text.Rise Kujikawa: "You're just Rise-chan," huh ... ?
Wh-What was I thinking, asking all that to Nanako-chan ... ?
(sigh) Risette ...
I quit so I wouldn't have to think about stuff like this ...
... I have no regrets about showbiz. I wouldn't want to go back.
Why would I sacrifice my real self!?
I just want to become a Rise who's needed by the ones who see the real me. Like you, Senpai.
That's the "me" I want to be. It's the truth.

text.ACTION: You can sense Rise's passionate will…
You feel that you understand Rise even more…
Still, I don't know that she's really made up her mind.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/17-P4-00156.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: I ...  got a little upset today when I heard those kids talk about Kanami.
... I'm sure I'll forget it by tomorrow.

text.ACTION: Rise looks helpless…
She's still got all of us, though.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/18-P4-00163.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Senpai... Thank you.
I'm okay. I feel better now.

text.ACTION: Rise seems relieved…

text.Rise Kujikawa: I'm sorry for being so selfish today.
When I was working, I met lots of people, but at the cost of free time to meet people outside of work.
I had no free time at all ...
So when I was alone, I was truly alone. Whatever I was thinking about ...  I had to keep them to myself.
So ...
Right now ...  I don't want to be alone ...
Stay with me ...  just a little longer ...

text.ACTION: You spent time with Rise until it got dark and went home.
Nanako was waiting for me when I got home, Dojima was coming home earlier than he expected and she wanted to surprise him.
VIDEO- "Justice"

text.Nanako: Let's make dinner together, big bro!
There's a lot to do today!

text.ACTION: Nanako is more cheerful than usual.

text.Nanako: I bought a bunch of dishes, pickled radish, and veggies at Junes!
Big bro, can you make a salad?
Right, then. You can be the salad-maker!
And I'll be the, uh ...  The eggs sunny-side-up-maker!

text.ACTION: Nanako looks really happy.

text.Nanako: We have to start eating our vegetables from now on.

text.ACTION: Nanako confidently repeats this as if she'd heard it from somewhere else.

text.Nanako: ... My teacher said that families help each other.
After Mom died, Dad and me have both been lonely, but ...
And I need to do my best so Dad doesn't feel lonely either!
You're my family, too, so ...  Let's work hard together!

text.ACTION: I never could have dreamed things would have been like this when I moved here.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/20-P4-00196.jpg
Nanako looks really happy.
You obtained Family Picture.
It has Nanako and her parents in it…

text.Nanako: You're family too, so you should have a family picture.
Let's get a picture of you and me and Dad all together one day!

text.ACTION: You feel a warm sense of love from Nanako…
You can feel a tight bond between yourself and Nanako…
So this is what it's like to have a little sister…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/21-P4-00211.jpg
Sraosha is an angel of some variety. I'm pretty sure there's a lot of disagreement on what angel does what.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2063/22-P4-00212.jpg

text.Nanako: We need to hurry, or Dad'll be home before we're done!

text.ACTION: You prepared dinner with Nanako.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I'm home.
Y-Yeah.

text.Nanako: I made dinner with big bro today! We made salad and, ummm, a bunch of other stuff!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I see ...  Good work, Nanako.

text.Nanako: Go wash your hands! Hurry, sit down!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: She's really cheerful.
I'm sure it's thanks to you.
I got it, I got it. Let's eat, then.

text.ACTION: The three of you sat around the table and enjoyed each other's company…
Ai called me up earlier, we headed out to Okina for a bit.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/1-P4-00006.jpg
Ai dragged you all the way here…

text.Ai Ebihara: I wanna go to that shop first and get a bangle.
It's kinda expensive, though ...  Could you buy it for me?

text.ACTION: I know she's loaded and all, but what are friends for?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/3-P4-00010.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: Wha ... ? I-I'm just kidding!
I wanted to see what you'd do, that's all.
But thanks anyways.

text.ACTION: It promises to be an entertaining day.
You spent some time with Ai.
Had a fun day, we're still waiting on Naoto's health so not much else.
It was crappy and raining today, stopped by Aiya then headed home after school. Dojima had something he wanted to show me and Nanako when I got home.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/4-P4-00022.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Now then ...  First off ...

text.ACTION: It seems Dojima has something in mind…

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Souji, go call Nanako down here.
Take your time.

text.ACTION: You called Nanako, as Dojima ordered you to do..

text.Nanako: You told me to go over there ...

text.ACTION: Dojima had gotten a cake, and made some coffee!
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/7-P4-00029.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Uhh, well ...  Today is a special day for us.
That's right.
Today's the day when you, me, and Souji become "family."
Er, well ...
A-Anyways, it's the day that we become a real family.

text.Nanako: I don't really get it, but ...  Cake!!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Alright, let's eat.

text.ACTION: You spent an enjoyable time together…
Eventually, Nanako petered out.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/8-P4-00043.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Uhh, well ...  Heh.
Er ...  Sorry about making you go along with this.
Huh ...  You're a nice guy.

text.ACTION: Dojima looks happy.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I felt like I needed to do this to draw the line ...
And I wanted Nanako to know ...
She has to know how important my daughter is to me ...
She's looking more and more like Chisato ...
Her smile ...  Her strong attitude ...
It was hard for me even to look at Nanako's face, because she reminds me so much of Chisato.
Chisato died because she went to pick up Nanako ...  There were times when I'd come close to believing that.
But even then, I can't count the number of times she's saved me just by being there ...
If I was living by myself, I would never have thought about taking you in.
I think I was ...  scared. Scared to have someone else around ...

text.ACTION: So that's what it was all about.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/10-P4-00061.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I was running away by chasing a guy who'd run away himself ...  It was almost funny.

text.ACTION: Dojima's smile looks sad…

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Souji ...  I've been scared this whole time.
That's why I used revenge as an excuse to spend time away from her ...
That's right.
I can't make Nanako wait any longer.

text.ACTION: Dojima nods.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Running, regretting ...  That crap all ends tonight.
I'm not going to lose the things that are important to me ...
Never again.

text.ACTION: You can feel Dojima's strong resolve…
I think everything's going to work out for us.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2064/11-P4-00074.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: That's the strength you've shown me.
Thanks, Souji.

text.ACTION: Kanji wanted me to come along when he went to see that kid from before, so I agreed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/1-P4-00007.jpg
It seems Kanji called the boy here…

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Here's the stuff I promised ya.
N-No complaining, okay ... ?

text.ACTION: Kanji handed the boy what appears to be a bunny doll…
…It's complete with clothes, a ribbon, a hat and an umbrella.
It's… very elaborate.

text.Doll Boy: This is incredible! Where'd you buy it!?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh ... ? Wh-Who cares!?
Oh ...  Well, I got one for you.

text.ACTION: Kanji handed the boy another bunny…
…It's complete with clothes, shoes, a cap and a soccer ball.
It's… very elaborate.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Er ...

text.ACTION: I had already figured out the only possible answer.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/3-P4-00025.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Er ...
I-I made it ...
Y-Y'got a problem with that ... ?
If ya think it's so creepy, then give it-

text.Doll Boy: Hey, can you make me something else!? Mom loves this kind of stuff!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh? S-Sure ...

text.Doll Boy: I'm gonna go give this to Sana-chan! Thanks, Mister!!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I'm not that old, dammit ...
Hah, he said I'm cool ...

text.ACTION: Kanji certainly does good work.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/4-P4-00040.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Yeah, but it's not like sewing's good for anything ...

text.ACTION: Kanji seems embarrassed…

text.Kanji Tatsumi: But y'know ...  It ain't a bad feeling.
"Thanks," huh ... ?
Ahhh, it was nothing.

text.ACTION: Kanji, with his embarrassed smile, looks more mature than usual…
You feel your relationship with Kanji has grown yet deeper…
I mean when you're that good at something, you should stick with it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/5-P4-00048.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: ... This is a great place, huh? The wind is different up here ...
Never noticed before.

text.ACTION: You talked with Kanji for a while and started back home.
I'm reading a book on men throughout history, it's kinda cool I guess.
Um, today was eventful. You could say that.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/6-P4-00052.jpg

text.Mr. Kondo: ... Oh man, I'm sooo hungry. Did you all eat breakfast?
I did, but it's already digested! I'm so hungry, even after eating lunch!
I feel like I haven't eaten in ten years!
Say, that reminds me. What figure of speech am I using when I say I haven't eaten in ten years?
... Yosuke! Take a wild guess!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Huh!? A g-guess ... ? How'd he get to this from breakfast?
Hey, Souji ...  Do you know?

text.ACTION: Here's an example: Yosuke is a million years behind in English!
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/8-P4-00060.jpg

text.Mr. Kondo: Good guess, Yosuke! Hyperbole is just a gross exaggeration.
We use it all the time when we're not even thinking about it to emphasize what we're saying.
I don't even want to imagine having to go ten years without eating ...
Thanks, Souji. You're awesome!

text.ACTION: Daisuke was out in the hall, so I asked him Ai's question.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/9-P4-00066.jpg

text.Daisuke Nagase: ... What? Do I have something on my face or something?

text.ACTION: You told Daisuke that Ai Ebihara wanted to know his type…

text.Daisuke Nagase: Huh? My type?
Hmmm ...  Someone who's a nice person ...  I guess.
... Why you gotta ask me things like that!?

text.ACTION: I reported back to Ai.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/11-P4-00072.jpg

text.Ai Ebihara: C-Come with me.

text.ACTION: Ai looks almost happy…
We went up to the roof, she didn't want to talk about it down there.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2065/13-P4-00076.jpg
Ai yanked your arm all the way up here…

text.Ai Ebihara: S-So, did you ask him ...  what kind of girl he likes?

text.ACTION: You told Ai about Daisuke's type… "Nice girls."

text.Ai Ebihara: ... "Nice"?
He didn't say anything about being cute? Not even like, "a beautiful woman" or anything like that?

text.ACTION: Ai looks almost panicked…

text.Ai Ebihara: B-But, every guy wants to be with a pretty girl, right? It's the good-looking girls who find love, isn't it!?
Forget this, I'm tired of beating around the bush. Just go ask him if he's got a crush on anyone.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Kunino-Sagiri

This is by far the hardest boss we've encountered so far. He starts out pretty simply by throwing around single and multi-target -dyne level spells. There's no rhyme or reason to what he'll use in this phase, and it's pretty simple. When you take off a bit of his health, things will get a whole lot more complicated.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2080/38-P4-00128.jpg

Once you see this taunt, he'll start using his first unique ability, Quad Converge. When you see Quad Converge come up, things are about to get interesting. What Quad Converge does is powers up one element while weakening all of the others. The tricky thing is that there's no way of knowing which one he's powered up until he actually attacks. You should strongly consider guarding through the Quad Converge until you know what element he's going to use, because it can do ruinous damage. So what we'd ideally like is to have personas that repel each element, because his own reflected spells will trash the hell out of him. What you need to be careful of is what happens to me in the video. I sort of went 'all-in' on him at some point Quad Converging fire, and he never did. This drags the phase out horribly. If he's not cooperating, your best bet is to just drag him down as best you can while keeping your party healed so you can go all-out when Quad Converge runs out and he has to renew it. You might think things are as bad as they can be. You are wrong.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2080/39-P4-00130.jpg

And when you see that, he'll take control of one of your party members for a few turns. While they 'can' use all of their abilities, in practice they'll mostly use physicals. The biggest risk early on is that he'll still be Quad Converging for a while. You just need to keep on track and drag him down as much as you can each turn, because when you get him a bit farther down, it gets even more terrible.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2080/40-P4-00133.jpg

And then he uses Control on all three of your allies. The good news is he'll totally switch to Attacks himself at this point. What you really need to do is have some kind of Persona that is immune to physical attacks you can switch into. What you need to do in this phase is just survive for a few turns like this. Then his control will break, and he'll move into his last phase. You know he's in the last phase because he'll just cast this every turn:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2080/41-P4-00136.jpg

This is basically him spamming Megidoloan each turn. You just need to keep healed while throwing everything you've got at him and take him down before he takes you down. Use SP restoring items if you have to, that's why you've got them. And remember, this one's for Nanako!
PS- Kunino-Sagiri is the Japanese goddess of fog.

"More and more citizens are calling for an investigation into the cause of the fog and the facts about it ...
"Thought the government has begun its preliminary investigation, many feel that the causes will be hard to pinpoint ... "
Huh ...  Is this fog really dangerous?

" ... The suspect was having an affair with the first victim. It seems she was killed due to relationship troubles.
"Also in April, Ms. Saki Konishi's body was discovered. The police are looking into a motive for the murder.
"In July, a boy living in Inaba performed a copycat murder.

"Last month, the suspect attempted to kidnap a seven-year-old girl of Inaba, resulting in his arrest ... "

https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/36-P4-00099.jpg

I'm sure your uncle can ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: But ...  the stuff he was saying was so obviously nuts.
If he says anything about the TV world, he might be considered mentally unstable ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: Also, I heard before that if the police don't have enough hard evidence, it's difficult to build a case.

text.Naoto Shirogane: Yes ...  There are many such cases and culprits. It's the eternal conundrum for crime investigators ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: So even if they're caught ...  the law can't do shit?

text.Naoto Shirogane: ... It's a possibility.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Hell's up with that!?
We all know he did it ...
You can't just let a maniac who thinks he's saving people by killing them run wild on the streets!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: They better not dismiss something this serious because of some mental issues ...
Saki-senpai ...
No ...  Not just her, or that announcer ...  Even King Moron is his fault.
If it weren't for what he did, nobody would've tried a copycat killing.
It's his fault Nanako-chan's in the hospital right now, too ...

text.ACTION: That reminded me of the promise I'd made to Nanako before Namatame kidnapped her.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/37-P4-00118.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: What's the matter?

text.ACTION: You told the others about your promise with Nanako…

I know Nanako-chan would be psyched if she came home and found a new kotatsu!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dude, why didn't you tell me sooner? The winter season's coming up, and we just got a bunch of 'em in stock!
Alright, off to the housewares section! For Nanako-chan!

text.ACTION: They had some really nice ones.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/38-P4-00126.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: It's a cliché because it's true, dammit.

text.Naoto Shirogane: The best complement to a kotatsu would be a heated rug.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dude, that much juice would kill the breaker the moment you tried to microwave something.
Oh yeah, you've never used a kotatsu before, huh Ted? It's nice and toasty.

text.Teddie: Can I still stay here ... ?
You kept your promise to me ...  So I should be going back ...
But I don't want to go until Nana-chan gets better.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Of course you can stay. How many times do we have to say this before it gets through to you?

text.Chie Satonaka: Nanako-chan would be sad if you weren't there when she wakes up.

text.Teddie: B-But ...  I couldn't save Nana-chan ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Don't be silly. We saved her together.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: We caught the killer, man. We couldn'ta done that without you.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Teddie, you shouldn't talk that way when Nanako-chan is still fighting.

text.Teddie: You guys ...

text.ACTION: Teddie keeps talking like he's going away. It's worrying…

text.Teddie: Sensei ...  I'm so touched!
I'll stay by your side until Nanako-chan comes home, Sensei!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, that's right ...  There's no one but you at your place.

text.Chie Satonaka: Hey, why don't we pick out a Christmas present for Nanako-chan while we're at it?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Oh, that's a great idea! I'm sure she'll be out of the hospital by then.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Alright, but none of this "charge it to Yosuke" stuff this time. Seriously. We're clear on this, right?

text.Chie Satonaka: Aw come on, why would we do something like that?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dude, the clothes you got for this guy? I almost pissed my pants when I saw the receipt!
How many days you think I had to work to pay that off!?

text.Chie Satonaka: Well, I can't help it if Junes overcharges for things.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Urgh ... !
Well, I guess you gotta expect that ...  It's not like Chie-san's ever had the occasion to help a guy shop before.

text.Chie Satonaka: Wha--!? What did you just say!?

text.Teddie: C'mon, baby. Don't fight over me ...
Stay outta this!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Stay outta this!

text.Chie Satonaka: Stay outta this!

text.Yukiko Amagi: Snrk ...  Heeheeheehee ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Let's leave them be and think of a present for Nanako-chan on our own.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: But what would a girl her age want ... ?

text.ACTION: I decided we couldn't go wrong with Jack Frost.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/40-P4-00161.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Yeah, that white, round shape's the best. A plush doll's the way to go!

text.Chie Satonaka: Yesss! And we'll bake the cake!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Of course!

text.Yukiko Amagi: Let's make it a cake to remember.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh no you're not! Are you trying to send Nanako-chan back to the hospital!?

https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/41-P4-00168.jpg

Nanako-chan's condition suddenly got worse ...
The doctor wants you to come to the hospital immediately ...  We'll be waiting.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: C-C'mon, let's go!

text.ACTION: We rushed down to the hospital as fast as we could get there. We even had to push past some of those goddamn gas mask crazies.

Dojima is listening to an explanation from the doctor…
There have been loud voices throughout the hospital for some time now…

They said so on TV! Isn't there a vaccine or something for it!?

Are you just going to stand there and watch us die!?

text.Chie Satonaka: What a commotion ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: What the hell's that supposed to mean!? Can't you see how much pain she's in!?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I don't give a damn about myself! Do something about Nanako-
Nngh ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dojima-san!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Just save her ...  For god's sake, please save Nanako ...

text.Doctor: ... We'll do our best.
I must ask you to step outside for the time being.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Nanako ...

text.ACTION: We couldn't do anything but stand around outside Nanako's room. Everyone else was so upset, I don't know. Seeing them like that just made me even more certain I had to keep my head in the game, no matter what happened.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/45-P4-00194.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: This all has to do with the world you came from! Can't you figure something out!?

text.Teddie: I'm thinking ...  I'm thinking, but ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Dammit! Why does this have to happen to a little girl like her ... !?
How'm I supposed to stay calm at a time like this!?
Can't believe this is happening ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Nanako-chan's gonna be okay ...  right?

text.Tohru Adachi: You guys still here?

text.Naoto Shirogane: How is Dojima-san doing?

text.Tohru Adachi: His wound's opened up again. They're treating it over in his room now.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Any luck with your investigation of Namatame ... ?

text.ACTION: Either Adachi's just a retard or he's intentionally fucking with us. I'm not goddamn sure but it's just bullshit all the stuff he comes out and says.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/46-P4-00206.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: I won't mince words here ...  We're gonna have a hard time making these charges stick.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What's that mean?

text.Tohru Adachi: I talked with the guys at the station, and it'll be next to impossible to find him guilty in court.
Especially given the reason why we took him off our list of suspects for the first case ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh yeah ...  something about him having an alibi ...

text.Tohru Adachi: Yeah, that. And the whole angle about him putting people into TVs ...  There's no way that'll stand up in court.
No one would believe that ...
What the public wants is when, where, and how Namatame killed these people.
And Dojima-san knows it ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Well, ain't you calm about this.

text.Tohru Adachi: I-I'm just telling you the truth.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: And you call yourself a cop!? Huh!?
If you wanna see that stuff so bad, we'll show you! Hurry up and bring a TV here, dammit!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Hey, stop-

text.Kanji Tatsumi: What the ... ?

text.ACTION: The nurse ran out…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/47-P4-00222.jpg

text.Nurse: Hurry inside! Please talk to her!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What the hell ... ? What's going on!?

text.Yukiko Amagi: No ...  Nanako-chan ...

text.ACTION: Nanako looked weaker than ever.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/48-P4-00226.jpg

text.Doctor: Nanako-chan ...  Nanako-chan. Can you hear us? Do you understand what we're saying?
Your big brother's here with you. Just hang in there.
Where's Dojima-san!?

text.Nurse: We're calling for him right now!

text.ACTION: Outside…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/50-P4-00234.jpg
But Dojima…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/51-P4-00235.jpg
He didn't make it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2089/52-P4-00243.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Nanako!
Nanako ... ?

text.Doctor: I'm sorry, Sir ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dammit ...
DAMMIT!!

text.Kanji Tatsumi: AAAAAGHH!!

text.Naoto Shirogane: Nanako-chan ...

Huh? What's wrong, everyone ... ?
Huh ... ? Wait ...  I-Is Nanako-chan ... ?
B-But then ...  where did Dojima-san go? His room isn't that way-
Wait a sec, that's the way to ... !

text.ACTION: We ran out when I heard Rise calling for us.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/6-P4-00012.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Dojima-san might've gone after Namatame!
Adachi-san said he was admitted to this hospital!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You transported him to the same hospital!? For crying out loud, he's the suspect in the case!

text.Tohru Adachi: Wh-What are you getting mad at me for? This is the biggest hospital, and he's in no condition to be moved ...
I-I can't tell you that.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Just tell us where he is already!
Dojima-san's on his way, ain't he? You don't know what he's gonna do there if we don't stop him!

text.Chie Satonaka: Kanji-kun, you don't mean ...

text.Tohru Adachi: H-Hold on ...  Just what are you guys talking about ... ?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Cought it up! Where's his room!?

text.Tohru Adachi: Urgh ...  T-Top floor in the second surgical ward, furthest room back ...
B-But ...  there's a police guard ...

text.ACTION: Meanwhile…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/10-P4-00028.jpg

text.Teddie: I was always watching over Nana-chan ...  And I still couldn't save her ...
It happened in my world ...
Even though I was the only Teddie in that place ...  I ...
I still couldn't do anything ...

text.ACTION: Elsewhere…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/12-P4-00035.jpg

text.Policeman: Like we said, without permission ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Permission ... ?
Who gave him permission to kill Nanako? Tell me that, huh?
The hell with you all ... !
Why is he still alive when Nanako's dead!?
Give me back Nanako ...  Give her back! She's ...  She's all I have ... !
She's ...  the only one ...  in the world ...
Let go of me ...  I need to ...

text.Tohru Adachi: Holy crap! Dojima-san!
Quick, get him to his room! I'll go alert the doctors!

text.ACTION: We saw Dojima, Adachi, and the guards go by as we approached Namatame's room.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/14-P4-00047.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: His only daughter's dead ...  Nothing woulda surprised me.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dojima-san probably knew ...  that there's little to no chance Namatame would be convicted ...
Dammit ...  He killed Senpai, and now Nanako-chan ...
And the bastard's gonna walk away without paying for what he did ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: That's not right ... !

text.Rise Kujikawa: Why ... ? Why is he the one that gets to go on living?

text.ACTION: We heard a thump from Namatame's room, and rushed in.

The window in the room is wide open…

text.Taro Namatame: I-I was scared ...  So I ...  I ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You have your life ...  and now you want your freedom, too!?

text.Chie Satonaka: It's your fault that Nanako-chan's ... !

text.Taro Namatame: I-I, I didn't, I ...

text.ACTION: That's when the bullshit started. The TV came on, it must have been midnight.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/18-P4-00063.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Hey, isn't this ... !?

text.Kunino Sagiri: I failed to save her. It's because you got in my way.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Another Namatame ... !?
How!? The real one's right here, and we already beat his Shadow ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: No ...  Come to think of it, Namatame never faced his other self.
And we didn't witness his Shadow returning to his body as a Persona, either ...
Perhaps that's why we're seeing this now ...

text.Taro Namatame: What ...  the ...

text.Kunino Sagiri: I failed. But it wasn't my fault.
And the law can't touch me anyway ...

text.Taro Namatame: Wh-What ... !?

text.Chie Satonaka: Is that what's Namatame's really thinking!?
Then ...  he wasn't deranged or anything ...  He knew what he was doing ... !

text.Yosuke Hanamura: To hell with the law ...  I won't ever forgive what you did ... !

text.Taro Namatame: Th-This ...  Please ...  Stop ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Huh? Stop what? We ain't even done anything yet ...
Or do you want us to do something ... ? Something fitting for a bastard like you!

text.Rise Kujikawa: K-Kanji ...

text.ACTION: Some things were already starting to bother me, though. Like how the hell we were talking with the goddamn TV, when before we were never able to interact with anything on the Midnight Channel.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/20-P4-00083.jpg

text.Kunino Sagiri: I don't care either way. Living or dying makes no difference to me.
But you ...  You're different. (chuckle) You can't do such a thing. You wouldn't dare, right?
(chuckle) I'll continue "saving" people ...  It's my mission ... !

text.Yukiko Amagi: Mission ... !?

text.Naoto Shirogane: My god ...

text.Taro Namatame: P-Please stop ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: He wants us to stop. What should we do?

text.Chie Satonaka: Wh-What do you mean ... ?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: We can't let this bastard do whatever he pleases.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Still ...  What are you going to do?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: No way I'm going to walk out of here doing nothing ...

text.Chie Satonaka: I-I understand, but ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: This must be a luxury suite. Most hospital wards don't have such large televisions ...
Why, with something like this in the room, this man could escape at any time ...
Although once he enters ...  he may find there's no way out ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Wait a second! Y-You don't mean ...
Are you ...  serious ... ?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: You just gonna turn your back and walk away?

text.Rise Kujikawa: That's ...  But ... !

text.Chie Satonaka: Wh-What's gotten into you guys!?

text.ACTION: But I was already damned sure of one thing. I wasn't going to let someone get murdered because of what some goddamn TV said. That's not what Nanako would want.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/21-P4-00104.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Chie!
Everyone ...  Listen to me.
If we're gonna do this ...  now is our only shot. We won't get a second chance.
At this rate, the guy's gonna get off the hook ...  And he'll go around "saving" people again!
You just heard what this bastard's really thinking!
If that happens, it'll be just like Nanako-chan and Senpai ...  Who knows how many innocent people will die this time?
I can't let something like that go ...
Someone close to me died ...  Her killer can't be convicted ...  And now I'm gonna let the same thing happen again?
There's no way I can to that! It's just wrong, isn't it!?

text.Chie Satonaka: B-But ...  Yosuke ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: All we have to do is push him inside the TV ...  That's it. We do that one thing, and this is all over.

text.Chie Satonaka: J-Just ...  push him inside ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: If any of you want no part in this, just leave the room. I'm not gonna force you to stay.
As for me, nothing could make me forgive this bastard ...  But before we do this, I want to hear what you think.
What do you want to do ...  Leader?

text.ACTION: Besides, if we don't figure out why this fog is covering Inaba how many people might die? Namatame's our only lead.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/22-P4-00120.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: We don't have time to wait! If we don't do this now, the cops'll come back!
What're you trying to say!?

text.ACTION: And anyway, even if we do listen to that Shadow, it said something that bothered me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/23-P4-00123.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Something we don't know ... ? What don't we know!?

text.ACTION: Because Nanako died, and Namatame knew that.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/24-P4-00125.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: But we just heard the guy's true feelings on TV!
What didn't you understand!?

text.ACTION: So why did he say he failed to save her?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/25-P4-00128.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Well, what is it!?
I already told you, there's no time to waste!
Are you even getting at something here, or are you just stalling!?

text.ACTION: But Yosuke was really freaking the hell out, and wasn't thinking straight.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/26-P4-00132.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Missing ... ? Like what, exactly?
Dammit ...  I've heard enough of this bullshit! Give me a straight answer!
Are we doing this or not!? That's all I give a damn about right now!

text.ACTION: He just wasn't listening to reason, so I kind of lost my cool.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/27-P4-00136.jpg
You yelled at everyone to calm down.

text.Taro Namatame: Nnngh ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: H-He's right. L-Let's all calm down for a second.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I'm perfectly calm.

text.Chie Satonaka: Hey, what did you mean by "we're missing something" ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What's there to miss with a sick bastard like him!?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Hey, let's all take a deep breath.
After what happened to Nanako-chan, and seeing Dojima-san ...  we're not thinking straight right now.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Tch ...  Fine ...

text.ACTION: Everyone took a deep breath.
It seems that everyone has finally regained their composure…

text.Naoto Shirogane: You're right ...  We should calm down and think rationally about this ...
I realize now that we've heard almost nothing from Namatame's perspective ...
There's no denying that this man brought great harm to Nanako-chan ...
But other than that point, the rest comes from our assumptions based on watching the Midnight Channel a moment ago.
I won't deny that we were blinded by the heat of the moment ...  trying to impute all responsibility to him rashly.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: But ... !

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah, the guy's not saying anything.

text.ACTION: I can understand why Yosuke's so adamant about this, but none of it makes sense. I'm not going to disgrace Nanako's memory by killing a guy when there's still questions to be answered.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It was him who put Senpai through that misery ...
How can we possibly understand someone who says killing people is the same as "saving" them!?

text.Naoto Shirogane: Failing to understand and failing to listen are rather different things.
Truthfully, not all the hitches that were nagging at me have been answered yet.
We'll have to see what he can tell us about them ...
... Though it appears he's in no condition to do so at the moment.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: True ...  Dealing with him right now might not solve all the things that are bothering us ...
Dammit ...
But you better remember this ...  I'll do everything I can to stop him from repeating what he's done.
Anytime, anywhere ...  anything.

text.ACTION: If Namatame ever did get away, if he ever did try to throw someone else into the TV world, I can tell you this much: Yosuke wouldn't get a chance to do anything. Even if we're misunderstanding things, what he did was still horrible beyond words.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/29-P4-00168.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Geez ...  How the hell can you stay so calm, man?
Then again, that's why you're our leader ...
Alright. Let's go ahead and think this through as much as we need.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: If we leave any unanswered questions behind, we'll just be lying to ourselves ...
Yeah, that ain't gonna cut it ...  Alright, I'm convinced.

text.Rise Kujikawa: (sigh) Thank you ...
I'll think as hard as I can, and try to help!

text.Chie Satonaka: We all know how you feel, Yosuke!
C'mon, we've accomplished this much together, haven't we?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Right ...  Together.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah ...
Yeah, you're right.
Sorry ...  and thanks.

It seems that you will go on with your friends to solve another mystery…
One door closes…

https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2090/31-P4-00186.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Hey ...  you guys!? What're you doing!? You can't be in here!

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh crap!

Mayumi ...  Where are you ... ?

I caused her so much trouble ...  I wanted to at least apologize to her, but I couldn't even do that ...
I lost the will and energy to do anything ...
Then one day, the rumor I heard some time ago came back to me.
Since I had nothing better to do, I sat down blankly in front of the TV and watched my own reflection ...

Mayumi ... ? Is that you?

She looked like she was calling for help, just like Mayumi.
