text.Ryotaro Dojima: What's gotten into you today ... ? It's odd to see you taking work so seriously ...

text.Tohru Adachi: C-C'mon, I'm always giving 110% when it comes to the job!
You should get back to work too, Dojima-san. Your current assignment: Get better as soon as possible!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: What are you all doing here?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: We came to confirm something ...  with Adachi-san.

text.ACTION: You should question Adachi…
I mean if he was really at the Amagi Inn when Ms. Yamano vanished, that's strike one.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/17-P4-00097.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: The time the announcer went missing ... ?
I can't say for sure offhand ...  It's not like I saw her or anything.
That was months and months ago, too. My memory's kinda hazy that far back ...

text.ACTION: You should question Adachi…
And if he was really bringing Saki in for questioning more than he needed to, that's strike two.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/18-P4-00102.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Why wouldn't I question her? She discovered the announcer's body.
But she didn't know much about it, so I only talked with her once or twice.
Was that all you wanted to ask? Well, I hope it helped.

text.ACTION: There is still something you need to question Adachi about…
Then I asked the real winner.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/19-P4-00107.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Warning letter?

text.Naoto Shirogane: The one that was delivered to his house. It's in police custody now, correct?

text.Tohru Adachi: Uhh ...  I don't really remember.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Hey, whaddya mean you don't remember?
I gave it to you to take down to the crime lab for processing. You're telling me you forgot!?

text.Tohru Adachi: Ha ...  haha, I'm sorry ...
Your accident was right after that, and what with one thing and another, it sorta slipped my mind ...
B-Besides, that thing was just a prank, wasn't it?
Geez, what're you asking me all this for!?
For crying out loud, what's this all supposed to be about!?
Dojima-san, you really need to get back to your bed. That's why your wounds aren't healing.
And you all need to go home right now! Do you have any idea what time it is!?
I'm going back ...  I need to get to the station and report in.

text.Naoto Shirogane: Just one more thing, please.
We know for certain now that the first two murders weren't Namatame's doing.
Someone else killed them.
Adachi-san ...  Do you have any idea who that might be?

text.Tohru Adachi: I-I have no idea what you're talking about ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: 'Cause we think it mighta been you.

text.Tohru Adachi: What!? Th-That's ridiculous!

text.ACTION: And that's when he struck out.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/20-P4-00128.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: What did you just say ... ?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Put them all in ... ?
What's this "putting them in" business?
Do you know something about the method behind their murders ... ?
Don't tell me that all that talk about TVs and whatnot from before was ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: I see ...  Now I finally understand.
To tell the truth, Adachi-san, I've been fixated on something you once said.
Before, I didn't know why ...  Only that it sounded a wrong note to me.
Do you recall when I read Namatame's diary at the scene of Dojima-san's accident?
At the time, I said, "Even the victims who survived and were never released to the public are written here."
And in response, your words were, "Wow ...  Then that settles it."
How, I wonder, would that "settle" anything?
At the time, the police had no idea that there had been other attempted murders related to the case ...
You had no reason to say such a thing.
After all, there are countless examples of people disappearing for a few days ...
Yet when I read the list of names, you raised no objection. Odd, that.
What do you say to that, Detective Adachi?

text.Tohru Adachi: I-I don't know!
I-I said I'm busy ... !

text.ACTION: And Adachi charged through before we could stop him!
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/21-P4-00148.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Adachi ...  Ngh ...  Dammit ...
Adachi!!

text.ACTION: We lost track of Adachi around Namatame's former room.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/22-P4-00151.jpg
Adachi isn't here either…

text.Yosuke Hanamura: What the ... !? I swear he ran this way ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Dammit ...  Where the hell'd he go?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Did you find him ... ?
I contacted security ...  Nobody's seen Adachi, and there's no record of anyone leaving this area.
So he must be still in this ward somewhere ...

text.Chie Satonaka: He's still here ... ? But we looked ...  We didn't find him anywhere ...

text.Ryotaro Dojima: That bastard ...
Ungh ...

text.Nurse: For heaven's sake, what are we going to do with you ... !?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Sorry. I got carried away ...

text.Nurse: Do you even want to get better!? If you keep this up, there could be lasting damages!
Have you forgotten how much trouble it caused you last time!?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: You're right ...  Sorry ...
You've got to find Adachi. I need to square this away with him ...  Please.

text.ACTION: There was only one place he could have gone.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/23-P4-00169.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Yeah, I think so.
If he's the killer, he can go through, right?

text.Rise Kujikawa: You mean he went in through here?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: We searched every inch in the direction he ran off ...  There's nowhere to hide. I don't think we coulda missed him.

text.Naoto Shirogane: He was cornered ...  It's highly probable that he escaped there.
If he does indeed turn up on the other side, hat should prove beyond a doubt that he is the true culprit.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Damn, so I guess we were right ...  What do we do now?

text.Rise Kujikawa: I think it's too dangerous to go in from here.
We're not 100% positive he used this TV, and on top of that, we don't know where it might lead.
Let's go in from Junes, like always.
It'll be fine. So long as we're ready for him, we'll crush that jerk in one strike.

text.ACTION: The extremely suspicious detective, Adachi…
You've taken another step towards the truth…
I still can't quite believe it, but one thing's for sure: Adachi's the real killer.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2094/24-P4-00184.jpg
You split up for today and you all went back home…
We're getting together tomorrow to try and track him down. Hopefully we can bring an end to this soon.
Another night interrupted by the Velvet Room, but this time something was… different.
VIDEO- "Ted"
This…
It seems that you've come to the Velvet Room in your dreams again…
But something is different this time… You don't see Igor or Margaret…
Teddie is sitting here, not noticing your presence…

text.Teddie: Where ...  am I ... ?
Sensei? Why are you here ... ?

text.ACTION: How do I answer a question that I'm asking myself every time I show up in this place?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/3-P4-00008.jpg

text.Teddie: I see ...  How mysterious ...
There are so many things I don't know about.
But I did realize something ...
I've been thinking all this time ...  about who I really am.
But I couldn't find the answer ...  I was "no one" from the start ...
Humans live in the other world, and Shadows live in this world ...
From the beginning ...  that's all there was to it.
I was just a Shadow in that world ...

text.ACTION: I was concerned with what Teddie was saying, but I was more concerned that he come home.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/4-P4-00017.jpg

text.Teddie: You're always so kind, Sensei ...
I figured something out ...
That day at the hospital, I realized that I really can't do anything.
As soon as I thought that, I lost consciousness ...  Then when I woke up, I was inside the fog.
Shadows can't stay in the human world ...  They aren't allowed.
I walked and walked, but there was nothing all around me ...
Just when I started thinking that I couldn't go anywhere, I heard the noise of a car ...
And then I was here ...
I remember lots of things now ...
My world is a place shaped by human thoughts ...
One day, a Shadow living in that world awakened to human emotions.
But humans and Shadows are completely different entities ...
So he made himself forget that he was a Shadow ...
He wanted to forget ...
He wanted people to like him ...
And that's how he came to look like this ...
I really am stupid ...
What the other Teddie said before ...  In the end, it was all true.
No matter how much I searched for myself, I have no self ...
There was no me to begin with ...

text.ACTION: How could Teddie have been the same as the Shadows we've been fighting?
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/5-P4-00038.jpg

text.Teddie: It would've been better if I had never remembered, but I did ...
I'll ...  probably turn back into a regular Shadow soon ...
Oh yeah, Sensei.
One day, when you meet Nana-chan in heaven ...  Apologize for me ...
Tell her ...  I'm sorry I couldn't do anything ...
Tell her I'm really sorry ...

text.ACTION: Even if he was, though, he needed to know the truth.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/6-P4-00045.jpg

text.Teddie: Huh ... ? R-Really!?

text.ACTION: You told Teddie about how Nanako came through.

text.Teddie: Nana-chan's ...
Wow ...  That's wonderful ...
I'm so glad ...
Glad that I could at least hear that ...
Heehee ...  My heart feels so much lighter now ...  I'm starting to feel sleepy ...
What a strange place ...  It feels so soothing ...
It's not like my world ...  Something just feels so nostalgic about this place ...
Could this be your dream world, Sensei ... ?

text.ACTION: That's probably as good a description as Igor's ever given me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/7-P4-00056.jpg

text.Teddie: Aha ...
But ...  I wonder why I met you here ...
What am I supposed to do now ...
But ...  I don't know what to look for or how to find it ...
No matter how hard I think, there's too many things my little brain can't understand ...
But I do understand one thing now ...  I'm glad that I met you, Sensei.

text.ACTION: You can sense Teddie's pure and deep gratitude.
I was already getting even more worried about him.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/9-P4-00065.jpg
I just had to trust that Teddie would come to his senses and return.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/10-P4-00066.jpg

text.Teddie: But I have to get going ...
This is your place ...  It doesn't seem like somewhere that I'd be allowed to stay ...
Goodbye ...  Sensei ...

text.ACTION: The world flashed, and the Velvet Room's familiar inhabitants were revealed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/11-P4-00070.jpg

text.Igor: Hmm ...  It seems the words in your memory weren't the only things you summoned here.
This is a room for guests who have an ego that can be nurtured ...
Shadows-mere fragments broken off from the ego-have no place here.
The water's strength has moved a single stone that had stopped, returning it once again into the flow ...
(chuckle) Very interesting.

text.ACTION: Igor has a meaningful smile on his face…

text.Igor: Well, now ...  It's about time we departed once again.
This vehicle is still on its journey ...  There is no reason to tarry here for long.
... Margaret?

text.Margaret: We're ready to go. Let us depart.

text.Igor: (chuckle) You are every inch the guest I had anticipated.
Now, it's time for you to return.
(chuckle) I am even more intrigued now as to where this is all headed.

text.Margaret: We'll be waiting for your next visit.

text.ACTION: I woke up, and headed down to Junes to meet up with the others.
VIDEO- "Return"

text.Yosuke Hanamura: No, and no one's seen him either.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Ooh, that annoying little furball! Just when we're at a turning point in the case, too!

text.Naoto Shirogane: We have no choice. Let's pursue Adachi for now.

text.ACTION: The fog in the TV world was thicker than ever, and we couldn't find Adachi.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/18-P4-00090.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: What the ... ? There's this malicious aura everywhere ...  It feels completely different from the last time I was here ...
I think we'd better hurry.
Give me a sec to try finding Adachi.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Does this mean both this world and ours are getting messed up?

text.Yukiko Amagi: Our glasses work on the fog on the other side. It can't be normal ...
And I heard more people are falling ill because of the fog.
I wonder what's going to happen.

text.Rise Kujikawa: I sense him! Adachi's definitely in here!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Are you serious!? Which way!?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Hold on ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: So he did come to this side ...
Well, that settles it. There's virtually no doubt remaining that he's the true culprit.
Once we capture him, solving the mystery of this world and the rest of the case can't be far behind.

text.Chie Satonaka: Then ...  maybe we'll find out where Teddie came from, too.
Man, where is that bear, anyway ... ?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Well ...  I can say for sure he's not here.
And I know Adachi is here, but I can't track him down myself ...
Gee, Ted! Why aren't you here when we need you most!?

text.ACTION: Meanwhile…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/21-P4-00109.jpg

text.Teddie: I see ...
I ...  came back ...
But it really doesn't matter... I'm completely useless ...
Nana-chan ...  I'm so sorry ...

text.Nanako: I heard ...  my big bro ...  and everyone else, too ...

text.Teddie: N-Nana-chan!?
Hold on, I'll get the doctor!

text.Doctor: It seems she's asleep again ...

text.Teddie: U-Um, Nana-chan told me that she heard my voice ...
She heard me say, "hang in there" ...

text.Doctor: It could be that her frankly miraculous recovery was because everyone's voices reached her.
Even unconscious people are capable of hearing other's voices.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/24-P4-00127.jpg

text.Teddie: Everyone ...

text.Doctor: In any case, there are too many things we don't understand about her condition and what caused it ...
We're doing our best, but it's difficult when everything about her illness is a total unknown.

text.Teddie: Unknown ...

text.Doctor: Well, if anything happens, please send for me ...

text.Teddie: If I'm an unknown being, then the way I can change is unknown, too ...
So all I have to do ...  is make them not-unknown.
Nana-chan's doing her best ...  Sensei and the others are probably fighting now too ...
I'm just a Shadow, but Nana-chan cheered up when she heard my voice ...
So what if I'm just a Shadow ... !? There must be something I can do!
I can't just give up thinking about things ...
That's why I came back here. Right, Nana-chan ... ?

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/25-P4-00141.jpg
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/26-P4-00142.jpg
Kinotki-Douji has transfigured into Kamui!

text.Teddie: Right! I need to get back to the others!
Hang in there, Nana-chan. I'll be back soon!

text.ACTION: No matter how hard Rise tried, she just couldn't seem to find Adachi.
VIDEO- "Ted's Secret"

text.Chie Satonaka: Rise-chan ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: If only Teddie was with us ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Didn't he say his nose is practically useless now? Could he even help us find that bastard?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Haha, nope. He'd be no help at all.
But he was always there to support me whenever ...

text.Chie Satonaka: That bear's a loudmouth, but he's nice to have around. He's always so full of energy ...

text.Naoto Shirogane: He's lighthearted, and always optimistic ...

text.ACTION: Rise's strength was starting to give out, and we had to stop for the day.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/29-P4-00154.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: The fog's so dense ...  It's hard to see through it ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Why don't we call it a day? It won't do us any good if you collapse.

text.Naoto Shirogane: I agree. If Rise-san became fatigued, even if we found Adachi, our capacity in battle would be reduced.
Moreover, it's almost nighttime ...  We should return to our world for the present.

text.ACTION: We headed back out to Junes, feeling defeated.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/30-P4-00159.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: I know he's in there, too ...
What's wrong with me ... ? My powers are completely useless ... !

text.ACTION: But it's always darkest before the dawn.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/31-P4-00162.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Y-Y-You little ...  Where the hell were you!?

text.Teddie: I-I'm sorry ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: You idiot! Bad bear! Bad!
You're so late! Who do you think you are!?
(sob)

text.Teddie: U-Um, R-Rise-chan ...
Are you faking?

text.Rise Kujikawa: No, stupid!

text.Teddie: S-Sorry ... !
I want to help you all again.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: You know how much trouble you caused, y'dumb bear!? Where the hell were you!?

text.Teddie: I'm sorry ...
I figured out a lot of things ...  Stuff about me ...  and that world.
I wanted to tell you all ...

text.ACTION: Teddie laid out all the things he'd told me in the Velvet Room to the group.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/32-P4-00177.jpg
That he was only a Shadow…
And that though he was at his wit's end, he was able to come back to your world…

text.Chie Satonaka: A Shadow ... ? You mean you're one of those things we've been fighting?

text.Teddie: Yup ...  just like the ones you all know about.
Shadows are suppressed human thoughts given form ...
Everyone has them inside.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Wait ...  You say you're a Shadow, but you didn't attack us.
And you kept telling us from the start that you wanted to bring peace and quiet back to that world, right?

text.Teddie: But in the end ...  I was just an ordinary Shadow. Nothing special about me at all.
I did everything I could until now to try and make my world peaceful ...
But instead, the weird fog started seeping out into this world too ...
I'm sorry ...  I'm really sorry. If I really was special, then maybe ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: It's no big deal.
I mean, we weren't expecting much from you in the first place.
And about you being a Shadow, we pretty much figured you were something like that anyway.

text.Teddie: Huh ... ?
Wh-What're you saying!?
Here I am, pouring my heart out to you, and you say you thought I was something like that anyway!?
No normal person would think such a pretty bear could really be a Shadow!

text.ACTION: Teddie was more worried about it than we were I think.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/33-P4-00197.jpg

text.Naoto Shirogane: It's true that you may have been born that way.
But you now possess the power of Persona.
A Shadow is suppressed power ...  Once controlled by the ego, it becomes a Persona ...
Doesn't it follow, then, that you must have developed an ego?
Whether the ego masters its Shadow, or the Shadow awakens to its ego ...
The only difference I see is the order in which the process occurred.

text.Chie Satonaka: Oh! Teddie's practically human, then.

text.Teddie: I-I'm ...  the same as humans ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You keep trying to figure out who you are, just like all of us here.
You can't do much on your own ...  You really aren't that special ...  See? What's so different between you and us?

text.Teddie: (sniff)
Raaaaaaaaawr!
Th-Tha ...  Thank you ...
I-I'm so glad ...  I met you guys ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: the rest of us were pretty much a group of misfits to begin with too, right?
You fit right in, man.

text.ACTION: Yosuke's started talking in the plural, it worries me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/34-P4-00215.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Isn't that just you, Senpai?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey ...  That's not something a detective would say ...  Or an idol, either!
Geez ...  Stop crying, will ya? Now's not the time for that.
While you were gone, we figured out who murdered the announcer and Senpai ...
It was Adachi.

text.Teddie: Huh!?
Adachi!? That total goofball!?
Whoa ...  I didn't notice at all. Looks like I'm pretty blind to that sorta thing ...
Mmm ...
But you all know him ...  If you can't find someone like that, I don't think I can help you ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Like I said, we're not expecting much from ya.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: The main thing is, it's hard to get pumped about this without someone nice 'n fuzzy around.

text.Rise Kujikawa: Yeah, what Kanji said.

text.Teddie: O-Okay ...
Thanks, guys ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Alright, now that the band's back together, let's take it from the top, starting tomorrow!

text.Teddie: It's been a while, but I'll do my best to look for him too! Leave it to Fuzzy!

text.ACTION: You've taken another step toward the truth…
Now there's no way we can lose.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2095/35-P4-00234.jpg
We're going back in tomorrow, we'll find Adachi for sure.
We returned to the TV world after school to search for Adachi.
VIDEO- "The Nose Knows"

text.Teddie: If Rise-chan couldn't find him, I really doubt someone with a dried-up nose like me will be much help ...
Hmm ...  Mmmmmm ...
I do smell Adachy-baby in here, but the fog is completely covering up his scent ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: Teddie ...  You can't do it either?

text.Teddie: Wh-When you look at me with those eyes ...  I get this feeling ...  I've gotta sniff him out no matter what ... !
This is my time to shine! Mm ...  Hrmmm ...
Ooh, I'm getting something!

text.ACTION: It seemed Teddie just needed the right motivation.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/4-P4-00011.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Teddie ... ?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey, quit wandering around! You better not flake out on us again.

text.Teddie: Huh ... ? I sense it from ...  thisaway.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Is it Adachi!?

text.Teddie: Umm ...
How do I put it ...  It's kinda hazy, but at the same time, it feels like I've got a whopper on the line ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: I don't get it ...

text.Teddie: Veeery suspicious ...  This definitely smells.
But that's weird ...
If I remember right, that's where Sensei, Yosuke, and Chie-chan came from when I met them for the first time ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: When we first ... ? Where was that?
Ohhhh ...  You mean that creepy-ass room where all the faces on the posters were cut out?

text.Teddie: Yep ...  there's someone there!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Teddie! You really are amazing!

text.Teddie: I-It was just dumb luck ...  It's because that's where I first sensed Sensei and the others ...
That's why it kinda smelled over there ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Ahh, I see.
Wait ...  did you say it smelled ... ?

text.ACTION: By the way Chie and I have made a pact to never let Yosuke forget this for the rest of his days. It's even going to be on his tombstone.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/9-P4-00030.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Huh ... ? You're saying ...  he peed his pants there!?

text.Yukiko Amagi: E-Eww ... ! I don't wanna hear it!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, you lie so bad! Dude, I did not piss my pants!
Chie! Quit spreading random rumors about stuff like that!

text.Chie Satonaka: Uhhh, well, it happened so long ago ...  My memory's kinda fuzzy, you know ...

text.Teddie: Oookaaay guys, enough fuzziness! Follow me, the master of fuzzy logic!
... Heehee.

text.Yukiko Amagi: S-Snrk ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Haha, I haven't heard you crack up in a while, Yukiko.
... Though I really wonder sometime about your sense of "humor."

text.ACTION: A cheerful mood has returned to the group, thanks to Teddie.
And you've taken another step toward the truth…
We had to return to where our journeys in the TV had started.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/10-P4-00043.jpg
And sure enough Adachi was waiting for us there.
VIDEO- "Adachi's Story"

text.Tohru Adachi: I noticed her first ...  and she just had to run off and have an affair ...

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/13-P4-00046.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Oh ...  it's you guys. You're very persistent ...

text.ACTION: I thought it was best to just get right to the important questions.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/14-P4-00048.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: You're getting on my nerves, kid ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Answer the question!
Did you or did you not throw Ms. Yamano into the TV!?

text.Tohru Adachi: It was an accident. She started struggling ...  What else was I supposed to do?
I called her out to the lobby because I wanted to ask her something. And then she started getting hysterical on me ...

text.ACTION: Adachi was in a talkative mood it seemed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/15-P4-00054.jpg

text.Mayumi Yamano: And what's this "something important" you called me out here for?

text.Tohru Adachi: What they say on the news isn't true, it is?
All that talk about you having an affair and whatnot ...  It's all a lie, right?

text.Mayumi Yamano: Why do I have to explain myself to you ... ?

text.Tohru Adachi: I see ...  So you don't deny it.
You caught my eye, but it turns out you're another worthless bitch ...

text.Mayumi Yamano: D-Don't make me call for help!

text.Tohru Adachi: Ugh, shut up, shut up, shut up.
I think you need to see what it's like to fear for your life ...  It'll get your head straight.
Sh-She fell in ...
Ha ... hahaha ...  Wow ...  So people can go completely inside ...

text.ACTION: Crazy son of a bitch.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/17-P4-00068.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: That ...  happened in our lobby ... ?

text.Tohru Adachi: I learned about the Midnight Channel through some rumor. You hear a lot of fishy stories like that on the force.
But it was pure coincidence that I touched the screen and discovered my power.
I burst out laughing when I found out. I knew right away that this was going to be interesting!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: So you tested it out on Mayumi Yamano.

I was just trying to punish the stupid bitch a little for betraying me.
Yeah, putting them inside the TV was never the plan ...
But y'know, both Mayumi and that dippy high school girl struggled for no reason ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Then you were responsible for Saki-senpai's death ... !

text.Tohru Adachi: Saki ... ? Oh yeah ...  her name was Saki Konishi ...  or something like that.
At first, I just called her in 'cause of work-related stuff. Her being the one who found Mayumi's body and all.
And naturally, if there was any chance she'd seen something, I'd need to know, right?
So I was all set to be a nice guy to her, and then that bitch ...

text.ACTION: Then he just made things worse, creepy fuck.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/18-P4-00083.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Well, we'll get to that. But you know, I saw you this afternoon.
You were getting pretty cozy with that Namatame ...
Huh ...  So I'm not good enough for you?
Well, I know how to deal with girls like you ...
God, these high school girls today. This world's gone straight to shit.
When I was in school, I wasn't allowed to do anything but study my ass off ...
I was supposed to be the best of the best, and instead they stick me in the boonies ...
But I guess I got this sweet power to make up for it.
(chuckle) Life's not so bad after all.
Get on your knees and beg, and maybe I'll let you out!
Yeah, like that'll happen. (chuckle)
As if I'd walk into a deathtrap like that ...

text.ACTION: To have killed her over something like that…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/20-P4-00098.jpg

text.Yosuke Hanamura: You son of a bitch ... !

text.Tohru Adachi: C'mon, gimme a break.
I didn't know it was dangerous inside the TV. It's not like I was trying to kill them.
I mean, I'm sure they hit on Namatame, not the other way around.
A council secretary will one day rise to public office himself. Mayumi and that high schooler were just gold digging.
They got exactly what they deserved. I didn't do anything wrong at all.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Shut the hell up!
You knew from what happened to Mayumi Yamano that people die in here!

text.Tohru Adachi: (sigh)
So what if I knew?

text.ACTION: I had a funny feeling he'd done something to convince Namatame to take the path he did.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/21-P4-00109.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Nah ...  He called the police in the middle of the night, just after they found that Saki girl's body.
The rest of the force had their hands full with the double homicide, and it happened that I was the one who took the call.

text.Naoto Shirogane: Namatame said the police refused to take him seriously ...  You were responsible for that, then.

text.Tohru Adachi: Oh, quite the contrary.
If anyone else had taken the call, sure, but I actually did believe him, y'know ... ?

text.ACTION: The truth was worse than I'd thought.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/23-P4-00115.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: And now you're seeing a girl in a kimono on that weird program, and you think she'll die too. Is that right?
Namatame-san ...  Do you seriously expect us to believe something like that?

text.Taro Namatame: B-But ...  it's true! If there's any way the police can protect her ...

text.Tohru Adachi: Listen ...  There's no way the police are going to make a move based on a fantasy story like that.
It does sound interesting, though ...

text.Taro Namatame: B-But ...

text.Tohru Adachi: Oh, I have an idea ...
If you really want to save her that much ...  Why not do it yourself?
Like ...
You could shelter her somewhere. Some place where no one could find her.

text.Taro Namatame: Where no one could find her ... ?

text.Tohru Adachi: Save her yourself ...  You can do it.
I'm busy, so I'm hanging up now. Bye.

text.ACTION: Even the people he didn't directly kill he'd put in horrible danger.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/25-P4-00130.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: Of all the people who could've received Namatame's call, it ended up being me. Talk about luck!
All I did was give him a little push ...
And he completely bought into his vision of this world. The more people you guys saved, the more he'd kidnap ...
Both sides had the best of intentions, so the game of cat and mouse would never end ...  Haha, it was awesome.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: You gotta be shittin' me ... !

text.Yukiko Amagi: Why ... ? What reasons could you have for doing that!?

text.Tohru Adachi: Reasons ... ? None, really.
I could do it, that's all. And it was fun ...  I guess that's my reason?

text.Chie Satonaka: Y-You murdered people just for the fun of it!?

text.Tohru Adachi: C'mon ...  All I did was put people in here. I didn't murder them.
And Namatame did most of it.
I had nothing to do with any of you.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: You're just dodging the blame!

text.Tohru Adachi: Yeah? Then how would you prove it?
"He put people inside TVs"? Haha, you think the police are that stupid?

text.Teddie: Grrrrr, what a jerkwad ... !

text.Tohru Adachi: I do admit, though. I never though you guys would manage to track me down.
I like that, Games like this gotta have surprises or they get boring fast.

text.ACTION: He thought it was all a game…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/26-P4-00149.jpg

text.Naoto Shirogane: Then ...  you mean to say that Mitsuo Kubo's disappearance was your doing as well?
I did sense something odd in his course of action ...
If he had special powers and wanted attention, why resort to a regular copycat crime?
But that wasn't the case ...  Kubo had no such powers. In fact, he was thrown in by you ...  Am I correct?

text.Tohru Adachi: It had been a while since I last put someone inside the TV, so I really got a kick out of that one.

text.Chie Satonaka: Why did you do that ... ?
And ...  how come Mitsuo didn't say anything about you ... ?

text.Tohru Adachi: Haha, you think that didn't occur to me before I did it? C'mon, I'm a detective.
I let him through to a room at the station with a TV, switched off the lights, and did it quick while he was still startled.
As long as he didn't see me push him in, and no one else did either, no one would believe him ...  even if he survived.
Of course, I don't think the Kubo kid ever figured out what happened, haha.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Wait, the police station ... ?

text.Tohru Adachi: Yeah ...  he turned himself in pretty quick, actually. This was back when we didn't even know enough to issue a search warrant.
But the other officers decided it was just a prank, so they pawned him off on me.
I didn't blame them ...  I mean, a kid coming and saying, "I did it all! It was me"? Who'd believe him?
But it looked bad ...  I didn't think anyone would come forward and take the blame for all the incidents.
The police were desperate to pin it on anyone ...  If this kid really did it, they might have announced the case was closed.

text.ACTION: The worst part is, he threw Kubo in just to continue his game.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/27-P4-00168.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: That's why I told the others I sent him home. I came up with the idea to put him inside the TV on the spot.

text.Yukiko Amagi: The game would be over ... ? You threw him in just so your fun wouldn't end!?

text.Tohru Adachi: You gotta have some excitement in life, don't you agree?

It worked out in the end, though, because good ol' Namatame kept saving people.
I guess the guy started to develop some kinda messiah complex, huh? What an idiot.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: This is all a game to you ...
How dare you murder people ...  murder Saki-senpai for such a stupid reason! You bastard ...  I'll never forgive you!

text.Tohru Adachi: You can keep your forgiveness.

text.ACTION: Adachi's news was chilling.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/28-P4-00182.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Wh-What the hell's he talking about ... ?

text.Tohru Adachi: Wow, you can tell that much?

text.Yukiko Amagi: The Shadows' ...  goal?

text.Tohru Adachi: By the end of the year, Inaba will disappear completely into the fog. Soon, this place will be reality.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Keep your bullshit to yourself.

text.ACTION: Adachi vanished in a flash of light as Kanji swung.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2096/29-P4-00197.jpg

text.Tohru Adachi: I'll be expecting you all ...  We'll put an end to this.

text.Chie Satonaka: Get back here, you ... !!

text.Rise Kujikawa: It felt like ...  he's gained some strong power after coming here.

text.Teddie: Not only that ...  Maybe he got taken over by that power.

text.Yukiko Amagi: So what he said about the two worlds becoming one ...  That's really gonna happen?

text.Chie Satonaka: Didn't he say that it would happen by the end of this year!?
What happens then!?

text.Teddie: I think he means ...  this world will engulf the human world.
The people in town are acting weird. It's like when the Shadows that emerged from people went berserk.
If the fog gets even thicker and this town is completely shut off from the outside world ...

text.Rise Kujikawa: You mean, everyone's gonna turn into Shadows ... !?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Dammit ...  Damn that bastard!

text.ACTION: From this day forward that changes.

text.Ai Ebihara: Thank you, Souji ...  You really are a nice guy.

text.Ai Ebihara: ... After I calmed down, I gave my life some serious thought.
Why do I go on such crazy shopping sprees? Why do I feel the need to be so well dressed all the time?
What makes me want to ditch class? Do I want to stand out so that I'll catch people's eyes?
And ...  why do I always find myself wanting to talk to you?
I always thought that if I couldn't be pretty, I'd be better off dead ...
Nobody likes people who aren't pretty. They hate you. What's the point of life if everybody hates you ... ?
But lately I've been thinking, maybe I'm wrong ...
There's still a lot I don't know ...  I guess I shouldn't be jumping to any conclusions.
And before I realized it, I was crying. I've always made sure not to cry, too, because it makes my eyes swell ...
I pulled back my curtains, and the sun was just coming up ...  The stars were shining so dimly ...
And for some reason, it made me think of you ...
I wonder why ...

I'm fine.
I'm worried about Nanako-chan! And we can't just let him do whatever he wants!
We have to put an end to all of this ...  Right?

text.ACTION: I think Kashiwagi is so unaware that the fog just doesn't do anything to her.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%2097/14-P4-00100.jpg

text.Noriko Kashiwagi: They're saying it can even beat out the germs from the fog. That's why I've been doing it every day since I saw it.

text.ACTION: Ai wanted to talk to me about something, so I hung out with her on the roof again.

... I'm better at long-distance running than sprints, I prefer milk over tea, and I like daifuku more than cream puffs.

But if the world ends, that's all over.

VIDEO- "Lost Okina"
Boss Battle: Lost Okina

This is a really annoying fight. He's only vulnerable to a few forms of elemental damage and completely immune to physicals. At the same time, though, he's largely nonthreatening. He will use Masukunda to reduce your agility, Stagnant Air to increase the probability that you are hit with status effects, and Navas Nebula, an attack that does damage and can exhaust. That's the whole damn fight. Amusingly Naoto is actually the best character for this fight because Almighty is by far the most effective form of attack against the boss. For defeating it we get a Chakra Ring, an accessory that halves the SP usage of the character who has it equipped.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Envious Giant

This is a funny little boss fight. The Giant pretty much just spams Megidoloan the whole fight, which can hurt so be ready with Mediarahan. He's largely insulated from most elemental magic, but is critically vulnerable to physical attacks. I almost kill him with a single non-crit Power Charged God's Hand. The trick though is that he also has High Counter, so sometimes those will get repelled back at you. I'd suggest you use Debilitate on him if you've got Trumpeter, which you should. That'll make his damage output drop substantially both in reducing the damage his Megidoloans do and their accuracy, and he'll take much more damage. Once he's dead, you'll be able to enter the door back in Magastu Inaba.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Ameno-Sagiri

Ameno-Sagiri is worlds nastier than anything we've faced up to this point. He gets two actions each round, and he'll use a nasty mix of -dyne level spells and a Light attack called God's Judgement that halves the target's health at first. After we've taken his health down a little, he gets serious.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20100/38-P4-00212.jpg

text.Ameno Sagiri: Why act against the wishes of your fellow man? Consider ...  is that truly just?

Then he'll use his signature move, Nebula Oculus. This is a powerful almighty attack similar to Megidoloan. He'll also start using group -dyne spells and Agneyastra now, so make sure you keep him Debilitated as much as possible. Bring him down slowly and steadily and eventually you'll see this:

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20100/39-P4-00215.jpg

text.Ameno Sagiri: Why will you not understand this!?

At this point he'll use Bewildering Fog. This makes him completely immune to attack for a while. What he'll then do is buff himself with Tarukaja and Sukukaja and Mind Charge. You have a full turn to do whatever buffing or healing you'll need, at which point you need to guard because when the fog lifts he'll cast Nebula Oculus, which will likely kill anyone who isn't guarding in one hit. Now he adds Dekaja and Dekunda to his arsenal, and will use them quite a bit if he's debuffed or you're buffed. He'll also start using Shadow Naoto's Galgalim Eyes attack, which if you recall reduces someone's health to 1 and Enervates them. As his health gets critical, he shifts to his final phase.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20100/40-P4-00221.jpg

text.Ameno Sagiri: I will bring about the deaths of those who would keep true peace from the world!

He'll use Quake, an attack that knocks people down, then release the Bewildering Fog again. Once again you need to be ready to guard, he'll Mind Charge and Nebula Oculus when the fog lifts. His tactics don't change much, but by this point you're likely to be low on resources. Just keep things together and you can bring him down.

text.Naoto Shirogane: I know this is what all the girls wear, but, um ...  Isn't the skirt too short ... ?

text.ACTION: And she wasn't very comfortable with it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/7-P4-00038.jpg

text.Naoto Shirogane: P-Please stop!
Don't embarrass me ...
I-I think I'll stick with my normal outfit ...
I'd feel awkward all day if I wore it at school.
... But I'm happy that I showed it to you.
... Huh?
Y-You want me here tonight ... ?
I-I can probably come up with some kind of alibi for where I spent the night ...

text.ACTION: The watch reads: "Distance: <1 m"…
We all got together at the food court earlier today.
VIDEO- "Christmas"

text.Naoto Shirogane: I think we can safely leave the rest to the police.
Adachi has confessed to his crimes, so I'm sure Namatame's presumed guilt will be reexamined as well.

text.Chie Satonaka: I see ...
Then that really wraps it up.

text.Rise Kujikawa: What'll you do now, Teddie? You're not going back over there, are you?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: You better not, you dumb bear! You don't know how much you worried us last time ...

text.Teddie: I-I won't suddenly disappear like that again!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Damn straight you won't. Man, just stay here, alright?

text.ACTION: Just then I got a call.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/14-P4-00066.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Hey, it's me.
Good news. It looks like they're letting Nanako come home for a bit.
She's awake again, and she's got a good amount of strength back too.
All goes well, she might be able to leave the hospital for the time being.
And as for me, hey said I just needed to see a doctor regularly. So I'm planning to come home with Nanako today.
Sorry I had to stick you with all the housework. I'll make up for it somehow. Anyway, I'll see you later.

text.ACTION: I told everyone the good news.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/16-P4-00074.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: I-I'm so happy for her ... !

text.Teddie: Me too ...  I'm really glad ...
The fog's all gone over here because everyone tried so hard ...  And now Nana-chan's gotten better!

text.Rise Kujikawa: Nanako-chan tried hard too ...
Sh-She's such an amazing girl ...  (sob)

text.Teddie: W-Waaaaaaah!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Seriously ...  Thank heavens she's okay.

text.Rise Kujikawa: (sniff) (sniff)
Where're you touching!?

text.Teddie: Augh ...

text.Chie Satonaka: Well, one thing's certain ...
It's party time!
Let's throw a big Christmas party for Nanako-chan!

text.Teddie: A party, you say!? I'm sure Nana-chan will be delighted!

text.Yukiko Amagi: We'll need a cake then.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: G-Guys ...  Please say you're not gonna ...

text.ACTION: And then they said it.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/18-P4-00091.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: Of course we're gonna make one.

text.Yukiko Amagi: I've already researched the ingredients.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Hey-W-Wait! Wait a sec! Whoa there!
That's way too tall an order for you!

text.Chie Satonaka: Let's go to the grocery department!
C'mon, Naoto-kun, you too!

text.Naoto Shirogane: B-But I've never baked a cake ...

text.Yukiko Amagi: Don't worry. Neither have we!

text.ACTION: We tried not to let it dim our excitement.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/19-P4-00100.jpg

text.Teddie: So this is the fabled kotatsu ...

text.Nanako: I was really looking forward to the new kotatsu!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Yeah, you talked about it all the time at the hospital.
Nanako's going back for a close checkup tomorrow, but at this rate, the doctors say she can leave the hospital soon.
If I'd gotten better sooner, we would've been able to buy the kotatsu together ...  Sorry.

text.Chie Satonaka: Sorry for the wait!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh no ...  The Christmas edition of Mystery Food X is about to be served ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Bring it on, I'm ready. Got my insurance card and everything.

text.ACTION: Needless to say we were floored.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/22-P4-00112.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Hey, this is bigger than I imagined ...

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Wait, Nanako-chan! I'll be the first one to-
NOOOOOO!!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Th-That can't be ...
No ...  Has she lost all sense of taste?

text.ACTION: She's right! It's like nothing you've tasted before!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Did you guys really make this?

text.Chie Satonaka: Huh? O-Of course we did.

text.Yukiko Amagi: Does it actually taste like something ... ?

text.Rise Kujikawa: It's not hot, is it?
How is it Kanji? Hm?

text.Kanji Tatsumi: I-It's amazing!

text.Chie Satonaka: You know what they say about true talent not needing to show off? Turns out we had good taste in cooking after all.

text.Naoto Shirogane: Then again, this one was our third attempt ...

text.Teddie: Hey, Yosuke! Chie-chan and the others really are talented chefs! Three starts for sure!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: I-Impossible ...  This ...  actually tastes good!
Wait, I didn't already pass out, did I? This isn't a dream, right?

text.Teddie: Ummm ...  Nana-chan, guess what I have ...

text.ACTION: Teddie had been busy the past few days.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/23-P4-00133.jpg

text.Nanako: Oh! It looks just like you!

text.Teddie: I wish I could've made it look better ...
But I thought it'd keep you company at the hospital, Nana-chan.
Oh, and it's made from 100% pure Teddie fur. I'm a guy who's all about using all-natural materials!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: I-Isn't that nice of him, Nanako?
Teddie fur ... ?
I have to thank you all again ...
Adachi confessed to the two murders. He insists it was him who hung the bodies, too.
There are still things that are unclear about his story, but he's most likely gonna pay for his crimes.
Anyway, this was one strange case ...
If what you said about a world inside the TV was true, then everything might make sense ...
... Though I still don't believe it.
Some things in this world just can't be explained.
Like Nanako ...  She made a miraculous recovery, and now she's as healthy as ever.
Back in the day ...  my own senpai on the force told me something.
"There's an underside to everything that you can never see."
This case has made me think about a lot of things ...
You've helped us out so much ...  Heh, it was meant to be the other way around, really ...

text.ACTION: Dojima brought up something I've sort of been wishing wasn't the case.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20101/24-P4-00154.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: That's right ...  You're only here until spring, huh ... ?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Senpai? You're going back ... ?

text.Naoto Shirogane: ... It won't be the same without you.

text.Teddie: Sensei ...  Are you going somewhere ... ?

text.Souji: I don't want to go back.

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Don't forget, there are people waiting for you.
When you get home, show your parents how much you've grown this past year.
And then, if they're okay with it ...  you can come back here at any time.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: C'mon, spring's a long ways off, right? Let's have all the fun we can until then!

text.Ryotaro Dojima: H-Hey, don't get too carried away. My sis would kill me if you got yourself held back a year ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Oh, but then you wouldn't have to go back, huh?

text.Rise Kujikawa: Wow, if that happened, I'd be in the same grade as Senpai.

text.ACTION: But spring's still a long ways off…
Together with them, you have overcome many ordeals, and the peace you've long waited for has returned…
Though the extreme cold has eased somewhat, the winter weather in this region is still severe.
But the days that you spend with your friends whom you have faced the truth with are always warm.
And…
Time has passed… and spring has come.
It's the day before you must go back to the city…
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/2-P4-00010.jpg
I suppose I was sort of bothered even before the day really began. After all, this was my last day in Inaba. But I never would have imagined it all ending this way.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/3-P4-00012.jpg

text.Ryotaro Dojima: All done packing? Well ...  if you forget anything, I'll mail it to you.

text.Nanako: Can I go answer the door?

text.Ryotaro Dojima: Oh yeah ...  That's right.
Sure, go answer it. There's nothing to worry about anymore.
Seeing her so cheerful like that ...  Nothing makes me happier.
I already bought your train ticket for tomorrow. It leaves at nine o'clock in the morning from Yasoinaba Station.
Today's your last day here ...  Don't worry about Nanako. You can leave her to me.
Go see your friends. This might be your last chance to talk to them.

text.ACTION: This is the last day you will be spending in this town.
You should wander around for a while…

text.Nanako: Are you going out? Be careful!

text.ACTION: The letter was for me, though I didn't really look at it. I just carried it along with me. Anyway, I started out down by the Samegawa. There was a big surprise waiting for me.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/6-P4-00024.jpg

text.Hisano Kuroda: My, my! What a coincidence. We really are connected by fate. (chuckle)
Shall we talk like old times?
Goodness, I'm so happy.
I just went to visit my husband's grave. Then I came to look at the river like I did last time ...
Next thing I know, here you are. There's a surprise.
I live with one of my kids, and his family now. They're all so kind.
... I just realized that I almost never talked about my kids with you.
I probably distanced myself from the rest of my family ...
I was afraid that if I didn't, I was going to depend on them ...
They're living their own lives; I didn't want to be a burden on them.
So I wanted them to forget about me ...  to treat me as if I was dead.
But they welcomed me ...  and now we live together.
They take care of me, but I'm taking care of my grandson.
(chuckle) So there's a little bit of give-and-take there.
There really is a place in the world where I belong.
I'd just assumed that there wasn't one.
They're my children ...  my family. I regret that I didn't talk with them before.
My husband's death must have been sad for them, too. After all, they lost their father ...

text.ACTION: I'm glad she was able to find her family again.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/9-P4-00045.jpg

text.Hisano Kuroda: Yes, very much so ...
I'm so happy right now, but because of that, I feel sad every now and then.
I can't help but think, "He must have wanted to feel this happiness, too ... "
So I've decided that the best thing I can do is live a long, happy life.
I'll make the rest of my life as great as it can be ...  And then I'll tell my husband about it when I see him again.
Then, we'll have all of eternity to be happy together.
I'm not afraid anymore. Just ...  a little lonely.
(chuckle) I'll also have to tell him everything that happened in town, too.
About this whole crazy year, those awful murders, and how the police solved the case.
I'll definitely have to tell him all about you, too.
I recently realized something.
Precious things remain precious, whether you're alive or dead ...
Sorry for making you listen to my long-winded monologue.
You look like you still have things left to do.
You look like you've grown up a lot, Souji-chan. You're much more handsome now, too.
Not as handsome as my husband was, though. (chuckle)
Well then ...  Take care of yourself.
You still have a lot of life ahead of you.

text.ACTION: You feel a close bond between Hisano and yourself…
HIsano left without looking back…
I remembered there was an early bus to the hospital so I decided to see if Sayoko was there today. I was pretty surprised by what I found.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/10-P4-00069.jpg
They seem to be talking about Sayoko…

text.Young Nurse: She joined some volunteer organization and went to Africa.

text.Slim Nurse: Africa!? I never though she'd be he kind of person who would go there ...

text.Young Nurse: Well, she seemed to be taking her job very seriously towards the end of her time here. She even studied during break.
Do you remember when we were talking about the rumors of the Midnight Channel? She wasn't interested at all.

text.Slim Nurse: Oh, I remember those rumors. Not that I know where they started ...
But yeah, not that you mention it, Uehara-san was never around when we were chatting about them.
She was studying some foreign language, wasn't she?

text.Young Nurse: She was trying to learn English and some African languages. She read a lot of medical books, too.

text.Slim Nurse: I see ...  But, why Africa? Why'd she join a volunteer organization? What's the point?
I'd rather marry a guy, raise kids, and be an ordinary housewife.

text.Young Nurse: That's what I used to think too, but watching Uehara-san kinda made me feel different about it.
... She did seem to have a boyfriend, though. A very young one, too!

text.Slim Nurse: Oh, it must have been that kid who was working here part-time ...

text.Young Nurse: I don't know the details, but he seemed to really mean something to her ...
She one told me that she was trying to do her best to live up to him ...

text.Slim Nurse: ... I feel I have to try harder, too ...

text.Young Nurse: Yeah ...  I'm starting to see where she was coming from.
... Let's get back to work and do our best.

text.ACTION: It seems that Sayoko is working hard in a foreign country…
Even though Sayoko is gone, her life here has changed people for the better.
You feel a close bond between Sayoko and yourself…
Even though I might never see her again, I could feel how much we meant to each other. Anyway, I caught a bus down to the Amagi Inn from there, Yukiko had to work for a while today.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/11-P4-00096.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: Souji-kun ...  That's right, you're leaving tomorrow.
Thanks for coming to see me before you leave ...
... It means a lot to me.
I ...  I was thinking of spending today as just another day.
Helping with the housework, taking a long bath, and going to sleep ...
So I can ...  I can say goodbye without crying ...
(chuckle) But I failed miserably ...  I kept thinking about you ...
And on top of that ...  Here you are, right in front of me. You're not helping at all.
... You're so mean.
That's it, I'm leaving town with you tomorrow!
(chuckle) Just kidding ...  for now.
You know ...  After I decided to stay here and become the manager, I realized how afraid I was ...
Whether I can meet all the responsibilities ...
Whether I'll be able to support the whole staff on my own ...
I never thought of things like that ...
But I've made my decision ...  Now I have to make an honest attempt at it.
I'll do my best to overcome the fear.
And you'll be in my heart while I do, Souji-kun ...
We'll be together ...  even when we're apart.

text.ACTION: I was happy that Yukiko was happy with her decision to stay.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/13-P4-00116.jpg

text.Yukiko Amagi: I'm going to meet every challenge head-on, no matter how hard it seems ...
... Remember what Ameno-sagiri said? "If mankind so wishes, I will return at any time ... "
That's not what I wish for ...
I'll face myself, no matter what happens.
Souji-kun ...  Thank you.
You'll forever be my precious friend.

text.ACTION: You feel a solid bond between you and Yukiko…

text.Yukiko Amagi: U-Um, well ...  I-I should get back to work!
I'll see you tomorrow ...

text.ACTION: I was already starting to notice something strange, but it hadn't quite started to bother me yet. Anyway, back in the shopping district I ran into Chie. Improbably, she was at the bookstore.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/14-P4-00126.jpg

text.Chie Satonaka: You caught me off guard, haha ...
Oh, umm ...  I was just thinking of you, and you suddenly showed up, so ...

text.ACTION: Chie is laughing, embarrassed…

text.Chie Satonaka: ... Tomorrow's the day, huh?
I thought a lot about you, and I ...  I decided to come here.
I was thinking, "What can I do for you?" And I figured crying or feeling sad about you leaving wasn't it ...
So I made up my mind ...  I'm gonna show you what you've taught me.
I bought a book.
It's called ...  "How to Become a Police Officer!"
I told you I wanted to become strong so I could protect what matters most to me, right?
Well, I want to protect this town.
We all worked hard to win this peace ...  I wanna keep it this way.
You can't be certain that no incident like this will ever happen again, right?
This is where all my best friends are ...  It's where I met you.
... So I thought maybe I'd become a cop, and have Dojima-san put me through the wringer!

text.ACTION: Chie is smiling cheerfully…

text.Chie Satonaka: So go home proud. We'll be fine here ...
Come back anytime. We'll all be waiting for you.

text.ACTION: You feel a tight bond with Chie…

text.Chie Satonaka: ... You still have to say goodbye to everyone else, right?
Go ahead ...  Go.

text.ACTION: Chie is smiling sadly…

As I started walking down the road, I really couldn't help but notice someone who, um, stood out a bit. I have no idea if people noticed her standing there, but Margaret was just sort of chilling out by the entrance to the Velvet Room.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/16-P4-00151.jpg

text.Margaret: ... You have come.
I was waiting for you.
I wanted to see you before you left.
Though, parting words aren't what I have for you ...
Remember?
The heart is shaken more by a single action than by a thousand words ...
Do you know what action will shake both of our hearts ... ?

text.ACTION: You only live once, so they say.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/18-P4-00159.jpg

text.Margaret: (chuckle)
For us residents ...  I'm sure this is a sin.
Now ...  Close your eyes.
Why, you ask ... ?
So that you don't witness my sinfulness.
Mm ...

text.ACTION: You feel a solid bond between you and Margaret…

text.Margaret: Why did I steal a kiss ... ? Is that what you were going to ask? But it's you who was the thief.
(chuckle)
Will I ever see you again, I wonder ... ?
Well, then ...  Farewell.

text.ACTION: That the door to the Velvet Room still remained seemed kind of strange, but I moved on. Rise was nearby, outside of Marukyu.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/19-P4-00173.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Senpai ...  No ...  That's like you came to say goodbye ... !
I'm not planning on letting this be the last time we meet!
... It does make me sad, though.
I told you before, right? I'm returning to showbiz, starting spring.
I went to voice training today to prepare myself for that. You see, I'm redebuting myself with a new album!
I'm writing all the lyrics myself! Well, I got a D in Composition, so they aren't exactly masterpieces ...
... But you know, a lot of stuff's happened while I was on break ...
I made friends ...  dear friends ...  Everyone was so nice to me ...
I want to express that to everyone who will listen. My deepest feelings, in my own words.
Ahh, I'm scared! I'm scared of putting the real me out there for people to see ...
But ...  I can't give in to that fear, right?
I'll work hard, for all my fans out there ...  I'm gonna make a huge comeback!
... So wish me luck!
(giggle) Thank you, Senpai.
I know that you'll be watching me on the other side of the camera ...  I'll keep thinking that way as I work.

text.ACTION: You feel a close bond between yourself and Rise…

text.Rise Kujikawa: I look back at Junes now, and I feel all these good memories of us ...

text.ACTION: I still can't wait for this commercial.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/21-P4-00194.jpg

text.Rise Kujikawa: Then you'll all remember the times we had every time you see it!
... But then, we'll all feel a bit lonely afterwards, huh ... ?
Senpai ...  I'll see you tomorrow. I'll say goodbye, and I won't cry ...
... I'm so glad that fog's gone.
I mean, it's still foggy over in the other world, but it's a clear, blue sky over here.
We can see you off on a happy note ...  Well, see you later.

text.ACTION: It'd been a while since I checked on the fox, so I headed down to the shrine.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/22-P4-00204.jpg
The shrine seems to be prospering, as some objects are shimmering with a golden sheen…
You don't see the fox…
Perhaps it left…

text.Keita's Grandpa: Hm? What's a young man like you doing in an old place like this?
This place was bustling with visitors not too long ago, but these days, you see less and less.
I heard the town was considering tearing the place down because someone stole money from the offertory box.
Also heard some fox had taken up a home here and they were gonna haul it off to an animal shelter.
Too many rumors these days.
Remember that one about how the fog was making everyone sick?
Or that other one ...  What was it called? Midnight Radio ... ? That was popular with the kids, alright.
My grandson and his friends were all into it.
Funny, I remember something kinda like that happening when I was a kid, too. Wonder who starts these rumors ...
... Oops, I almost forgot. I was supposed to pick up some juice for my grandson.

text.ACTION: You wonder if the fox was taken to an animal shelter, as that old man said…
You decided to leave the shrine…
You feel a presence watching you…
Things weren't as they seemed.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/23-P4-00223.jpg
The fox family seems to be welcoming you…
They look like they're doing fine…
The fox's happiness reminds you of the close bond you share with it…
I left the foxes, Kanji was by the textile shop so I decided to stop in and talk with him.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/24-P4-00227.jpg
Kanji seems to be panicking for some reason…

text.Kanji's Mother: Oh, hello Souji-kun.
I heard you're leaving tomorrow. You know, Kanji's been acting all say and lonely lately.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Sh-Shut up, you old bat!!

text.Kanji's Mother: I told you not to speak to me that way!
Anyway, have you told him about the handicraft class?
Thank you for being such a role model for my son, Souji-kun.
Come visit here sometime, all right? Goodbye now.

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Y-You didn't hear what she said, did you ... ?
Ugh ...
See, a buncha customers liked those knitted dolls we sold, and they asked me how to make 'em ...
S-So ...  I-I'm gonna hold classes on how to do it ...
L-Laught it up, why don't you!?

text.ACTION: I didn't think it was funny at all.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/26-P4-00245.jpg

text.Kanji Tatsumi: ... Senpai.
It was my decision, though.
If people wanna learn, and if I can teach 'em ...  Hell, why not, you know?
I-I'm still kinda embarrassed, though ...
But, uhh ...
It kinda feels good to do something for other people ...
... Heh.
It's only 'cause of you that I could face up to who I am, Senpai.
... Thank you very much!!

text.ACTION: Kanji has a refreshing smile on his face…
You feel a solid bond between you and Kanji…

text.Kanji Tatsumi: Are you gonna say goodbye to the others later?
... Well, it ain't like this is the last time we'll see each other.
Our friendship ain't just on the surface ...  Funny how we got the murder case to thank for that.
... We put an end to that stuff, right?
Adachi's in the slammer, and the fog is all cleared up ...
... It's all thanks to you, Senpai.
Yo, Senpai ...  When you go, don't turn back around, okay?
See ya.

text.ACTION: I figured Yosuke and Teddie were working, so I headed down to Junes.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/27-P4-00268.jpg

text.Teddie: Sensei! I'm super-duper happy that you came to see me!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Going around saying goodbye, huh?
What'd you think of the sleepy, peaceful version of Inaba? It must seem weird to you ...
Huh ...  I wonder why it began just as you arrived here ...
I remember that first time. Sensei and Yosuke, braving the TV world alone ...

text.Teddie: Boy, I feel so nostalgic!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Yeah. Ever since then, it was just one surprise after another ...
I can't imagine how it's gonna be like, living here without you.
A quiet, peaceful town, with no need to use our Personas anymore ...

text.Teddie: I can't imagine it either.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: ... That's right, we were right in the middle of the case when you came over to this side.
A lot of stuff's happened.
Facing my true self ...  And you and me got into a fight, too ...

text.Teddie: Y-Yosuke, did you smack Sensei!? Oooh, how reckless ...

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Of course, moron. Best friends gotta fight sometimes to be best friends.

text.ACTION: Teddie always takes things too literally.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/30-P4-00285.jpg

text.Teddie: Sensei! Bring it on! Let's fight!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Don't hurt him, man. He's gotta get on that train tomorrow.

text.Teddie: Sensei ...  You're really leaving, huh?
I'm glad I met you and Yosuke.
You two completely changed my life ...
And Nana-chan, Yuki-chan and the others, too ...
They all helped me ...  They gave life to me.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: Life ... ? Come on, man.
You were the one who wanted to change. That's why you tried so hard to make it happen.

text.Teddie: ... Thank you so much, Sensei and Yosuke!
I love you.

text.Yosuke Hanamura: "Love" is kinda strong ...

text.Teddie: I'll take off my outfit if you want!

text.Yosuke Hanamura: L-Let's not ...

text.ACTION: You feel a solid bond between you, Yosuke, and Teddie…

text.Yosuke Hanamura: By the way, is it okay for you to chill here?
Don't you have somewhere to go?
Like ...  meeting someone?

text.Teddie: Do you want Teddie to come with you?

text.Yosuke Hanamura: No, I think Teddie has to work ...

text.ACTION: The school was open due to a few activities, so I wandered in for a bit. I thought I saw someone familiar in the drama room, and sure enough I was right.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20102/31-P4-00312.jpg

text.Yumi Ozawa: I knew you'd come ...  Hehe.
I came here today to turn something in and ...  I felt this wave of nostalgia.
We used to be in this club together ...
You're leaving tomorrow, right?
I have something to tell you.
I haven't really put my thoughts in order yet ...  But I want you to hear what I have to say.
Because you're the one who changed how I think, Souji-kun ...

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Izanami

So here starts the first phase of the final boss, the battle with Izanami. Izanami doesn't have any particular elemental defenses in this phase but she has stats through the roof. She starts out pretty simply, throwing around ma-dyne spells. You want to be a bit careful about Yukiko and especially Teddie, she's pretty much guaranteed to cast Maziodyne at least once. After you've done a little damage, she gets serious.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20105/21-P4-00057.jpg

Now she'll start using Megidoloan pretty heavily, which can do some serious damage if she's not debilitated. As her health gets lower, she'll also start Mind Charging. Needless to say you need to guard, as she'll follow up with a Megidoloan that's basically certain to wipe your party. Try to conserve your SP on this fight, because you're about to need every bit of it ...
Try as they may, the pitiful creatures can do true harm to one such as I.

text.ACTION: Boss Battle: Izanami-no-Okami

Here it is, our final boss. She's got weaker defenses than her first form, though she now drains electricity. She also hits a bit softer in absolute terms but now she gets two actions. Once again you want to keep her debilitated as much as possible. She has and will use sometimes ma-dyne spells (especially maziodyne and mabufudyne) but she mostly uses her own unique Almighty skills. At first she'll mostly use Fury of Yasogami. This is an interesting sort of skill, because it does Almighty damage but is flagged as a physical attack. This lets it crit, which is needless to say bad. Izanami will generally use Dekunda on herself when she gets One More if she's debuffed and Debilitate on the MC otherwise. She'll also use ma-ndas and Debilitate sometimes, so having Dekunda yourself is pretty handy. As the fight starts she'll immediately Mind Charge and debuff your defense. Any time she Charges you of course need to guard. The fight proceeds like this for a little while before she gets even more angry.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20105/28-P4-00080.jpg

Now she'll start threading in Kuro Ikazuchi, a very damaging magical Almighty attack.  This tends to increase the damage you'll be taking as a group, but it's not too bad. One big threat is that she can Mind Charge her Kuro Ikazuchis, which can really lay the hurt on you. When you get her health down a bit more, things get really dangerous.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20105/29-P4-00083.jpg

Now she'll use Galgalim Eyes, which if you recall reduces you to one HP and enervates you. Then we'll see her next signature move, Summons to Yomi. This instantly kills anyone with a status effect. Obviously this is a pretty significant danger, and it gets worse after you've done a bit more damage to her. She'll use Stagnant Air, which makes status effects more likely to work, and Mind Charge. Then on her next turn she'll unleash her ultimate attack, World's End. This is like Nyx Avatar's Night Queen attack, it causes a bunch of Almighty damage and random status effects. If you're still alive after World's End she'll compound it with a Summons to Yomi. You 100% need to guard no matter what after the Stagnant Air/Mind Charge because otherwise you are basically guaranteed to die. But once you've gotten this far, if you can just keep it going, you should be good. This can be a long fight, so don't be afraid to use any SP restoring items you may have. Not like there's any use for them after this. Take her down to zero health and the fight will end ...
There is only one truth.

text.ACTION: Part 108: Bonus Boss: A Date With Margaret
The Bonus Boss: A Date With Margaret

So, if you've met all the requirements to fight the bonus boss I laid out last time, late in the game you'll enter the Velvet Room and Margaret will give you a brief story about her sister Elizabeth and challenge you to a duel. So for those not familiar with Persona 3, here's an executive summary of the information we get:

Elizabeth had Margaret's role in The Journey and The Answer. She leaves the Velvet Room after The Answer. Margaret knows why but won't say, and she thinks the reason was pretty foolish. She intends to track her down and bring her back, but first wants to fight us for reasons that will totally make sense later. Maybe.

Anyway, Margaret will wait for us at the end of Heaven. This means we need to beat the bonus shadow there before we can fight her (you'd be CRAZY not to want the Chakra Ring for this fight anyway). You'll notice the atmosphere is hugely different when you approach the final heaven if you've done everything right. And when you approach the platform, things'll start ...
VIDEO- "Showdown With Margaret"

It seems Elizabeth also requested a duel from our last guest.
Though there's no way of knowing whether the boy took her up on the offer.
(chuckle) I called my sister foolish, but it seems we are kin indeed.
Are you sure you're ready ... ?
As the one who rules over power ...  I will fight with the utmost deference to you.
Show me what lies beyond a mere exchange of words.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/4-P4-00012.jpg

text.ACTION: Bonus Boss: Margaret

Margaret is a very special sort of fight. The first thing to keep in mind is that her attack pattern is 100% predictable. You'll always know what attack she's going to use next turn, which is important. This is because she hits HARD. If she's not Debilitated she is capable of doing absolutely massive amounts of damage to your party. The second thing to keep in mind is that you CANNOT use an Omnipotent Orb on anyone during this fight. If you do she'll chain cast 9999 damage Megidoloans until you die. The third thing is that she'll do one of those every 50 turns no matter what, so you probably want to give your MC an accessory with Endure like the Partial Award just in case. She can be Downed by a crit, and unless you've got something like Vile Assault you might as well just take the All Out because you'll never Dizzy her. She's got 15000 HP which is important to keep in the back of your mind.

So, two things control what attack Margaret will use. The first is her health, the second is an internal counter of turns taken. While her health is above 80%, she'll just Attack people. It's damaging for an Attack but not much to worry about. When she gets to 80%, things get a bit more exciting, because that's when she'll start her Persona Cycle. This is the cycle:
Turn 1:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/6-P4-00020.jpg
Siegfried: Drains Fire. Skills: Ragnarok, Meltdown (Mega Fire to party)
Turn 2:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/7-P4-00023.jpg
Loki: Drains Ice. Skills: Niflheim, Cocytus Pain (Mega Ice to party)
Turn 3:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/8-P4-00027.jpg
Okuninushi: Drains Elec. Skills: Thunder Reign, Narukami (Mega Elec to party)
Turn 4:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/9-P4-00029.jpg
Cu Chulainn: Drains Wind. Skills: Panta Rhei, Divine Wind (Mega Wind to party)
Turn 5:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/10-P4-00031.jpg
Oberon: Nulls Everything. Skill: Mind Charge
Turn 6:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/11-P4-00035.jpg
Ardha: Resists Everything. Skill: Megidoloan

And then she'll cycle back to Turn 1. What she'll do is use the group mega damage spells each turn unless you have someone weak to the element she's currently using, at which point she'll use the single target mega damage spell on them THEN use the group one with her One More. Obviously you need to Guard when she Mind Charges because the Megidoloan WILL kill you. After a bit Margaret will talk some shit.
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/12-P4-00024.jpg

text.Margaret: I'll tell you now, discard any concern you may have for me.

The main threat in this phase is forgetting what she's going to do next. If you brought Teddie or Yukiko be very careful to Guard them through their weakness when she's getting ready to use it, or she'll waste their Endure and as we'll see later having that can be very important later. Anyway, things get more exciting at 50%.

text.ACTION: https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/13-P4-00036.jpg

text.Margaret: My apologies, but I'm even more eager to defeat you now!

And then she'll switch to Lucifer and cast Morning Star on you. This is like Megidoloan but nastier, pretty much. It doesn't even matter what elements Lucifer is vulnerable to really, because on her NEXT turn she'll switch to Ardha and cast Diarahan. So now she's back in her 80+% phase, but since she's in Ardha she'll take half damage from everything (even Almighty). One thing to keep in mind is that she'll start back exactly where she was in the sequence once she's below 80% again. Things proceed normally at that point until she reaches about 40% health or so. That's when Margaret stops playing the fuck around with you. Oberon will start casting Power Charge instead of Mind Charge, and she gets a whole new Turn 6. Just think of the worst thing she could do with a Power Charge, then look down.

text.ACTION: Turn 6 New

Yeah she starts using Power Charged Hassou Tobis as her sixth action. Weaker characters like Naoto, Yukiko, or Teddie can die even if they Guard unless she is debilitated and they have rakukaja on. Ideally you have a Trumpeter or Norn that nulls physical in one way or another, because that lets you recast debilitate if you need to on the turn she Power Charges. If you don't, one other option is to 'sacrifice' someone to use an Attack Mirror on Souji. Just keep scraping people up and drag her down as best you can. You'll know you're getting close when you see this:
https://lparchive.org/Persona-4/Update%20108/15-P4-00047.jpg

text.Margaret: Now, show me ...  Show me what lies beyond battles ... !

Again, you have 50 turns to kill her before she uses a 9999 megidoloan on the party. If you endure that, you buy yourself another 50 turns. In the improbable situation that you're still fighting her at turn 100, she will mercifully terminate you with another 9999 megidoloan. Take her down, though, and congratulations. You've beaten the hardest enemy in the game.

text.Margaret: Before Elizabeth left ...  she told me this.
A soul slumbers at the ends of the world-that of a young man who devoted himself to becoming a seal ...
That soul is risking itself to prevent mankind, who has lost the joy of living, from calling down ultimate destruction ...
She told me that she was going to save him from that fate.
To tell the truth, I wondered what sort of nonsense she was speaking. But no ...  She was serious.
She said if she couldn't do it alone, she would combine her powers with those bonded with that soul to enact a miracle.
Maybe all that she said was the truth ...  And that was her reason for leaving the Velvet Room ...
She must have come to realize what I now understand ...
You, a human, won against me, one who rules against power ...
You have shown me one's potential.
Those who search for themselves ...  are "no one" as long as the search continues.
It isn't emptiness, but limitless potential ...  It means the seeker can choose to be anything he or she wishes.
